txt:rv_w_pressure.zh: 舱室尚未完成泄压，就直接开启了舱门。
txt:rv_w_pressure.en: COMPARTMENT OPENED BEFORE DEPRESSURIZATION WAS COMPLETE.

txt:rv_y_pressure.zh: 开启前未通过与舱室连通的测点确认内部压力，也没有完成泄压处理。舱门开启时仍存在压差，违反安全操作要求。
txt:rv_y_pressure.en: INTERNAL PRESSURE WAS NOT VERIFIED AT A TEST POINT CONNECTED TO THE COMPARTMENT, AND DEPRESSURIZATION WAS NOT COMPLETED. A PRESSURE DIFFERENTIAL REMAINED WHEN THE DOOR WAS OPENED.

txt:rv_w_power.zh: 电气回路尚未断电，就直接拆除了连接部件。
txt:rv_w_power.en: ELECTRICAL CONNECTION REMOVED WHILE THE CIRCUIT WAS STILL ENERGIZED.

txt:rv_y_power.zh: 设备停止运行后仍可能带电。拆卸前应先切断所有供电及储能回路，释放残余电能，并在测点确认电压为 0 V。
txt:rv_y_power.en: EQUIPMENT MAY REMAIN ENERGIZED EVEN WHEN STOPPED. ISOLATE ALL POWER SOURCES, DISCHARGE STORED ENERGY, AND VERIFY 0 V AT THE TEST POINT BEFORE DISCONNECTING.

txt:rv_w_tied.zh: 部件尚有连接未解除，强行拖拽导致连接处断裂（%s）。
txt:rv_w_tied.en: PART WAS PULLED BEFORE ALL CONNECTIONS WERE RELEASED, CAUSING DAMAGE AT THE ATTACHMENT POINTS (%s).

txt:rv_y_tied.zh: 拖动前未确认部件是否完全脱离船体。应先使用检测工具检查固定点和连接管线，全部解除后再进行拖运。
txt:rv_y_tied.en: THE PART WAS NOT FULLY DETACHED BEFORE MOVING. USE THE INSPECTION TOOL TO LOCATE ALL MOUNTING POINTS AND CONNECTED LINES, THEN RELEASE THEM BEFORE TOWING.

txt:rv_w_tied_lines.zh: 拖动部件时仍有管道或电缆连接，强行拖拽导致管线断裂（%s）。
txt:rv_w_tied_lines.en: PART MOVED WITH PIPES OR CABLES STILL ATTACHED, CAUSING CONNECTIONS TO TEAR (%s).

txt:rv_y_tied_lines.zh: 拆除了固定件，但没有检查剩余的管道和电缆连接。应分别确认所有连接点，全部解除后才能拖动部件。
txt:rv_y_tied_lines.en: MOUNTING POINTS WERE RELEASED, BUT PIPE AND CABLE CONNECTIONS WERE NOT FULLY CHECKED. ALL CONNECTIONS MUST BE INSPECTED AND DISCONNECTED BEFORE MOVING THE PART.

txt:rv_w_tied_hidden.zh: 检修面板后仍有隐藏固定点未解除，强行拖动导致连接处断裂（%s）。
txt:rv_w_tied_hidden.en: PART MOVED WITH A HIDDEN MOUNTING POINT STILL ATTACHED BEHIND THE ACCESS PANEL, CAUSING DAMAGE (%s).

txt:rv_y_tied_hidden.zh: 检测结果显示的固定点数量多于当前可见数量，但没有进一步排查。应先拆除检修面板，找到隐藏的固定点并解除连接，再进行拖运。
txt:rv_y_tied_hidden.en: THE INSPECTION REPORTED MORE MOUNTING POINTS THAN WERE VISIBLE, BUT THE REMAINING CONNECTION WAS NOT LOCATED. REMOVE THE ACCESS PANEL, FIND AND RELEASE THE HIDDEN MOUNT BEFORE MOVING THE PART.

txt:rv_w_tank.zh: 储气罐内压力过高，拆解过程中发生爆裂。
txt:rv_w_tank.en: GAS TANK RUPTURED UNDER EXCESSIVE INTERNAL PRESSURE DURING DISMANTLING.

txt:rv_y_tank.zh: 舱室已经泄压，但内部储气罐仍存有高压气体。拆解前应单独连接回收软管，确认罐内气体已排空并完成泄压。
txt:rv_y_tank.en: THE COMPARTMENT WAS DEPRESSURIZED, BUT THE GAS TANK INSIDE REMAINED PRESSURIZED. CONNECT A SEPARATE RECOVERY HOSE AND VERIFY THE TANK IS EMPTY AND DEPRESSURIZED BEFORE DISMANTLING.

txt:rv_w_drain.zh: 管路尚未排空就拆除了接头，导致内部液体泄漏。
txt:rv_w_drain.en: PIPE CONNECTION REMOVED BEFORE DRAINING WAS COMPLETE, CAUSING RESIDUAL FLUID TO LEAK.

txt:rv_y_drain.zh: 拆卸前未完成管路排液和冷却处理。应先排空内部液体，等待管路温度降至安全范围，再拆除连接件。
txt:rv_y_drain.en: THE LINE WAS NOT FULLY DRAINED OR COOLED BEFORE DISCONNECTION. DRAIN ALL REMAINING FLUID AND ALLOW THE LINE TO REACH A SAFE TEMPERATURE BEFORE REMOVING THE FITTINGS.

txt:rv_w_cut.zh: 激光切割时误伤设备本体，造成部件损坏（%s）。
txt:rv_w_cut.en: LASER CUTTING DAMAGED THE EQUIPMENT ITSELF (%s).

txt:rv_y_cut.zh: 设备原本可以通过解除固定件和连接管线完整拆下，但直接使用激光切割，造成了不必要的损坏。下次先检查连接结构，尽量完整拆卸。
txt:rv_y_cut.en: THE EQUIPMENT COULD HAVE BEEN REMOVED INTACT BY RELEASING ITS MOUNTS AND CONNECTIONS. USING THE LASER CAUSED AVOIDABLE DAMAGE. INSPECT ALL CONNECTIONS AND TRY TO REMOVE THE EQUIPMENT IN ONE PIECE.

txt:rv_w_impact.zh: 部件在搬运过程中发生剧烈碰撞，导致结构受损（%s）。
txt:rv_w_impact.en: PART DAMAGED BY A HEAVY IMPACT DURING HANDLING (%s).

txt:rv_y_impact.zh: 搬运速度过快，接近目标位置时未及时减速，导致部件碰撞受损。下次应控制拖运速度，并提前制动。
txt:rv_y_impact.en: THE PART WAS MOVED TOO FAST AND WAS NOT SLOWED DOWN IN TIME, RESULTING IN IMPACT DAMAGE. CONTROL YOUR HAULING SPEED AND BRAKE EARLIER.

txt:rv_w_hazard.zh: 危险物品被送入熔炉，或在回收过程中发生起火事故。
txt:rv_w_hazard.en: HAZARDOUS MATERIAL WAS SENT INTO THE FURNACE OR CAUGHT FIRE DURING RECOVERY.

txt:rv_y_hazard.zh: 未确认物品的危险残留及回收去向。含有危险物质的部件应送往危险品回收口，禁止直接投入熔炉。
txt:rv_y_hazard.en: HAZARDOUS RESIDUES AND THE CORRECT DISPOSAL ROUTE WERE NOT VERIFIED. PARTS CONTAINING HAZARDOUS MATERIALS MUST GO TO THE HAZMAT COLLECTION BAY, NOT THE FURNACE.

drill:step:1.zh: 训练任务：先将加工区修复至 1 级，恢复工业熔炉和材料分选线的运行。
drill:step:1.en: TRAINING ORDER: RESTORE THE PROCESSING DISTRICT TO LEVEL 1 AND BRING THE INDUSTRIAL FURNACE AND SORTING LINE BACK ONLINE.

drill:step:2.zh: 训练任务：港务局已提供 1 吨混合废金属供你加工。本次训练的电费和材料检测费由港务局承担。
drill:step:2.en: TRAINING ORDER: THE PORT AUTHORITY HAS PROVIDED 1 TONNE OF MIXED SCRAP METAL FOR PROCESSING. ELECTRICITY AND MATERIAL ASSAY COSTS ARE COVERED FOR THIS TRAINING RUN.

drill:step:3.zh: 训练任务：将加工完成的钢坯交付工业客户，完成本次订单。
drill:step:3.en: TRAINING ORDER: DELIVER THE FINISHED STEEL BILLETS TO THE INDUSTRIAL CLIENT TO COMPLETE THE ORDER.

drill:step:4.zh: 训练任务：前往工业炉台，将处理好的金属炉料熔炼成钢坯。
drill:step:4.en: TRAINING ORDER: HEAD TO THE INDUSTRIAL FURNACE AND SMELT THE PREPARED METAL FEED INTO STEEL BILLETS.

drill:step:5.zh: 训练任务：前往材料化验台，检测炉料成分并确认材料等级。
drill:step:5.en: TRAINING ORDER: TAKE THE METAL FEED TO THE ASSAY STATION TO ANALYZE ITS COMPOSITION AND DETERMINE ITS GRADE.

drill:step:6.zh: 训练任务：前往材料分选台，选择「整线加工」，将这批金属送入分选线处理。
drill:step:6.en: TRAINING ORDER: GO TO THE SORTING STATION AND SELECT \"PROCESS FULL BATCH\" TO RUN THE METAL THROUGH THE SORTING LINE.

drill:step:7.zh: 训练任务：前往材料分选台，将提供的 1 吨混合废金属完成分选。
drill:step:7.en: TRAINING ORDER: GO TO THE SORTING STATION AND SORT THE 1 TONNE OF MIXED SCRAP METAL PROVIDED BY THE PORT AUTHORITY.

prologue:_fill:2.en: FOLLOW THE ARROW TO THE HULK · %d m TO GO

prologue:_fill:3.zh: 按 %s 操控无人机移动，按 %s 快速冲刺。沿着无人机旁的指引箭头前进。
prologue:_fill:3.en: %s to move, %s to dash. Follow the arrow by the drone.

prologue:_fill:4.zh: %s 移动，%s 冲刺。漂流船在画面外，无人机旁边的箭头指着它，到了它会被亮圈圈住。这一趟只是把它带回港。

prologue:_fill:6.zh: 太空里没有摩擦，松手也会一直漂。

prologue:_fill:7.zh: 太空里没有摩擦，松开方向键也会一直漂。%s 开飞行稳定会自动帮你减速。

prologue:_fill:8.zh: 按 1 切换至测量仪，使用鼠标左键扫描目标残骸。
prologue:_fill:8.en: PRESS 1 TO EQUIP THE SCANNER. LEFT-CLICK THE DERELICT TO INSPECT IT.

prologue:_fill:9.zh: 拆解前先检查目标状态，确认质量、材料类型、供电情况及内部压力。
prologue:_fill:9.en: INSPECT THE TARGET BEFORE DISMANTLING. CHECK ITS MASS, MATERIAL TYPE, ELECTRICAL STATUS, AND INTERNAL PRESSURE.

prologue:_fill:10.zh: 按 2 切换至激光切割器，准备切断桅杆底部的连接结构。
prologue:_fill:10.en: PRESS 2 TO EQUIP THE LASER CUTTER. CUT THROUGH THE MAST'S BASE CONNECTION.

prologue:_fill:11.zh: 按住鼠标左键，沿桅杆底部闪烁的切割线移动，直到连接完全切断。
prologue:_fill:11.en: HOLD LEFT MOUSE BUTTON AND MOVE ALONG THE FLASHING CUT LINE AT THE BASE OF THE MAST UNTIL THE CONNECTION IS SEVERED.

prologue:_fill:12.zh: 船尾有根撞弯的天线桅杆，底部焊在船体框架上，正好挡住了拖缆眼。按住鼠标左键，沿着闪烁的焊接处切开，把它拆下来。
prologue:_fill:12.en: A bent antenna mast is welded to the stern frame, blocking the tow eye. HOLD LEFT CLICK and cut along the flashing welds to detach it.

prologue:_fill:13.zh: 按 3 切换到磁力抓钩，把拆下来的桅杆移开。
prologue:_fill:13.en: PRESS 3 TO EQUIP THE MAGNETIC GRAPPLE. MOVE THE DETACHED MAST OUT OF THE WAY.

prologue:_fill:14.zh: 抓住桅杆，把它拖到距离拖缆眼至少 6 m 的位置，再松开。
prologue:_fill:14.en: GRAB THE MAST AND PULL IT AT LEAST 6 m AWAY FROM THE TOW EYE BEFORE RELEASING.

prologue:_fill:15.zh: 按住左键抓住桅杆，拖离拖缆眼 6 m 以上。松开前可以顺势甩一下，让它自己飘远。
prologue:_fill:15.en: HOLD LEFT CLICK TO GRAB THE MAST. PULL IT MORE THAN 6 m CLEAR OF THE TOW EYE. GIVE IT A FLICK BEFORE RELEASING TO SEND IT DRIFTING.

prologue:_fill:16.zh: 飞到拖缆眼，按 %s 挂缆

prologue:_fill:17.zh: 挂上缆，拖船把它拖回七号坞。
prologue:_fill:17.en: Hook on; the tug takes it home.

prologue:_fill:18.zh: 挂上缆，拖船把它拖回七号坞。到港以后它就是你的第一笔料。
prologue:_fill:18.en: Hook it on and the tug takes it home to Berth 07: your first material.

prologue:_stuck_line:1.zh: \n还没找到？跟着无人机旁边的箭头飞到亮圈那里。
prologue:_stuck_line:1.en: \nCAN'T FIND IT? FOLLOW THE ARROW BY THE DRONE TO THE LIT RING.

tutorial_hud:intro_lines:1.zh: 为什么现在上：你刚接的合同（%s）船上有这一类系统，按港务规定先取得「%s」资质才能开工。合同给你留着。

tutorial_hud:intro_lines:2.zh: 为什么现在上：你在训练页选了这门课。

tutorial_overview:_ready:3.zh: 先学飞行和拆船，再学处理危险，最后学用自己的材料生产、卖货。基础工具一直能用，不用买探针、透镜或电容。
tutorial_overview:_ready:3.en: Learn flight and salvage, then hazards, then production and trade with owned stock. Basic tools never need purchased tips, lenses or capacitors.

tutorial_overview:_ready:4.zh: 基础训练：飞行、拆解和回收

tutorial_overview:_ready:7.zh: 流体设备：压力、阀门和回收

tutorial_overview:_ready:8.zh: 特殊环境：富氧、烟气和余热

tutorial_overview:_ready:11.zh: 独立舱段：查清连接与电源

tutorial_overview:_ready:12.zh: 经营入门：买料、炼钢、卖货

tutorial_overview:_ready:13.zh: 考核：独立完成拆解任务

tutorial_overview:refresh:1.zh: 把前面学会的操作连起来用

tutorial_overview:refresh:2.zh: 进入考核后，先看清本次目标。先测量、查连接，再按现场情况断电、放电、排空、拆卸和搬运。不要只凭关机或一次旧读数判断安全。
tutorial_overview:refresh:2.en: Read the assessment objective. Inspect connections and measurements before isolating, discharging, draining, dismantling and hauling. Shutdown or an old reading alone does not prove safety.

tutorial_overview:refresh:3.zh: 考核使用配备好的基础工具，不用先买工具配件。查看这里不会替你完成任务；关掉总览后继续原来的进度。
tutorial_overview:refresh:3.en: Basic tools are supplied. Reading this overview does not complete objectives; close it to resume your existing progress.

txt:tool_locked.zh: 这一步还用不到这件工具

txt:coach_guard.zh: 光束停在绞车上：设备要整件保住，只切它的固定座
txt:coach_guard.en: THE BEAM STOPS AT THE WINCH: KEEP IT WHOLE, CUT ONLY ITS MOUNTS

first_receipt:_draw_card:2.zh: 完好 · 回收站现场收购，现金已到账
first_receipt:_draw_card:2.en: WHOLE · BOUGHT ON THE SPOT, CASH IN THE ACCOUNT

first_ship:guards:1.zh: 图纸开着：船壳里面的测试点、电闸、气口都看得见了
first_ship:guards:1.en: THE BLUEPRINT IS UP: WHAT IS INSIDE THE HULL SHOWS

first_ship:guards:2.zh: 读到了：48 V 带电、驾驶舱有一舱气——所以接下来先断电、再泄压
first_ship:guards:2.en: READ: 48 V LIVE AND A CABIN OF AIR — SO FIRST THE POWER, THEN THE AIR

first_ship:guards:3.zh: 电压归零：现在切割不会打火
first_ship:guards:3.en: ZERO VOLTS: CUTTING WILL NOT SPARK NOW

first_ship:guards:4.zh: 舱压到安全值：切开舱壁不会被气流冲开，抽回来的气也能卖钱
first_ship:guards:4.en: THE CABIN IS DOWN: NO BLAST WHEN THE WALL OPENS, AND THE AIR SELLS

first_ship:guards:5.zh: 绞车整件脱离、没伤到它：完整设备按设备价卖，比碎料值钱得多
first_ship:guards:5.en: THE WINCH IS OFF WHOLE AND UNHARMED: A MACHINE SELLS AS A MACHINE, FAR ABOVE SCRAP

first_ship:guards:6.zh: 抓住了：抓钩转不了货，它怎么躺着就按多宽选口
first_ship:guards:6.en: HELD: THE GRAPPLE CANNOT TURN IT — PICK THE MOUTH BY HOW WIDE IT LIES

first_ship:guards:7.zh: 设备口收下：按设备价结算（看飘字）
first_ship:guards:7.en: TAKEN BY THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH: PAID AS A MACHINE (SEE THE FIGURE)

first_ship:guards:8.zh: 碎料进熔炉：炼成钢锭进仓库，以后修船坞用得上
first_ship:guards:8.en: SCRAP IN THE FURNACE: INGOTS FOR THE WAREHOUSE, FOR MENDING THE YARD LATER

first_ship:target_name:5.zh: 熔炉口 · 推进长槽也行
first_ship:target_name:5.en: THE FURNACE · OR ONTO THE TROUGH

first_ship:_fill:1.zh: 第一艘船 · 第 %d 步 / 共 %d 步

first_ship:_fill:2.zh: 认识船坞 · %d / %d · 任意键跳过
first_ship:_fill:2.en: THE BERTH · %d OF %d · ANY KEY SKIPS

first_ship:_fill:3.zh: 设备回收口 · %.1f m 宽

first_ship:_fill:4.zh: 这次是真的拆：完整设备从下方送进这个口，按设备价卖。
first_ship:_fill:4.en: This time it pays: whole machines go in from below and sell as machines.

first_ship:_fill:5.zh:
序章只是把它带回来；这一次是真的拆：安全拆开它，把值钱的整件卖掉。
完整的设备从下方送进这个口，按设备价卖。比这个口宽的进不去。
first_ship:_fill:5.en:
The prologue only brought it home; this time it pays: take it apart safely and sell what is whole.
Whole machines go in from below here and sell as machines. Anything wider will not go in.

first_ship:_fill:7.zh: 切下来的船壳和碎料送这里，炼成钢锭进仓库。
first_ship:_fill:7.en: Hull and scrap go here and are cast into ingots for the warehouse.

first_ship:_fill:8.zh: 重载接收架 · %.1f m 宽

first_ship:_fill:9.zh: 设备口放不下的大设备送这里。
first_ship:_fill:9.en: Machines too wide for the equipment mouth go here.

first_ship:_fill:10.zh: 设备口放不下的大设备送这里，也按设备价卖。抓钩不能把货转过来，所以按它现在躺着的宽度选口。
first_ship:_fill:10.en: Machines too wide for the equipment mouth go here, still sold as machines. The grapple can't turn a load, so pick the mouth by how wide it lies.

first_ship:_fill:12.zh: 船里的测试点、电闸、气口、绞车都画在图纸上。
first_ship:_fill:12.en: The test point, switch, gas port and winch are all on the blueprint.

first_ship:_fill:13.zh: 船里的测试点、电闸、气口和绞车藏在船壳里面，从外面看不见。打开图纸，它们的位置和名字都画在上面；后面每一步要找的东西都在图纸上。图纸开着也能干活，再按一次关掉。
first_ship:_fill:13.en: The test point, the switch, the gas port and the winch are inside the hull. The blueprint shows where each is and what it is called; every step after this is found on it. You can work with it open; press again to close it.

first_ship:_fill:14.zh: 按 %s 拿测量仪，左键点亮圈处的测试点
first_ship:_fill:14.en: PRESS %s FOR THE METER, CLICK THE LIT TEST POINT

first_ship:_fill:15.zh: 动手前先读数：还带电，舱里还有气。
first_ship:_fill:15.en: Read before you touch: it is live and the cockpit holds air.

first_ship:_fill:16.zh: 动手之前先读数：这艘船还带着电（48 V 电池），驾驶舱里还有一舱气。
first_ship:_fill:16.en: Read it before you touch it: it still has power (a 48 V battery) and air in the cockpit.

first_ship:_fill:17.zh: 断电：按 %s 维护工具，左键点亮圈处的总电闸 K-T
first_ship:_fill:17.en: SWITCH IT OFF: PRESS %s FOR THE WRENCH, CLICK THE MAIN SWITCH K-T

first_ship:_fill:18.zh: 带电切割会打火。读数归零才算断开。
first_ship:_fill:18.en: Cutting live sparks. Off means the reading is zero.

first_ship:_fill:19.zh: 带电切割会打火。拉下总电闸，读数归零才算断开。
first_ship:_fill:19.en: Cutting live sparks. Pull the main switch; it counts once the reading is zero.

first_ship:_fill:20.zh: 泄压：按 %s 气液回收管，接到亮圈处的气口
first_ship:_fill:20.en: DEPRESSURIZE: PRESS %s FOR THE HOSE, PUT IT ON THE LIT PORT

first_ship:_fill:21.zh: 舱压降到 5 kPa 以下就安全（气也值钱）。
first_ship:_fill:21.en: Below 5 kPa it is safe (the air pays too).

first_ship:_fill:22.zh: 把驾驶舱的气抽回来（气也值钱）。舱压降到 5 kPa 以下就安全了。
first_ship:_fill:22.en: Pump the cockpit's air back (it is worth money). Below 5 kPa it is safe.

first_ship:_fill:23.zh: 按 %s 激光：切开绞车的固定座

first_ship:_fill:24.zh: 绞车上还连着一块船壳：按 %s 激光把它切下来
first_ship:_fill:24.en: A SLAB OF HULL IS STILL ON THE WINCH: PRESS %s AND CUT IT OFF

first_ship:_fill:25.zh: 设备口不收连着船壳的件：沿接缝切开。
first_ship:_fill:25.en: The mouth takes no machine with hull on it: cut along the seam.

first_ship:_fill:26.zh: 连着船壳的是混合件，设备回收口不收。沿着绞车和那块船壳相连的地方切开，绞车干净了才算这一步完成。
first_ship:_fill:26.en: Machine and hull together is a mixed load: the equipment mouth won't take it. Cut along where they join; the step is done once the winch is clean.

first_ship:_fill:27.zh: 按住左键沿固定座划过去，直到绞车松开。
first_ship:_fill:27.en: Hold the button and sweep along its mounts until it comes loose.

first_ship:_fill:28.zh: 亮圈里是拖缆绞车。按住左键沿着它和船体连接的固定座划过去，直到它整个松开。光束碰到绞车本身会停下：设备要整件保住。
first_ship:_fill:28.en: The lit thing is the tow winch. Hold the button and sweep along the mounts that hold it to the hull until it comes loose. The beam stops at the winch itself: it comes off whole.

first_ship:_fill:30.zh: 完整设备比碎料值钱得多。
first_ship:_fill:30.en: A whole machine is worth far more than scrap.

first_ship:_fill:31.zh: 完整的设备比碎料值钱得多，要整件取下来。
first_ship:_fill:31.en: A whole machine is worth far more than scrap: take it off in one piece.

first_ship:_fill:32.zh: 把绞车送进设备回收口
first_ship:_fill:32.en: PUT THE WINCH IN THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH

first_ship:_fill:33.zh: 拖到亮着的口下方，松开。
first_ship:_fill:33.en: Under the lit mouth, let go.

first_ship:_fill:34.zh: 亮着的就是它要去的口。拖到口下方松开，看飘出来的结算数字。完整设备送设备口；比设备口宽的送重载接收架；碎料进熔炉。
first_ship:_fill:34.en: The lit mouth is where it goes. Let it go under the mouth and watch the figure. Whole machines to the equipment mouth, anything wider to the heavy rack, scrap to the furnace.

first_ship:_fill:35.en: PUT A PIECE OF SCRAP IN THE FURNACE

first_ship:_fill:36.zh: 切一块船壳，抓到熔炉口松开。
first_ship:_fill:36.en: Cut off a piece of hull, let it go over the furnace.

first_ship:_fill:37.zh: 切一块船壳下来，抓到熔炉口松开。熔炉把碎料炼成钢锭，送进仓库。
first_ship:_fill:37.en: Cut off a piece of hull and let it go over the furnace. It casts the scrap into ingots for the warehouse.

first_ship:_fill:38.zh: 剩下的自己拆（顺序你定）

first_ship:_fill:39.zh: \n熔炉口在船坞右下（亮圈）。切下的船壳掉进长槽也会自己送进去。
first_ship:_fill:39.en: \nTHE FURNACE IS LOWER RIGHT (THE LIT RING). HULL THAT DROPS ONTO THE TROUGH GOES IN BY ITSELF.

first_ship:_fill:40.zh: 还没找到？跟着无人机旁边的箭头飞到亮圈那里。
first_ship:_fill:40.en: CAN'T FIND IT? FOLLOW THE ARROW BY THE DRONE TO THE LIT RING.

first_ship:rest_text:2.zh: 还带电：先拉总电闸 K-T（维护工具 4）
first_ship:rest_text:2.en: STILL LIVE: PULL MAIN SWITCH K-T (WRENCH 4)

first_ship:rest_text:4.zh: 还有压力：%s（气液回收 5 接气口）
first_ship:rest_text:4.en: STILL UNDER PRESSURE: %s (HOSE 5 ON ITS PORT)

first_ship:rest_text:5.zh: · 完整设备还剩 %d 件：切开固定座，整件送设备口（比口宽的送接收架）
first_ship:rest_text:5.en: · %d MACHINES LEFT: CUT THEIR MOUNTS, WHOLE TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH (WIDER: THE RACK)

first_ship:rest_text:6.zh: · 船壳和碎料还剩 %d 件：切小块送熔炉
first_ship:rest_text:6.en: · %d PIECES OF HULL AND SCRAP: CUT SMALL, TO THE FURNACE

first_ship:rest_text:9.zh: 先取完整设备（值钱），再切船壳
first_ship:rest_text:9.en: the machines first (they pay), then the hull

first_ship:rest_text:10.en: cut the hull small for the furnace

first_ship:rest_text:11.zh: 建议下一步：%s。按 Tab 看图纸上它连在哪里。
first_ship:rest_text:11.en: SUGGESTED NEXT: %s. TAB SHOWS WHAT IT IS FIXED TO.

onboard:lock_reason:1.en: FIND THE SECOND HULK FIRST: OPEN FIND SHIPS

onboard:lock_reason:2.zh: 先修船坞的照明：点“装备”里的“照明与配电”
onboard:lock_reason:2.en: MEND THE BERTH'S LIGHTS FIRST: EQUIPMENT › LIGHTING & POWER

onboard:step:1.zh: 找第二艘船：终端 → 找船 → 星图，扫最近的扇区（第一趟拖运免费）。
onboard:step:1.en: Find the second hulk: terminal › Find ships › star map, sweep the nearest sector (first tow free).

onboard:step:2.zh: 船坞的照明坏了：暗处看不清读数，切割也慢。
onboard:step:2.en: The berth's lights are out: readings are hard to see in the dark and cutting is slow.

onboard:step:3.zh: 趁拖船在路上修好它：终端 → 船坞 → 照明与配电。
onboard:step:3.en: While the tug is out, mend them: terminal › Berth › Lighting & power.

onboard:step:4.en: To mend them you still need: %s.

onboarding:顶层:1.zh: 终端里多了“装备”：七号坞有 16 处坏了，用拆船拆回来的零件或者钱来修。
onboarding:顶层:1.en: The terminal now has EQUIPMENT: sixteen things in Berth 07 are broken; mend them with salvaged parts or money.

onboarding:顶层:2.zh: 账本开放：缺钱可以借，结算时自动扣分期
onboarding:顶层:2.en: THE LEDGER OPENS: BORROW WHEN SHORT, INSTALMENTS TAKEN AT SETTLEMENT

onboarding:顶层:3.zh: 终端顶上多了“声望”：船拆得越多越好，别人越信你，才肯把更大更难的船交给你。
onboarding:顶层:3.en: REPUTATION now shows at the top: the more ships you strip well, the bigger the jobs people trust you with.

onboarding:顶层:4.zh: 交易行开了：仓库里的东西可以拿去卖；“成长与建设”里可以修港区的其他地方。
onboarding:顶层:4.en: The exchange is open: sell what is in the warehouse. Growth and Construction mends the rest of the port.

onboarding:顶层:5.zh: 训练舱开了：遇到不熟的船，可以先来这里练一下，不练也能接。
onboarding:顶层:5.en: The training bay is open: practise on a ship type you don't know yet, or skip it.

onboarding:顶层:8.zh: 无线电开放：回看终端发过的消息
onboarding:顶层:8.en: THE RADIO LOG OPENS: THE TERMINAL'S MESSAGES

op_cards:顶层:5.zh: WASD 移动无人机。太空里没有摩擦，松开方向键也会一直漂。
op_cards:顶层:5.en: WASD moves the drone. Nothing slows you in space: it drifts on when you let go.

op_cards:顶层:6.zh: 按住冲刺，推力更大，也更费电。
op_cards:顶层:6.en: Hold to dash: more thrust, more power.

op_cards:顶层:7.zh: 反推刹停：按住直到停下。
op_cards:顶层:7.en: Fire against the drift until you stop.

op_cards:顶层:8.zh: 飞行稳定：开着时松开方向键会自动减速。
op_cards:顶层:8.en: Flight assist: when on, letting go slows you down by itself.

op_cards:顶层:9.zh: 按住锁定在原地，切割、对接时手不抖。
op_cards:顶层:9.en: Hold to stay put while cutting or docking.

op_cards:顶层:10.en: Hold to pull back and see the whole ship.

op_cards:顶层:11.zh: 按住让时间走快，等抽气、等施工时用。
op_cards:顶层:11.en: Hold to speed time up while pumping or waiting for the crew.

op_cards:顶层:12.zh: 测量仪：左键点零件或测试点，读质量、材质、电压和压力。动手前先读数。
op_cards:顶层:12.en: Meter: click a piece or a test point for its mass, material, voltage and pressure. Read before you touch.

op_cards:顶层:13.zh: 激光切割：按住左键沿着要切的地方划过去；固定件切开，零件就松了。
op_cards:顶层:13.en: Laser: hold the button and sweep along the cut; cut the fixings and the piece comes loose.

op_cards:顶层:14.zh: 磁力抓钩：左键抓住松开的零件拖着走，松开放下，甩一下能扔出去。
op_cards:顶层:14.en: Grapple: grab a loose piece and tow it; let go to drop it, flick to throw it.

op_cards:顶层:15.zh: 维护工具：拧螺栓、开关阀门和电闸、开舱门；指着它们时自动换上。
op_cards:顶层:15.en: Wrench: bolts, valves, switches and hatches. It comes to hand by itself when you point at one.

op_cards:顶层:16.zh: 气液回收：左键把软管接到气口或液口，把气体和液体抽回来，也能卖钱。
op_cards:顶层:16.en: Hose: put it on a gas or fluid port and pump it back; that sells too.

op_cards:顶层:17.zh: 部署：把带来的设备（支架、吊臂等）放到船上用。
op_cards:顶层:17.en: Deploy: set the gear you brought (stands, arms) on the ship.

op_cards:顶层:18.zh: 维修包：补无人机的损伤。
op_cards:顶层:18.en: Repair kit: mend the drone's damage.

op_cards:顶层:19.zh: 爆破切割环：贴在厚件上一次切开，要先清空周围。
op_cards:顶层:19.en: Breaching ring: fixed on a thick piece, it cuts through at once; clear the area first.

op_cards:顶层:20.zh: 图纸：看整船的结构、设备和管线在哪。
op_cards:顶层:20.en: Drawing: the ship's structure, machines and lines.

op_cards:顶层:21.zh: 合同：这一单要拆什么、回收率目标和时间。
op_cards:顶层:21.en: Contract: what this job wants, the recovery targets and the time.

op_cards:顶层:22.zh: 互动：用船坞电脑、上车、操作身边的面板。
op_cards:顶层:22.en: Use: berth computers, vehicles, the panel next to you.

op_cards:顶层:23.zh: 把回收口移到无人机下方，近一点好送件。
op_cards:顶层:23.en: Moves the mouth under the drone, so pieces have less way to go.

op_cards:顶层:24.zh: 右键标记零件，让搬运无人机去搬。
op_cards:顶层:24.en: Right-click marks a piece for the hauler drone.

op_cards:顶层:25.zh: 划一块禁入区，船坞机器不进去。
op_cards:顶层:25.en: Draws a keep-out zone the berth's machines stay out of.

op_cards:顶层:26.zh: 停下 / 恢复船坞机器。

op_cards:顶层:27.zh: 在船坞里切换零压港全景。
op_cards:顶层:27.en: At the berth, toggles the whole port's view.

op_cards:顶层:28.zh: 终端：找船、修港区、交易、看下一步。
op_cards:顶层:28.en: Terminal: find ships, mend the port, trade, see the next step.

op_cards:顶层:29.zh: 星图：扫描小行星带找船，看拖船和货船在哪。
op_cards:顶层:29.en: Star map: sweep the belt for hulks, see the tugs and freighters.

op_cards:顶层:30.zh: 在作业艇上：靠近漂浮舱段的拖眼挂上拖缆，拖到船坞外的交付区再摘缆。
op_cards:顶层:30.en: Aboard the work boat: hitch the line to a drifting section's tow eye, tow it to the delivery box off the berth, cast off.

op_cards:顶层:31.zh: 抓钩在单体和范围模式间切换：范围模式一次抓起圈内多件散料。Shift+X 开关防护。
op_cards:顶层:31.en: Switches the grapple between one piece and its field: the field catches several loose pieces at once. Shift+X toggles its guard.

op_cards:顶层:32.zh: 图鉴：见过的设备、危险和做法。
op_cards:顶层:32.en: Codex: the machines, hazards and methods you have met.

op_cards:顶层:33.zh: 无线电记录：之前说过的话。

op_cards:顶层:34.en: Turns the on-screen hints on or off.

port_tour:_stage_line:1.zh: 第 %d 期 / 共 2 期

port_tour:_how_line:2.zh: 修复单在终端“成长与建设”里下；施工队修，要等施工完才生效。
port_tour:_how_line:2.en: Order it in the terminal under Growth & Build; the crew builds it, it works once built.

port_tour:_how_line:4.zh: 材料和钱都够，可以下单。

port_tour:rows:2.zh: 一座废弃的太空港，围着中央转运环有六个区。你接手的是拆船区的七号船坞，其它区现在大多停着。
port_tour:rows:2.en: An abandoned port: six districts round the central ring. You have Berth 07 in the salvage district; most of the rest stands idle.

port_tour:rows:3.zh: 整个游戏就是一个循环：拆船赚钱 → 用钱和材料修港 → 各区修好以后拆得更快、卖得更贵、能接更大的船 → 最后让中央转运环重新转起来。
port_tour:rows:3.en: The whole game is one loop: strip ships for money → mend the port with money and materials → mended districts strip faster, sell dearer, take bigger ships → at last the central ring turns again.

port_tour:rows:4.zh: 你刚拆完第一艘船。接下来逐个看每个区是干什么的。
port_tour:rows:4.en: You have stripped your first ship. Now each district, one by one.

port_tour:rows:6.zh: 拆船的地方。拖回来的船推进七号船坞，你在这里断电、泄压、切割、抓取。
port_tour:rows:6.en: Where ships are taken apart. A hulk is pushed into Berth 07; here you isolate, vent, cut and grab.

port_tour:rows:7.zh: 钱几乎都从这里来：完整设备送设备回收口按设备价卖，太宽的送重载接收架，碎料进熔炉炼成钢锭（修港和加工都要用）。
port_tour:rows:7.en: Nearly all your money starts here: whole machines through the equipment mouth sell as machines, wide ones go to the heavy rack, scrap goes to the furnace as ingots (the port and the works need them).

port_tour:rows:8.zh: 。船坞里的照明、熔炉主火、碎屑网等设施坏着，要一项项修。
port_tour:rows:8.en: . The berth's lights, the furnace's main fire, the debris net and more are broken: mend them one by one.

port_tour:rows:9.zh: 全港的电从这里来。电网按顺序把电分给各区，电不够时后面的区分到的少。
port_tour:rows:9.en: The whole port's power. The grid shares it out district by district; when it runs short the last in line get less.

port_tour:rows:10.zh: 拆船时激光、传送带、熔炉都吃电。屏幕上“电不够：船坞只分到 … MW”就是它在提醒你——电越足，切得越快、熔炉越快。
port_tour:rows:10.en: Cutting, the conveyors and the furnace all draw power. The \"short of power\" line is this district talking: more power, faster cutting and melting.

port_tour:rows:11.zh: 拖船从这里出发去小行星带，把你在星图上找到的废船拖回来；拖回来的船先停在这里的泊位上。
port_tour:rows:11.en: The tugs leave from here for the belt and bring home the hulks you find on the star map; they wait at its berths.

port_tour:rows:12.zh: 泊位数决定能同时停几艘等着拆的船；拖船站越好，能拖的船越长（44 m → 88 m → 不限）。有了自家拖船，拖运费减半。
port_tour:rows:12.en: Its berths say how many hulks can wait; the better it is, the longer the ships it can tow (44 m → 88 m → any). Your own tugs halve the tow.

port_tour:rows:13.zh: 港里的仓库：一排排货架，叉车搬货。钢锭、零件、你卖出的货都从这里进出。
port_tour:rows:13.en: The port's warehouse: racks and forklifts. Ingots, parts and what you sell all pass through here.

port_tour:rows:14.zh: 卖出去的货要叉车从这里出库发运；熔炉取料也从这里拿。仓库越顺，钱到得越快。
port_tour:rows:14.en: Sold goods leave from here by forklift; the furnace draws its feed from here. The smoother it runs, the sooner you are paid.

port_tour:rows:15.zh: 港里做买卖的地方：交易行（终端里按 F8）、上门的客人、公司的长期合同。
port_tour:rows:15.en: Where the port does business: the exchange (F8 in the terminal), visiting buyers, company contracts.

port_tour:rows:16.zh: 钢坯、材料、零件在这里卖；修港缺的零件在这里买。贸易港修好以后，完整设备卖得更贵，二手船市也在这里开。
port_tour:rows:16.en: Billets, materials and parts are sold here; parts you lack for repairs are bought here. Mended, it pays more for whole machines and opens the hulk market.

port_tour:rows:17.zh: 把拆下来的东西再加工的地方：炉台把钢锭炼成钢坯，轧机轧成钢板和型材，分选台、化验台分开混在一起的金属；还有气体线，把回收的气分离成液氧。
port_tour:rows:17.en: Where what you strip is worked again: the furnace desk makes billets, the mill rolls plate and sections, sorting and assay desks part mixed metal; the gas line separates recovered gas into liquid oxygen.

port_tour:rows:18.zh: 加工过的东西比原料值钱得多：钢坯卖给工业公司，钢板和型材还能用来修港。
port_tour:rows:18.en: Worked goods pay far better than raw: billets sell to the firms, plate and sections also mend the port.

port_tour:rows:20.zh: 港的中心：一圈连着所有区的环，走廊和接驳车从这里通到各区。
port_tour:rows:20.en: The heart of the port: a ring joining every district; the corridors and the shuttle run from here.

port_tour:rows:21.zh: 它重新转起来，是整个游戏最后的目标——那时才能接远航者那样的巨舰。要先修好动力区和拖船站。
port_tour:rows:21.en: Getting it turning again is the game's last goal — only then can giants like the Ark come in. The power district and the tug station come first.

txt:hint_ta_turning.zh: 环还在转（或没锁死），转运气闸联锁着。先在环毂里消旋、锁轴承。
txt:hint_ta_turning.en: The ring is still turning (or not locked), so its transfer airlock is interlocked. Despin it in the hub and lock the bearing first.

txt:hint_leak_lng.zh: 低温货没排空就切开了。先用货泵接口抽液，再抽蒸发气，罐子空了再拆。
txt:hint_leak_lng.en: Cut while there was cargo in it. Draw the liquid off through the cargo port, then the vapour, and open it only once it is empty.

txt:hint_mat_armor.zh: 军规装甲钢：普通激光要慢三到四倍。升级切割功率对它提速最明显；能拆螺栓就整块卸下
txt:hint_mat_armor.en: MILITARY ARMOUR: THREE TO FOUR TIMES SLOWER FOR A PLAIN LASER. MORE CUTTING POWER HELPS IT MOST; UNBOLT IT WHOLE WHERE YOU CAN

txt:hint_mat_ti.zh: 钛合金：每切一米熔掉一点价值，切缝很久才冷。整件卸下最值钱
txt:hint_mat_ti.en: TITANIUM: EVERY METRE OF KERF MELTS SOME VALUE AWAY AND STAYS HOT. WHOLE PARTS FETCH THE MOST

txt:hint_mat_ceramic.zh: 陶瓷复合装甲：连续切会受热开裂、掉价。切一小段停几秒让它散热，或者整块卸下
txt:hint_mat_ceramic.en: CERAMIC ARMOUR: CUT ON AND IT CRACKS FROM THE HEAT AND LOSES VALUE. CUT A LITTLE, LET IT COOL A FEW SECONDS, OR TAKE IT OFF WHOLE

txt:hint_mat_shield.zh: 隔热反射层：反光、不吸热，切得慢；这层不值钱，先剥掉再切里面
txt:hint_mat_shield.en: HEAT-SHIELD LAYER: IT REFLECTS AND SHRUGS OFF HEAT, SO IT CUTS SLOWLY; IT IS WORTH LITTLE, STRIP IT FIRST

txt:hint_mat_al.zh: 铝合金：反光、散热快，火花少熔渣多，比钢略慢；回收价比钢高
txt:hint_mat_al.en: ALUMINIUM: REFLECTIVE AND QUICK TO SHED HEAT, FEW SPARKS AND MUCH DROSS, A LITTLE SLOWER THAN STEEL; IT FETCHES MORE THAN STEEL

txt:hint_mat_composite.zh: 碳纤维复合材料：切得快但冒烟，回收价低
txt:hint_mat_composite.en: CARBON COMPOSITE: CUTS FAST BUT SMOKES, AND FETCHES LITTLE

txt:hint_degauss_live.zh: 退磁之前要先断掉牵引线圈的供电（供电柜读数归零）。
txt:hint_degauss_live.en: Kill the tow coils' supply first (the supply cabinet must read zero), then degauss.

txt:hint_equip_rail.zh: 设备口挂在天花板导轨上：按 %s 让它移到你头顶。
txt:hint_equip_rail.en: The equipment bay runs on a ceiling rail: press %s to bring it overhead.

txt:hint_start.zh: 先别急着切。用 1 测量工具点外壳上的测压口和测点，看看这艘船现在的真实状态。
txt:hint_start.en: Don't cut yet. Take tool 1 to the ports and test points on the hull — find out what this ship is really like now.

txt:hint_dead_leg.zh: 读数来自测压口实际连通的那一段。按 Tab 看图纸：测压口和舱室之间可能还隔着阀门。
txt:hint_dead_leg.en: A gauge reads whatever its port is connected to. Press Tab: there may be a valve between the port and the room.

txt:hint_dead_leg_hose.zh: 阀门关着，软管只能抽到阀门外侧那一小段空管。
txt:hint_dead_leg_hose.en: With the valve shut the hose only reaches the empty stub outside it.

txt:hint_not_off.zh: 控制台显示的是指令，不是实测：母线仍然有电。
txt:hint_not_off.en: The panel shows what was commanded, not what is true: the bus is still live.

txt:hint_remote.zh: 指令已发出。它真的停了吗？用测量工具去测试点验证。
txt:hint_remote.en: Command sent. Did it actually stop? Verify at a test point.

txt:hint_measured.zh: 读数会标出仪器、测点和时间；系统一变化，旧读数就会变灰过期。
txt:hint_measured.en: Readings carry instrument, point and time; when the system changes they turn grey and stale.

txt:hint_equip_cut.zh: 激光靠近设备时会闪红光。切进去设备就成了废料——想完整回收，用 4 维护工具拆它的固定件。
txt:hint_equip_cut.en: The beam flashes red near equipment. Cutting into it turns it to scrap — use tool 4 on its fixings to take it out whole.

txt:hint_arc.zh: 带电部件一碰就是电弧。断开电源、放掉电容，再用电气检测仪确认 0 V。
txt:hint_arc.en: Live parts arc. Isolate the sources, bleed the capacitor, then confirm 0 V with the tester.

txt:hint_burst.zh: 储气罐和舱室是两回事：舱室抽空了，罐子里可能还有压力。
txt:hint_burst.en: A bottle is not its room: the room can be empty while the bottle is still full.

txt:hint_leak_fuel.zh: 推进剂泄漏会在附近形成危险区：别在里面用激光。
txt:hint_leak_fuel.en: Leaking propellant makes a hazard cloud — keep the laser out of it.

txt:hint_leak_coolant.zh: 冷却液会污染附近设备。先关两侧阀门、抽空、等温度降下来再拆。
txt:hint_leak_coolant.en: Coolant fouls nearby equipment. Close the valves, drain it and let it cool before you open the line.

txt:hint_fire.zh: 推进剂起火了。泄漏的地方离激光远一点。
txt:hint_fire.en: The propellant caught fire. Keep the laser away from leaks.

txt:hint_fixings.zh: 还连着东西。用 1 检查它有几个固定件，用 4 拆掉或用 2 切断。
txt:hint_fixings.en: Something still holds it. Inspect it with 1, then undo the fixings with 4 or cut them with 2.

txt:hint_heavy.zh: 抓钩最多 3 t。切小一点，或者先拆下附属件。
txt:hint_heavy.en: The grapple tops out at 3 t. Cut it smaller or take parts off first.

txt:hint_torn.zh: 硬扯会扯断锁扣和线缆，设备也跟着受损。下次先用 4 解开。
txt:hint_torn.en: Tearing breaks locks and lines and hurts the equipment. Undo them with 4 first.

txt:hint_pipe_full.zh: 管里还有流体。先关阀、用 5 抽空。
txt:hint_pipe_full.en: Still full. Close the valves and drain it with tool 5.

txt:hint_pipe_hot.zh: 冷却回路很烫——发电机还在运转时它不会凉下来。
txt:hint_pipe_hot.en: The coolant loop is hot — it won't cool while the generator keeps running.

txt:hint_no_power.zh: 舱门电机没电。看看船坞有没有外接辅助电源的插座。
txt:hint_no_power.en: No power for the door motors. Look for a dock aux power socket.

txt:hint_hatch_jam.zh: 舱门变形卡住了，先用 4 解除卡滞。
txt:hint_hatch_jam.en: The hatch is bent and jammed — clear the jam with tool 4 first.

txt:hint_hose.zh: 软管在后台抽，不用守着。按 5 可以切换回收 / 排放。
txt:hint_hose.en: The hose works in the background. Press 5 again to switch recover / vent.

txt:hint_blowout.zh: 带压舱室被切开会爆发性失压：货物被推撞，气体收益也没了。
txt:hint_blowout.en: Cutting into a pressurised room blows it out: cargo gets thrown and the gas is lost.

txt:hint_discharge_refused.zh: 发电机或蓄电池还在给母线供电，先断开它们的开关。
txt:hint_discharge_refused.en: A generator or battery still feeds the bus — open their switches first.

txt:hint_free_body.zh: 零件脱离了。用 3 抓住它，拖或甩进对应的回收口。
txt:hint_free_body.en: It's free. Grab it with 3 and haul or fling it into the right mouth.

txt:hint_impact.zh: 撞击会让设备折价。慢一点，或者用 Space 刹停。
txt:hint_impact.en: Impacts cost value. Slow down — Space brakes.

txt:hint_field.zh: 泊位上方和右侧是开放的。边缘有牵引场，会把漂出去的东西（包括你）轻轻拉回来。
txt:hint_field.en: The berth is open above and to the right. A tractor field at the edge eases anything drifting out — you included — back in.

txt:hint_drone_lost.zh: R-02 损毁，新机已弹射。回到左侧机库可以免费修复。
txt:hint_drone_lost.en: R-02 lost; a new one is on its way. The bay on the left repairs for free.

gear:hint_gear_anchor_set.zh: 锚已打上。把这一段切离，绞盘就会把整段拉进熔炉槽——不用切碎。整段进炉后锚留在绞盘处，记得捡。
gear:hint_gear_anchor_set.en: Anchor set. Cut this section free and the winch hauls the whole of it into the scrap trough — no need to cut it up. The anchor stays at the post afterwards: fetch it.

gear:hint_gear_anchor_not_scrap.zh: 传送带不收带完整设备或危险品的整段。先把设备拆下来，或把危险品排空。
gear:hint_gear_anchor_not_scrap.en: The belt won't take a section with whole equipment or a hazard on it. Take the equipment off first, or drain the hazard.

gear:hint_gear_pump_set.zh: 泵在自己抽，不用守着。零件进回收口前记得把泵收回。
gear:hint_gear_pump_set.en: The pump works by itself. Take it back before the piece goes down a mouth.

gear:hint_gear_prop_set.zh: 撑杆已顶住：这一列和外侧各列的重量都压在撑杆上，里侧的列可以先卸了。旁边的读数是它扛着多少吨，过了 60 t 会弯、会断。
gear:hint_gear_prop_set.en: Prop set: this bay and the bays outboard bear on it now, so the bays inboard can come off first. The figure by it is the tonnes it carries: past 60 t it bows, then buckles.

gear:hint_gear_probe_set.zh: 探头留在这里，读数会一直更新，有变化会在无线电里报。
gear:hint_gear_probe_set.en: The probe stays here: its reading keeps updating, and a change is called out on the radio.

gear:hint_gear_dropped.zh: 掉落的装备在事故位置漂着。用抓钩或部署工具点一下捡回。
gear:hint_gear_dropped.en: Dropped gear is drifting at the crash site. Pick it up with the grapple or the deploy tool.

gear:hint_rp_part_in.zh: 完整送进设备口的供电、热工、驱动控制类设备进了零件仓库，用来修船坞；不想留可以在终端出售。
gear:hint_rp_part_in.en: Power, thermal and drive equipment delivered whole goes onto the parts shelf for the berth's repairs; sell it at the terminal if you would rather have the money.

gear:hint_rp_net.zh: 碎屑网破了，碎块会漏掉。在终端的船坞修缮里修它。
gear:hint_rp_net.en: The debris net is torn and cut-offs slip through. Repair it under Berth Repairs at the terminal.

gear:hint_cs_out.zh: %s用完了。终端里能买新的，回机库才装上。
gear:hint_cs_out.en: The %s is worn out. Buy one at the terminal; it is fitted back at the bay.

gear:hint_cs_cheap.zh: 先锋型的精度与稳定性有限。高风险作业建议选用重装型或泰坦型。
gear:hint_cs_cheap.en: Vanguard parts have limited precision and reliability. Choose Bastion or Titan for high-risk work.

gear:hint_g4_anchor_locked.zh: 钢索长度已锁止。绷紧时产生张力，松弛时不施力；抓钩可接管，回收牵引锚可解除。
gear:hint_g4_anchor_locked.en: CABLE LENGTH LOCKED. TENSION ONLY WHEN TAUT; SLACK CABLE EXERTS NO FORCE. GRAPPLE TO TAKE OVER, OR RETRIEVE THE ANCHOR TO RELEASE IT.

txt:day_over.zh: 第 %s 天收工：全船状态已保存，运营费按天计
txt:day_over.en: DAY %s DONE: THE WHOLE SHIP'S STATE IS SAVED; RUNNING COSTS ARE BY THE DAY

txt:wd_day.zh: 第 %d 天 / 计划 %d 天 · 今日剩 %s

txt:vent_jammed.zh: 排气阀卡死了，接不上：先从外面把阀拧开
txt:vent_jammed.en: THE VENT VALVE IS JAMMED: FREE IT FROM OUTSIDE FIRST

txt:j_armor_fix.zh: 装甲板 · 板后有 %d 个固定件

txt:j_segments.zh: %d 条分段线（沿线切开保留设备价值）
txt:j_segments.en: %d MARKED CUT LINES (CUT ALONG THEM AND IT STAYS EQUIPMENT)

txt:j_life.zh: 剩余寿命约 %d 年（修缮能用）

txt:j_life_out.zh: 寿命已到：修缮用不上，只能卖
txt:j_life_out.en: WORN OUT: NO USE FOR REPAIRS, SELL IT

txt:laser_near.zh: 前面是 %s · 切进去就成了废料
txt:laser_near.en: %s AHEAD · CUT INTO IT AND IT'S SCRAP

txt:too_heavy.zh: %s t · 超过 3 t 上限

txt:discharge_refused.zh: 母线仍有电源 · 放电装置跳开

txt:seg_cut.zh: %s 沿分段线切开：每段都还是完整设备
txt:seg_cut.en: %s CUT ALONG ITS MARKED LINE: EACH PART STILL WHOLE

txt:tow_too_heavy.zh: %s 吨，超过作业艇的拖带能力（60 吨）
txt:tow_too_heavy.en: %s t: MORE THAN THE BOAT CAN TOW (60 t)

txt:tow_too_far.zh: 靠近一点：船尾要到它的拖眼 6 米以内
txt:tow_too_far.en: CLOSER: THE STERN WITHIN 6 m OF ITS TOW EYE

txt:tow_too_fast.zh: 太快了：相对速度降到每秒 1.5 米以下再挂缆
txt:tow_too_fast.en: TOO FAST: UNDER 1.5 m/s RELATIVE TO HITCH

txt:tow_on.zh: 拖缆挂上（%s 吨）。慢慢拉紧，猛拉会断
txt:tow_on.en: LINE ON (%s t). TAKE UP THE SLACK GENTLY: A JERK PARTS IT

txt:tow_parted.en: THE LINE PARTED: PULLED TOO HARD

txt:tow_done.zh: 舱段交付：清障费 %s，钢材入库
txt:tow_done.en: SECTION DELIVERED: FEE %s, ITS STEEL ON THE BOOKS

txt:furl_overload.zh: %s 角还绷着就收卷：帆膜过载撕裂，收卷电机跳闸。先松绞车刹车
txt:furl_overload.en: %s CORNER FURLED WHILE TAUT: THE FILM OVERLOADED AND TORE, THE MOTOR TRIPPED. LET THE WINCH BRAKE OFF FIRST

txt:furl_done.zh: 光帆卷收好：%s。拆下螺栓送设备回收口
txt:furl_done.en: SAIL ROLL WOUND: %s. UNBOLT IT AND TAKE IT TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH

txt:mg_on.zh: 抓钩：范围模式 · 半径 %s m · 最多 %s 件
txt:mg_on.en: GRAPPLE: FIELD MODE · %s m RADIUS · UP TO %s PIECES

txt:mg_pick_steel.zh: 范围抓钩：只抓钢（不碰整件设备）· 再按 X 只抓设备
txt:mg_pick_steel.en: FIELD: STEEL ONLY (NO WHOLE MACHINES) · X FOR MACHINES ONLY

txt:mg_pick_equip.zh: 范围抓钩：只抓整件设备 · 再按 X 关掉
txt:mg_pick_equip.en: FIELD: WHOLE MACHINES ONLY · X TURNS IT OFF

txt:mg_unfitted.zh: 还没装范围抓取：终端「技能」里升级「范围抓取」
txt:mg_unfitted.en: NO FIELD GRAPPLE FITTED: UPGRADE «FIELD GRAPPLE» IN THE TERMINAL'S SKILLS

txt:mg_guard_on.zh: 范围抓取防护：开（不抓精密件、危险件、核心资产）
txt:mg_guard_on.en: FIELD GUARD ON (KEEPS OFF PRECISION KIT, HAZARDS, CORE ASSETS)

txt:mg_guard_off.zh: 范围抓取防护：关（会连精密件、危险件一起抓，小心碰撞）
txt:mg_guard_off.en: FIELD GUARD OFF (TAKES PRECISION KIT AND HAZARDS TOO: MIND THE KNOCKS)

txt:mg_none.zh: 范围内没有能抓的散料（固定件要先切开）
txt:mg_none.en: NOTHING LOOSE TO CATCH IN THE FIELD (CUT FIXED PARTS FREE FIRST)

txt:mg_over.en: OVERLOAD: THE PULL IS SPREAD THIN

txt:mg_alert.zh: 强制回收件 %s %s — 本单评级只能是「未达标」
txt:mg_alert.en: REQUIRED PIECE %s %s — THIS CONTRACT CANNOT PASS

txt:ore_jam.zh: %s 卡住了：几块矿石在出口上方挤成一拱。用抓钩拽出一块就通
txt:ore_jam.en: %s IS JAMMED: CHUNKS HAVE WEDGED INTO AN ARCH OVER IT. PULL ONE OUT WITH THE GRAPPLE TO CLEAR IT

txt:mat_crack.zh: %s 受热太快开裂：崩掉一块，这块料掉价了
txt:mat_crack.en: %s CRACKED FROM THE HEAT: A PIECE SPALLED OFF, IT IS WORTH LESS

txt:bio_spill.zh: %s 漏了 · 生物污染进了舱内空气

txt:bio_contam.zh: 生物污染：%s 要洗消，折价 25%%

txt:degauss_live.zh: 线圈供电还在 · 先断电再退磁

txt:no_power.zh: 没有电 · 接入船坞辅助电源

txt:hatch_welded.zh: 舱门驱动卡死：门缝焊死了
txt:hatch_welded.en: HATCH DRIVE STALLED: THE SEAMS ARE WELDED

txt:item_spare.zh: 备用无人机顶上，不扣费

txt:it_repair_d.zh: 现场为无人机恢复 50 耐久

txt:it_ring_d.zh: 贴在厚龙骨上，瞬间切开一圈
txt:it_ring_d.en: CLAMPS ON A THICK KEEL AND CUTS RIGHT THROUGH

txt:it_spare_d.zh: 无人机损毁时免费重生
txt:it_spare_d.en: A LOST DRONE IS REPLACED FREE

txt:it_intel_d.zh: 接单前揭示一项隐藏状态的真实数据
txt:it_intel_d.en: REVEALS ONE HIDDEN CONDITION BEFORE YOU SIGN

txt:snapped.en: THE STRUCTURE SNAPPED AT A CRACK

txt:door_stuck.en: %s IS BENT AND STUCK: THE DRIVE WILL NOT OPEN IT

txt:ship.zh: GR-7「灰鹭号」中型货运船 · 42 m
txt:ship.en: GR-7 GREY HERON · MEDIUM FREIGHTER · 42 m

txt:blueprint.zh: 出厂图纸 · 仅代表原始设计

txt:c_title.zh: 拆解合同 GR-001 · 未开工

txt:c_req2.zh: 强制回收：黑匣子 BB-01、主电源模块 G-01（完整送设备回收）
txt:c_req2.en: MUST RECOVER: BB-01 RECORDER, G-01 POWER MODULE (WHOLE, TO EQUIPMENT BAY)

txt:c_req3.zh: 回收至少 70% 可回收价值（总值 $120,000）

txt:c_log.zh: 最后一次船载记录 · 退役前 17 小时 · 未验证
txt:c_log.en: LAST ONBOARD LOG · 17 h BEFORE RETIREMENT · UNVERIFIED

txt:c_brief.zh: 事故简报：推进系统维护期间尾部设备事故，船员已撤离。现场未完成危险能源隔离检查，所有历史安全状态须重新验证。
txt:c_brief.en: INCIDENT: AFT EQUIPMENT ACCIDENT DURING PROPULSION MAINTENANCE. CREW EVACUATED. HAZARDOUS ENERGY ISOLATION WAS NEVER VERIFIED — RE-CHECK EVERYTHING.

txt:c_drawing.zh: 出厂工程图：按 Tab 随时查看（只代表原始设计）
txt:c_drawing.en: FACTORY DRAWING: PRESS TAB ANY TIME (ORIGINAL DESIGN ONLY)

txt:c_fee.zh: 无主漂流船 · 你的拖船拖回 · 不收费 · 无时限
txt:c_fee.en: UNOWNED HULK · TOWED IN BY YOUR TUG · NO FEE · NO TIME LIMIT

txt:c_req2_n.zh: 强制回收：%s（完整送设备回收）

txt:c_req3_n.zh: 回收至少 70%% 可回收价值（预估 %s）
txt:c_req3_n.en: RECOVER AT LEAST 70%% OF AN ESTIMATED %s

txt:mouth_moving_equip.zh: 设备口沿导轨移到头顶

txt:mouth_moving_both.zh: 设备口和炉口沿导轨移过来
txt:mouth_moving_both.en: EQUIPMENT BAY AND FURNACE COMING OVER

txt:hauler_marked.zh: 已标记，搬运无人机会来取

txt:hauler_heavy.zh: 超过 1.5 t，搬运无人机搬不动
txt:hauler_heavy.en: OVER 1.5 t: TOO HEAVY FOR THE HAULER

txt:hauler_no_mouth.zh: 这件设备怎么转都进不了任何设备口 · 先切开再搬
txt:hauler_no_mouth.en: NO EQUIPMENT MOUTH TAKES THIS WHOLE · CUT IT FIRST

txt:crane_heavy.zh: 超过 12 t，起重机也吊不动
txt:crane_heavy.en: OVER 12 t: TOO HEAVY EVEN FOR THE CRANE

txt:berth_hint.zh: 船坞空着：按 %s 或飞到船坞电脑旁，打开终端挑下一单
txt:berth_hint.en: THE BERTH IS EMPTY: PRESS %s OR FLY TO THE BERTH COMPUTER TO PICK THE NEXT JOB

txt:tear_warn.zh: 还有 %s 个锁扣 / 线缆连着 · 硬扯会扯断
txt:tear_warn.en: %s LOCKS / LINES STILL ATTACHED · PULLING TEARS THEM

txt:tear_warn_live.zh: 连着锁扣 / 线缆（%s）· 硬扯会扯断并打火
txt:tear_warn_live.en: LOCKS / LINES ATTACHED (%s) · PULLING TEARS THEM, LIVE

txt:radio_log.zh: 无线电记录 · L 关闭

txt:auto_off.zh: 船坞机器 · 按 %s 启动
