txt:sc_out.zh: 合同范围外 · 不计酬

txt:eaf_line.zh: 分选线（压块 · 撕碎 · 磁选）

gear:gear_anchor_d.zh: 打在船体结构上，锚索会连接到船坞的绞盘。\n切断连接处后，绞盘会把整段结构拖进投料槽，不受重量限制。\n回收完成后，牵引锚会留在绞盘附近，记得捡回来。
gear:gear_anchor_d.en: Shot onto a hull piece; its line runs to a winch on the scrap trough. Once the section is cut free the winch hauls the whole of it down into the trough, whatever it weighs. The anchor is left at the winch post afterwards: fetch it.

gear:gear_pump_d.zh: 可以安装在带压舱室的壁板、储罐或储箱上，直接抽出内部物质，不需要连接现有接口。\n即使接口被阀门封死，或者找不到接口，也能正常抽取。\n回收零件前记得拆下泵，否则会跟着零件一起被回收。
gear:gear_pump_d.en: Stuck on any wall of a pressurised room, or on a tank or bottle: it draws through its own tap, no port needed, even where the port is shut off or nowhere to be found. Left on a piece that goes down a mouth, it goes with it.

gear:gear_prop_d.zh: 安装在船坞地面，支撑货柜墙指定一列的底部横梁。\n安装后，这一列及外侧各列的重量会通过撑杆传到地面，方便你先拆除内侧的货柜。\n最大承重 60 t，约等于两列满载货柜。超载后撑杆会弯曲，受力过大时可能折断。
gear:gear_prop_d.en: Stood on the berth floor under a bay's bottom chord of a container wall: that bay and every bay outboard of it bear on it instead of the bays inboard, which can then be emptied first. Rated 60 t (about two full bays): past that it bows, then buckles.

gear:gear_probe_d.zh: 安装在测量点、接口或零件上，持续监测数据。\n读数会自动更新。出现明显变化时，会通过无线电通知你。\n回收零件前记得取下探头，否则会一起丢失。
gear:gear_probe_d.en: Left on a test point, a port or a piece: its reading stays live and never goes stale, and a real change is called out on the radio. Left on a piece that goes down a mouth, it is gone.

gear:gear_mod_bumper_d.zh: 机体外圈的缓冲架：轻撞不再掉耐久，硬撞伤害减半。
gear:gear_mod_bumper_d.en: A bumper frame round the hull: light knocks cost no integrity, hard ones half as much.

gear:gear_mod_hover_d.zh: 更强的稳定推进：松手几乎立刻停稳，作业中不漂。
gear:gear_mod_hover_d.en: Stronger station-keeping: it stops almost at once when you let go, and does not drift while you work.

gear:gear_dropped.zh: %s 件装备掉落在事故位置
gear:gear_dropped.en: %s PIECES OF GEAR DROPPED AT THE CRASH SITE

gear:gear_anchor_off.en: ANCHOR CAST OFF AT THE WINCH POST

gear:gear_lost_mouth.en: %s WENT DOWN THE MOUTH WITH ITS PIECE

gear:gear_probe_stop.zh: 读数变了，激光已停：%s（松开左键再按才继续）
gear:gear_probe_stop.en: READING CHANGED, BEAM STOPPED: %s (RELEASE AND PRESS AGAIN)

gear:gear_no_target.en: NOTHING TO PUT IT ON HERE

gear:ld_note.zh: 带回的装备可以重复使用，不用重新购买。留在船上或掉落后没捡回的装备，按购买价格计算损失。
gear:ld_note.en: Gear brought back is not charged again; anything left on the ship or dropped and not fetched is lost at its purchase price.

gear:ld_keys.zh: 点击装备槽切换装备。按 Enter 开工，按 Esc 返回。
gear:ld_keys.en: Click a slot to change it · Enter starts · Esc goes back

gear:cs_will_fit.en: %s WILL BE FITTED AT THE BAY

gear:cs_out_probe.en: THE PROBE TIP IS WORN OUT

gear:cs_keys.zh: 永久技术来自工程成果 · 消耗件按用量磨损，三档任选 · Esc 返回
gear:cs_keys.en: Techniques come from achievements · parts wear with use, three grades · Esc back

gear:cs_tech_d.zh: 在合同里达成一次工程成果，对应型号永久开放，不花钱。
gear:cs_tech_d.en: Achieve it once on a job and the type is open for good, nothing to pay.

gear:cs_refund_note.en: The skill book was withdrawn; %s refunded.

gear:cs_parts_d.zh: 透镜按切割米数、电容按拖运吨次、探针按测量次数磨损。用完的工具停用，装上新的才能用。
gear:cs_parts_d.en: The lens wears by metres cut, the capacitor by tonnes grabbed, the probe by reads. A worn-out tool stops until a new part is fitted.

gear:g4_settle_failed.zh: 结算未保存，现场与物资已保留。可继续作业，或从菜单重试结算。
gear:g4_settle_failed.en: SETTLEMENT WAS NOT SAVED. YOUR SITE AND GEAR ARE INTACT. CONTINUE WORK OR RETRY FROM THE MENU.

gear:g4_reward_rigging.zh: 完整底板验证 · 牵引锚 +1

gear:g4_order_sold.zh: 改为出售，不计本次工程交付

gear:g4_order_pending.zh: 已预留，下次可继续交付

gear:g4_order_tracking.zh: 预留给工程 · P 管理方案与交付

gear:g4_order_wrong_zone.zh: 目标未送入设备口，按普通回收处理，未计工程交付。
gear:g4_order_wrong_zone.en: THE TARGET DID NOT ENTER EQUIPMENT RECOVERY; IT WAS NOT COUNTED AS AN ENGINEERING DELIVERY.

gear:g4_order_mount.zh: 目标未与完整底板一起送达，未计工程交付。
gear:g4_order_mount.en: THE TARGET DID NOT ARRIVE ON ITS INTACT MOUNT; NO ENGINEERING DELIVERY WAS RECORDED.

gear:g4_order_unstable.zh: 这组货物尚未完成 1 秒稳定检查，未计工程交付。
gear:g4_order_unstable.en: THIS ASSEMBLY HAD NOT COMPLETED ITS ONE-SECOND STABILITY CHECK; NO DELIVERY WAS RECORDED.

gear:g4_order_damaged.zh: 受损目标不符合完整交付标准；合格目标仍可预留。
gear:g4_order_damaged.en: DAMAGED TARGETS DO NOT MEET THE INTACT DELIVERY STANDARD; ELIGIBLE TARGETS CAN STILL BE RESERVED.

gear:boat_board.zh: [%s] 进入挂架 · 驾驶作业艇
gear:boat_board.en: [%s] INTO THE RACK · PILOT THE BOAT

gear:boat_underway.zh: 艇还在动：先刹停（Space）再操作
gear:boat_underway.en: THE BOAT IS MOVING: BRAKE (SPACE) FIRST

gear:boat_title.zh: 作业艇 WB-1 · 自动航行

gear:boat_sub.zh: 只列到访过的泊位；航行中按任意方向键接管。
gear:boat_sub.en: VISITED PADS ONLY; ANY MOVEMENT KEY TAKES OVER.

berth_view:build:2.en: Signed for; not in the berth yet.

berth_view:build:4.zh: 去「找船」，派拖船拖一艘回来。
berth_view:build:4.en: Find a ship and send a tug for it.

berth_view:_build_live:1.zh: 船上还剩 %d 件 · 危险 %d 处 · 值钱的设备 %d 件，共 %s
berth_view:_build_live:1.en: %d parts left · %d hazards · %d whole units worth %s

berth_view:_build_empty:4.zh: 船坞设施已修 %d / %d · 拖船区 %d 艘

boat_tow:_draw:2.zh: 拖缆 %.1f kN / 断裂 %.0f kN

consoles:_draw:1.zh: 仓库终端 · 已用 %d/%d 格

core_asset:顶层:4.zh: 带张力切断会撕裂，裂口顺着帆面蔓延；没接地，收卷时静电会击穿帆膜
core_asset:顶层:4.en: Cut while taut it tears, and the tear runs; unearthed, static pinholes the film as it winds

core_asset:顶层:6.zh: 快，几乎没风险，但光帆只剩废料价
core_asset:顶层:6.en: Quick and nearly safe, but the sail fetches scrap money only

core_asset:顶层:8.zh: 整船溢价 $900,000 + 船上设备和船壳

core_asset:顶层:10.zh: 小船断电、抽空燃料、舱室和货舱泄压；托架锁从船尾往船首依次解（CL-1→CL-4），先解船头侧会撬起撞门、溢价砍半；开船首门、出口路线清空、绞盘通电，整船拖出按一件结算；小船船壳一刀都别碰
core_asset:顶层:10.en: Battery off, fuel out, cabin and hold vented; the cradle locks from the stern forward (CL-1→CL-4), a bow lock first and it lurches into the door, half the premium gone; bow door open, the way out clear, winch powered: out whole, paid as one; never cut its hull

core_asset:顶层:12.zh: 不管顺序直接切：小船的设备照样能卖，但船壳一开，$900,000 的整船溢价就没了
core_asset:顶层:12.en: Cut it as it comes: its equipment still sells, but once its hull is open the $900,000 premium is gone

core_asset:顶层:14.zh: 7 列 26 箱，含居住舱、低温箱、危险品箱
core_asset:顶层:14.en: 26 CONTAINERS IN 7 BAYS, A HAB, A CRYO BOX AND A DG BOX AMONG THEM

core_asset:顶层:16.zh: 先松四根拉杆的花篮螺丝；每箱 6–9 t 要吊车；从两端往中间、每列从上往下，看着每列上方的弯曲读数走：外侧还满就卸空里侧，那一列会折弯，外侧的箱全被砸坏
core_asset:顶层:16.en: Slacken the four rods' turnbuckles first; each box is 6–9 t, crane it; from the ends inwards, each bay from the top, by the bending bar over it: empty an inner bay with the outer ones full and it kinks, every box beyond it damaged

core_asset:顶层:18.zh: 两根临时撑杆顶住外侧的列，里侧的箱就能先卸：撑杆额定 60 t（约两列满箱），撑得太靠里会超载、弯了再折；撤撑杆之前外侧要先卸掉，不然空掉的列当场折弯
core_asset:顶层:18.en: Two temporary props under the outer bays and the inner bays can come off first: a prop is rated 60 t (about two full bays), set too far in it bows and buckles; clear the outer bays before you take a prop away, or the empty bay kinks at once

core_asset:顶层:20.zh: 细矿 34 t + 矿块；破碎头、筛选机、振动驱动、皮带、皮带电机
core_asset:顶层:20.en: 34 t OF FINES + CHUNKS; CRUSHER, SCREENER, VIBRATOR, BELT, BELT MOTOR

core_asset:顶层:23.zh: 两扇放料门用开关打开，矿从门里流出边流边收钱；门口搭拱就挪开矿块；破碎头 6 t 超过抓钩，整件要吊车，切开就成废料；皮带先松张紧再拆，直接切会弹回打坏筛选机
core_asset:顶层:23.en: Open both gates by their switches, the ore pays as it runs; an arch over a gate, move its chunks; the 6 t crusher is past the grapple, crane it whole; slacken the belt before you take it off

core_asset:顶层:25.zh: 切开矿仓壁板，直接掏矿块，不用等放料：但料位线以下的破口会让细矿洒光、一分不算；矿还剩一半以上就撬门会撕裂矿仓、罚 $8,000
core_asset:顶层:25.en: Cut the hopper's walls and take the chunks, no waiting on the gates: but a hole below the heap pours the fines out unpaid; a gate forced with it half full tears the hopper, $8,000

core_asset:顶层:27.zh: 7 件：主、辅发动机，燃料箱，三件货
core_asset:顶层:27.en: 7 UNITS: TWO ENGINES, THE FUEL TANK, THREE CRATES

core_asset:顶层:31.zh: 先断电、泄压、抽空燃料再动刀；切管带油会起火，切到设备就成废料，搬运时撞到会掉价
core_asset:顶层:31.en: Power off, vent, drain the fuel before any cut; a pipe cut wet burns, equipment cut is scrap, knocks on the way cost

core_asset:顶层:33.zh: 大刀切开船体，整块往熔炉里送：快、痛快，但设备大多切坏、撞坏，按废料算
core_asset:顶层:33.en: Cut the hull into big sections and feed them to the furnace: quick and satisfying, but most equipment is cut or knocked to scrap

core_asset:顶层:35.zh: 燃料罐 T-2、水罐 T-5 + 罐里的燃料和水
core_asset:顶层:35.en: THE FUEL TANK T-2, THE WATER TANK T-5 + WHAT IS IN THEM

core_asset:顶层:39.zh: 总线还通着先从 PT-2、PT-5 把罐抽空（泵要有电）；从车尾往前拆，K-4 后面的拆完再动 K-4；罐 9 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:39.en: Drain both tanks at PT-2 and PT-5 while the bus is live (the pumps need it); strip from the tail, K-4 last; a tank is 9 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:41.zh: K-4 车钩卡死承着整列的弯矩：先拆它，后半列弹开，撕坏两边；先断总线罐就抽不出来了
core_asset:顶层:41.en: K-4 holds the train's bend: undo it first and the aft train springs off, tearing both sides; cut the bus first and the tanks can't be drained

core_asset:顶层:43.zh: 防喷器、岩芯盒、底部钻具、顶驱
core_asset:顶层:43.en: THE BOP, THE CORE BOX, THE BHA, THE TOP DRIVE

core_asset:顶层:46.zh: 先拨 TQB 泄掉残余扭矩，接 PMUD 放掉泥浆，再从上往下逐节卸钻杆，每卸一节先卡上它下面的卡瓦 SLIP
core_asset:顶层:46.en: Bleed the torque (TQB), let the mud out at PMUD, then break the stands out from the top, each with the slips (SLIP) set under it

core_asset:顶层:48.zh: 带着扭矩卸钻杆会甩打砸坏钻台，带着泥浆压力会喷出污染设备，顺序错了上面的钻杆会掉下来
core_asset:顶层:48.en: Broken out with torque it whips and smashes the floor, with the mud in it blows out, out of order the stands above drop

core_asset:顶层:53.zh: 每个飞轮先开刹车冷却 CV 再拨刹车 BR，降到 300 rpm 以下才拆；导轨张紧器从尾往头逐个松；托架 6 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:53.en: Each wheel's brake cooling (CV) on, then its brake (BR), under 300 rpm before it comes off; the rail tensioners from the tail to the head; the cradle is 6 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:55.zh: 飞轮还在转就拆：甩飞砸坏旁边；干刹会烧坏卡钳；张紧器先松头部，导轨会窜动甩打
core_asset:顶层:55.en: Taken still spinning it is thrown off; braked dry the caliper burns; a head tensioner first and the rail lurches

core_asset:顶层:57.zh: 4 罐低温货 + 两台制冷机
core_asset:顶层:57.en: 4 TANKS OF CRYO CARGO + TWO CRYOCOOLERS

core_asset:顶层:61.zh: 制冷机一直开着，先拨 RVH-3 给 TK3 冻住的泄压阀化冻，再逐罐接 PT 口抽走，最后才断电
core_asset:顶层:61.en: Keep the cryocoolers running, thaw TK3's frozen relief valve (RVH-3), draw each tank at its PT port, power off last

core_asset:顶层:63.zh: 先断电：罐压一路升到泄压阀放空，货没了；TK3 的阀冻着，那一罐会爆
core_asset:顶层:63.en: Power off first: the tanks climb to their reliefs and vent the cargo; TK3's valve is frozen, and that one bursts

core_asset:顶层:65.zh: 系绳两端两个吊舱里的设备
core_asset:顶层:65.en: WHAT THE TWO PODS ON THE TETHER CARRY

core_asset:顶层:68.zh: 开船坞刹车的冷却 BRK-C 再拨刹车 BRK，等它停转；拨 TEN 松掉残余张力，再切系绳；干刹打滑了就只能用 B 舱的 RCS 停
core_asset:顶层:68.en: The berth brake's cooling (BRK-C) on, then the brake (BRK), till it stops; let the residual pull off (TEN), then cut the tether; braked dry the rollers slip and only B's RCS can stop it

core_asset:顶层:70.zh: 还在转就切系绳：两个吊舱被甩飞，里面的设备撞坏
core_asset:顶层:70.en: Cut the tether still turning: both pods are thrown, and what they carry is smashed

core_asset:顶层:72.zh: 主反应堆 + 副反应堆

core_asset:顶层:75.zh: 和 NR-95 一样：四个控制鼓先拨 RL 锁住，冷到 60°C 以下，在屏蔽板的阴影里干活，激光绝不碰堆芯；整船只许人工拆
core_asset:顶层:75.en: As on NR-95: the four drum locks (RL) thrown, cooled under 60 °C, worked in the shield's shadow, the beam never on the core; the whole ship by hand only

core_asset:顶层:77.zh: 不锁鼓不躲辐射：无人机剂量超限、控制鼓滑出；激光切坏堆芯会核爆
core_asset:顶层:77.en: Locks off, no shadow: the drone's dose runs over, a drum slips; cut a core and it detonates

core_asset:顶层:82.zh: 每个舱的点火电容先拨 ARM 断开（或拔掉引线），再松发射夹；观察厅先泄压，玻璃才不会吹出
core_asset:顶层:82.en: Each pod's firing circuit off at its ARM switch (or its lead pulled) before its launch clamps; vent the observation hall before its glass

core_asset:顶层:84.zh: 点火电路还活着就切发射夹：火工螺栓点火，逃生舱被弹射出去摔坏
core_asset:顶层:84.en: Cut a launch clamp with its circuit live: the bolts fire and the pod is thrown off and smashed

core_asset:顶层:86.zh: 夹在两船体之间的预制居住舱里的 19 件设备
core_asset:顶层:86.en: THE 19 UNITS IN THE HABITAT CLAMPED BETWEEN THE HULLS

core_asset:顶层:89.zh: 居住舱先抽到 20 kPa 以下，8 个液压夹按对角顺序交替松（HC-U1、HC-L4、HC-U4、HC-L1……）
core_asset:顶层:89.en: Pump the habitat below 20 kPa, then let the eight clamps go crosswise (HC-U1, HC-L4, HC-U4, HC-L1…)

core_asset:顶层:91.zh: 有压就松夹舱体会弹出；一边先松光舱体扭转、砸坏舱里的设备，裂了的 2 号梁会断开
core_asset:顶层:91.en: Let go with air in it and it springs; one side first and it twists into its fittings, and the cracked beam 2 tears out

core_asset:顶层:95.en: KILL THE LOCKS, OPEN THE VAULTS

core_asset:顶层:96.zh: 两路电锁都要断：主电 K-M 和锁的备用电 K-LB；再在维修柜拨机械释放 MR，金库门就能打开，保险箱整件取出
core_asset:顶层:96.en: Both lock circuits dead, the main bus (K-M) and the locks' backup (K-LB); throw the release (MR) in the maintenance cabinet, open the vault, take the boxes whole

core_asset:顶层:98.zh: 不开门直接切金库墙：快，但刀口贴着保险箱，切到或撞到就掉价
core_asset:顶层:98.en: Cut through the vault wall: quick, but the cuts run beside the boxes and a cut or a knock costs

core_asset:顶层:100.zh: 酸、乙二醇、溶剂 + 总管 + 三个工艺罐
core_asset:顶层:100.en: ACID, GLYCOL, SOLVENT + THE MANIFOLD + THREE PROCESS TANKS

core_asset:顶层:103.en: SAMPLE, THEN ONE AT A TIME

core_asset:顶层:104.zh: 接口编号对不上介质：先在 SP 点取样认清；抽哪一支就只开它的阀 V，其他支路阀全关
core_asset:顶层:104.en: The port numbers say nothing of the medium: sample at SP first; open only the branch you draw, every other valve shut

core_asset:顶层:106.zh: 几支路阀都开着就抽：介质在总管里混成废液，不值钱还要付处理费；带介质切总管会洒
core_asset:顶层:106.en: Draw with several valves open: they mix in the manifold into waste, worthless and charged for; cut the manifold full and it spills

core_asset:顶层:108.zh: 冰（融水按水价）+ 两台水泵
core_asset:顶层:108.en: THE ICE (PAID AS WATER) + TWO PUMPS

core_asset:顶层:112.zh: 逐区开加热器 HT 融冰，融水积到 3 m³ 就会短路，及时从 PW 泵走；冰化到一半以下才松鞍座 PH
core_asset:顶层:112.en: Heaters (HT) zone by zone; past 3 m³ standing the meltwater shorts things, pump it at PW as it comes; no saddle seat (PH) lets go till half the ice is gone

core_asset:顶层:114.zh: 直接切冰块：裂缝顺着冰跑，冰块砸坏设备；冰没化就松鞍座，冰整块掉下来
core_asset:顶层:114.en: Cut the ice: the crack runs and the split ice hits the units; a seat let go with the ice still on drops it

core_asset:顶层:116.zh: 阵列 + 摇篮上的 3 台光学仪
core_asset:顶层:116.en: THE ARRAY + 3 OPTICS ON THE CRADLE

core_asset:顶层:119.zh: 仪器摇篮挂在主梁上：先拨 DL 解开三台光学仪的摇篮锁，再动吊挂和主梁
core_asset:顶层:119.en: The cradle hangs from the main beam: release the three optics (DL) before the hangers or the beam

core_asset:顶层:121.zh: 锁还没解就切吊挂或主梁：整组仪器砸下来
core_asset:顶层:121.en: Cut a hanger or the beam with them still locked on: the whole set comes down

core_asset:顶层:122.en: THE FURNACE CORE AND THE INGOTS

core_asset:顶层:123.zh: 炉芯 + 两个钢锭架 + 光谱仪
core_asset:顶层:123.en: THE CORE + TWO INGOT RACKS + THE SPECTROMETER

core_asset:顶层:126.zh: 换热泵 HX 一直有电，炉芯冷到 150°C 以下再吊；进料臂先给 ACC-F 泄压、拔销；炉芯 9 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:126.en: Keep the heat-exchange pumps (HX) powered till the core is under 150 °C; bleed the feed arm (ACC-F) and pull its pins; the core is 9 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:128.zh: 350°C 以上断了冷却，炉芯热震开裂；带压拆进料臂会弹出砸坏分选机
core_asset:顶层:128.en: Cooling lost over 350 °C and the core cracks; the feed arm taken under pressure springs into the sorter

core_asset:顶层:133.zh: 船首门的蓄能器 ACC-D 先泄压、拔销，再开门罩和首门；然后逐条拨 LR 解轨道锁，货自己滚出来；每件 4.8 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:133.en: Bleed the bow door's accumulator (ACC-D) and pull its pins, open the visor and the door; then each rail lock (LR) and the cargo rolls out; 4.8 t each, crane them

core_asset:顶层:135.zh: 轨道锁扳手拧不开，只能连轨道切：货被扯伤
core_asset:顶层:135.en: The wrench can't undo a rail lock: cut the rail with the cargo on it and it is wrenched

core_asset:顶层:137.zh: 反应堆、炮塔、火控、加密机
core_asset:顶层:137.en: THE REACTOR, THE TURRET, THE FIRE CONTROL, THE CRYPTO

core_asset:顶层:140.zh: 先开注水阀 FLV 把弹库全打湿（弹药就不会殉爆，但也不值钱了），拨 LK-T 锁住推力矢量作动器，放掉电容再拆；反应堆 12 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:140.en: Open the flood valve (FLV) and wet the magazine (no cook-off, and no value in the rounds), lock the thrust-vector rams (LK-T), drain the capacitors, then take; the reactor is 12 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:142.zh: 弹药还活着就在附近切：殉爆，一发带一发连锁，设备被炸坏；作动器没锁切线会猛甩
core_asset:顶层:142.en: Cut close with the rounds live: they cook off, one setting off the next, and the units are blown apart; an unlocked ram jerks when its line is cut

core_asset:顶层:144.zh: 6 架舱位无人机 + 回收无人机

core_asset:顶层:147.zh: 每架无人机先拨 PK 断开电池隔离开关（或先摘电池），升降机给 ACC-G 泄压、拔销，再从托架上拆
core_asset:顶层:147.en: Each drone's pack isolator off (PK), or the pack off first; bleed the lift (ACC-G) and pull its pins; then off the cradles

core_asset:顶层:149.zh: 电池还通着就拆托架：无人机醒来，旋翼一转把自己甩出去撞坏
core_asset:顶层:149.en: Free a drone with its pack live: it wakes, spins up and throws itself into whatever is near

core_asset:顶层:151.zh: 8 个环向线圈 + 2 个中心螺线管

core_asset:顶层:154.zh: 开泄能开关 DUMP、保持制冷（冷箱要有电、液氦要够），等储能降到 5% 以下再动线圈支架
core_asset:顶层:154.en: Close the dump (DUMP) with the cooling kept on (the cold box powered, helium in it), and touch no coil support till the energy is under 5%

core_asset:顶层:156.zh: 不泄能就断电或切支架：线圈失超，能量瞬间放出，连锁到旁边的线圈
core_asset:顶层:156.en: Power off or cut a support with the field up: the coil quenches, the energy comes out at once and runs into the coils beside it

core_asset:顶层:157.en: THE ENGINE PODS AND THE WINCH

core_asset:顶层:158.zh: 上下两台引擎舱 + 拖曳绞车
core_asset:顶层:158.en: TWO ENGINE PODS + THE TOW WINCH

core_asset:顶层:162.zh: 先拨 SUP 撑住船体（或者两台引擎舱一起拆），蓄能器泄压、拔掉绞车和拖钳的销子再拆；引擎舱 4.2 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:162.en: Set the support (SUP) first, or take both pods together; bleed the accumulators and pull the winch and jaw pins; a pod is 4.2 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:164.zh: 不撑船体先拆一边：重量全压在剩下那台上，船体扭曲，引擎舱和吊架受损；带压拆绞车会弹出
core_asset:顶层:164.en: One pod off with nothing set: the hull twists under the other, it and its mounts damaged; the winch taken under load springs

core_asset:顶层:166.zh: 三罐 LNG 货 + 三个低温罐
core_asset:顶层:166.en: THREE TANKS OF LNG + THE TANKS

core_asset:顶层:170.zh: 冷机一直开着，从每个罐的 LP 口把 LNG 抽走，最后才断电拆罐；罐 7 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:170.en: Keep the chillers running, draw each tank off at its LP port, power off last; a tank is 7 t, crane it

core_asset:顶层:172.zh: 先断电直接切：LNG 升温沸散，货没了；泄压阀冻住的罐会爆
core_asset:顶层:172.en: Power off and cut: the LNG warms and boils away, and a tank with its relief valve frozen ruptures

core_asset:顶层:174.zh: 3 张手术台、3 个冷冻柜、空气再生器、制氧机
core_asset:顶层:174.en: 3 OPERATING TABLES, 3 FREEZERS, THE AIR REGENERATOR, THE OXYGEN PLANT

core_asset:顶层:177.zh: 隔离舱先用回收软管（带滤网）抽走空气，生物危险品逐个封存再搬，干净舱的门最后才开
core_asset:顶层:177.en: Pump the isolation rooms out through the hose's filter, seal every biohazard before it moves, open the clean rooms last

core_asset:顶层:179.zh: 隔离舱带着污染空气就开门或切开：污染扩散到干净舱，里面的设备每件掉 1/4
core_asset:顶层:179.en: Open or cut an isolation room with its air still dirty: it spreads, and every unit in a clean room it reaches loses a quarter

core_asset:顶层:181.zh: 12 个机柜（另有 8 块客户硬盘要托管）

core_asset:顶层:184.zh: 8 块硬盘先拨 CUST 锁进屏蔽舱；每个机柜先从 PT 口抽干冷却液罐，再拧下吊走
core_asset:顶层:184.en: Latch the 8 drives into custody (CUST) first; drain each rack's tank at its PT port before you unbolt it

core_asset:顶层:186.zh: 罐里还有液就吊：冷却液洒出来，旁边一排机柜短路；没上锁的硬盘取出按违约罚款
core_asset:顶层:186.en: Lift a rack wet: the fluid spills and shorts the racks beside it; a drive taken unlatched is a breach, fined

core_asset:顶层:188.en: THE FISH TANK, THE FRY TANK, THE SEED VAULT

core_asset:顶层:190.en: PUMP IT DOWN, VENT THE DOME

core_asset:顶层:191.zh: 先从 PW 口抽水，水球缩到 12% 以下才能动网罩和支架；穹顶先泄压，玻璃才不会吹出
core_asset:顶层:191.en: Pump the ball down at PW below 12% before the net or its frame; vent the dome before the glass

core_asset:顶层:193.zh: 水球还大就切网：水球炸散，鱼全死，舱里的电气被泡坏
core_asset:顶层:193.en: Cut the net with the ball still up: it bursts, the fish die, the room's electrics are soaked

core_asset:顶层:195.zh: 种子库、6 个培养架、6 块观察玻璃、培养控制台
core_asset:顶层:195.en: THE SEED VAULT, 6 CULTURE RACKS, 6 VIEWING PANES, THE CONSOLE

core_asset:顶层:197.en: THE RICH AIR OUT, HALL BY HALL

core_asset:顶层:198.zh: 三间培养舱逐个接 G-U 口抽空，富氧空气走了再动刀；观察玻璃拧螺栓拆
core_asset:顶层:198.en: Pump each culture hall out at its G-U port before any cut; unbolt the panes

core_asset:顶层:200.zh: 富氧空气还在就切：闪燃烧遍培养舱，观察玻璃也会龟裂
core_asset:顶层:200.en: Cut with the rich air in: a flash fire through the halls, and the panes craze

core_asset:顶层:202.zh: 堆芯、液氢罐、喷管、屏蔽板
core_asset:顶层:202.en: THE CORE, THE HYDROGEN TANK, THE NOZZLE, THE SHIELD

core_asset:顶层:205.zh: 四个控制鼓先拨 DL 锁住，冷却泵有电让堆芯冷到 60°C 以下；先吊起屏蔽板，在它的阴影里干活；激光绝不碰堆芯
core_asset:顶层:205.en: Lock the four drums (DL), keep the coolant pumps powered till the core is under 60 °C; lift the shield and work in its shadow; never let the beam touch the core

core_asset:顶层:207.zh: 不躲辐射硬干：无人机剂量超限、电子件故障；控制鼓没锁就吊堆芯会滑出；激光切坏堆芯会核爆
core_asset:顶层:207.en: Work in the open: the drone's dose runs over and its electronics fault; lift the core with a drum unlocked and it slips; cut the core and it detonates

core_asset:顶层:209.zh: 三个推进剂罐 + 主泵 + 罐里的推进剂
core_asset:顶层:209.en: THREE PROPELLANT TANKS + THE MAIN PUMP + THE PROPELLANT

core_asset:顶层:212.en: VALVES IN ORDER, PUMP IT OFF

core_asset:顶层:213.zh: 主泵有电时打开 MMH 罐的交叉阀，从 PR 口抽走总管；N2O4 罐单独从 LD-2 抽；增压阀 PV 一直开着、TV 和 NP 口别放空，否则罐会抽瘪
core_asset:顶层:213.en: With the pump powered open the MMH tanks' cross valves and draw the manifold at PR; the N2O4 tank on its own at LD-2; keep the pressurisation (PV) open and never vent TV or NP, or a tank buckles

core_asset:顶层:215.zh: 推进剂还在就切管：MMH 和 N2O4 碰上自燃，罐和泵烧坏
core_asset:顶层:215.en: Cut the lines with propellant in them: the MMH and N2O4 meet and ignite, burning the tanks and the pump

core_asset:顶层:217.zh: 三间冷舱的 18 个托盘 + 6 个疫苗箱
core_asset:顶层:217.en: 18 PALLETS + 6 VACCINE BOXES IN THREE COLD HOLDS

core_asset:顶层:220.zh: 先接船坞临时制冷 COLD-X（或让冷机一直有电），货全部卸完再断电
core_asset:顶层:220.en: Plug in the berth's cooling (COLD-X), or keep the chillers powered, till every pallet is out; power off last

core_asset:顶层:222.zh: 先断电：冷舱升到 −5°C 以上，疫苗解冻，只剩 45% 价值
core_asset:顶层:222.en: Power off first: the holds warm past −5 °C and the vaccines thaw, 45% of their worth left

core_asset:顶层:224.en: THE TOW WINCH, THE ENGINE, THE NAV

core_asset:顶层:227.zh: 先泄压、断电、抽空燃料；设备用维护工具拧下固定件整件取，切到就成废料
core_asset:顶层:227.en: Vent, power off, drain the fuel; unbolt each unit whole with the wrench, a cut makes it scrap

core_asset:顶层:229.zh: 船体切成大块整块送熔炉：快，但设备跟着一起熔了
core_asset:顶层:229.en: Cut the hull into big sections for the furnace: quick, but the units melt with it

core_asset:顶层:233.en: THROUGH THE DOOR, ONE BY ONE

core_asset:顶层:234.zh: 开货舱门，拧开每个货柜的固定件，逐个抓出来；最大的 CG-3 有 3.8 t，超过抓钩要吊车
core_asset:顶层:234.en: Open the hold, unbolt each container and take it out one by one; CG-3 is 3.8 t, past the grapple: crane it

core_asset:顶层:235.en: CUT THE WALL, DRAG THE ROW

core_asset:顶层:236.zh: 切开货舱壁，连着舱板整排拖出来：快，但刀口贴着货柜，切到就成废料
core_asset:顶层:236.en: Cut the hold's wall and drag the row out on its deck: quick, but the cuts run along the boxes and a cut box is scrap

core_asset:顶层:238.en: THE ARM, THE FUEL CELL, THE ENGINE

core_asset:顶层:241.zh: 燃料电池先停机、放掉电容、抽空氢氧再拆；机械臂是强制回收件，整件拧下送设备口
core_asset:顶层:241.en: Stop the fuel cell, drain the capacitor, take the hydrogen and oxygen out first; the arm is a named piece: unbolt it whole

core_asset:顶层:243.zh: 船体切成大块送熔炉：快，但氢氧还在就切会爆燃，设备跟着熔掉
core_asset:顶层:243.en: Big sections to the furnace: quick, but cut with the gas still in it flares, and the units melt

core_asset:顶层:244.en: THE QUANTUM CHIP AND ITS FRIDGE

core_asset:顶层:245.zh: 量子芯片 QPU + 稀释制冷机五级冷台
core_asset:顶层:245.en: THE QPU + THE FRIDGE'S FIVE STAGES

core_asset:顶层:249.zh: 先锁隔振台、停循环、回收混合气，再停脉管，等它自己回到 250 K 以上才拆冷台：安全，但要等很久
core_asset:顶层:249.en: Lock the isolation table, stop the circulation, recover the mixture, then stop the pulse tube and wait till it is past 250 K before the stack: safe, and slow

core_asset:顶层:251.zh: 同样的顺序，停脉管后开加热器，回温快几倍；混合室还没过 30 K 就开，芯片当场裂
core_asset:顶层:251.en: The same order, heaters on once the pulse tube stops: several times quicker; on before the mixing chamber is past 30 K and the chip cracks

core_asset:顶层:256.zh: 先开货舱门和船尾门，再拨轨道锁 LK-U、LK-L：箱子顺着轨道自己滑出来；门没开就解锁，箱子撞门受伤
core_asset:顶层:256.en: Open the hold door and the stern door, then the rail locks LK-U, LK-L: the boxes run out on their rails; released into a shut door they dent

core_asset:顶层:258.zh: 扳手拧不开轨道锁，只能连轨道一起切下来：快，但箱子被扯伤
core_asset:顶层:258.en: The wrench can't undo a rail lock: you cut the rail with the box on it, quick, but the box is wrenched

core_asset:顶层:259.en: THE TOW HEADS AND THE HYDRAULICS

core_asset:顶层:260.zh: 上下两个拖头 + 液压站

core_asset:顶层:264.zh: 先断线圈电源再消磁，蓄能器泄压、拔掉拖臂的销子，最后拧下拖头；拖头 2.2 t 要吊车
core_asset:顶层:264.en: Kill the coil supply and degauss, bleed the accumulator, pull the arm pins, then unbolt the heads; 2.2 t each, crane them

core_asset:顶层:266.zh: 不消磁不泄压直接切：残磁把无人机和碎件吸过去，拖臂带压弹出，砸坏拖头
core_asset:顶层:266.en: Cut it as it is: the residual field drags the drone and loose pieces in, the arms spring out under pressure into the heads

core_asset:顶层:268.zh: 主机、电池 + 驾驶舱和电子舱的电子件
core_asset:顶层:268.en: THE ENGINE, THE BATTERY + THE COCKPIT AND AVIONICS ELECTRONICS

core_asset:顶层:272.zh: 先把舱室抽到真空再切碳纤维壳，或者用维护工具拧下壳板：都不冒烟
core_asset:顶层:272.en: Pump a room down before you cut its carbon skin, or unbolt the panels: no smoke either way

core_asset:顶层:273.en: CUT THE SKIN WITH AIR IN

core_asset:顶层:274.zh: 舱里还有空气就切碳纤维壳：快，但毒烟把电子件熏得掉价，玻璃也会起雾
core_asset:顶层:274.en: Cut the carbon skin with air in the room: quick, but the smoke spoils the electronics and fogs the glass

core_asset:顶层:276.zh: 保险箱、钢琴、酒墙、水疗、吧台、艺术品
core_asset:顶层:276.en: THE SAFE, THE PIANO, THE WINE WALL, THE SPA, THE BAR, THE ART

core_asset:顶层:279.zh: 先撬开卡死的气口 G-S，把主舱的富氧空气抽走再动刀；玻璃拧螺栓拆，别在旁边切
core_asset:顶层:279.en: Free the jammed port G-S and pump the oxygen-rich air out before any cut; unbolt the glass, never cut beside it

core_asset:顶层:281.zh: 富氧空气还在就切：闪燃烧遍主舱，收藏被烧坏，玻璃也会龟裂
core_asset:顶层:281.en: Cut with the rich air in: a flash fire through the saloon scorches the collection and crazes the glass

core_asset:顶层:283.zh: 日冕仪、两台光谱仪、仪器计算机
core_asset:顶层:283.en: THE CORONAGRAPH, TWO SPECTROMETERS, THE INSTRUMENT COMPUTER

core_asset:顶层:286.zh: 接上船坞冷却回路 COOL-S，等仪器舱降到 150°C 以下再取：仪器完好，要等
core_asset:顶层:286.en: Plug in the berth's cooling loop (COOL-S) and wait for the instrument room below 150 °C: whole, and a wait

core_asset:顶层:288.zh: 先拆已经冷下来的区，热区边等边拆：快，但从 150°C 以上的区取出的设备热损，热瓦切开会碎
core_asset:顶层:288.en: Strip the cool zones first and the hot ones as they come: quick, but units out of a zone over 150 °C are heat-damaged, hot tiles shatter

core_asset:顶层:290.zh: 环控、气泵、控制台、电池、电容、配电板、两个储物柜
core_asset:顶层:290.en: ENV CONTROL, BAG PUMP, CONSOLE, BATTERY, CAPACITOR, PANEL, TWO LOCKERS

core_asset:顶层:293.zh: 四个气囊各自接 BV 口放气，折叠贴到脊梁上，再拨 TN 松开张紧器，最后拆设备
core_asset:顶层:293.en: Let each bag down at its BV port till it folds onto the spine, the tensioners (TN) off, then the units

core_asset:顶层:295.zh: 带气割气囊：快，但气囊当场撕开塌下来砸坏下面的设备，绷着的绑带也会甩
core_asset:顶层:295.en: Cut a bag with gas in it: quick, but it rips and comes down on the units, and a taut strap whips

core_asset:顶层:297.zh: 18 片，三圈，装在 6 块背板上

core_asset:顶层:299.zh: 没放防尘罩就在附近切，镜面会被粉尘污染；支撑器没锁就取，镜片会摔裂；不从外圈往里取，外圈会崩边
core_asset:顶层:299.en: Cut near it uncovered and dust spoils the coating; taken off unlocked a segment drops and cracks; not outer ring first and the outer edges chip

core_asset:顶层:301.zh: 先把镜筒外壳拆掉，吊车才有路把块吊出去；每块约 5.4 t；同样要放防尘罩、锁支撑器、从外圈往里切；整块磕一下，3 片一起受伤
core_asset:顶层:301.en: Strip the tube's casing first, or the crane has no way out with a block; about 5.4 t each; cover, locks and outer ring first all the same; one knock hurts three segments

core_asset:顶层:303.zh: 那一角还绷着就切了帆片
core_asset:顶层:303.en: a panel cut with its corner still taut

core_asset:顶层:304.zh: 切帆片之前，先松开那一角的绞盘刹车
core_asset:顶层:304.en: Let off that corner's winch brake before you cut its film

core_asset:顶层:306.en: a panel cut through, now scrap

core_asset:顶层:307.zh: 要整帆的钱就别切帆面：用收帆电机卷
core_asset:顶层:307.en: To keep the sail's worth, don't cut the film: wind it in

core_asset:顶层:309.zh: 裂口顺着绷紧的帆面跑进了旁边的帆片
core_asset:顶层:309.en: a tear ran across taut film into the next panel

core_asset:顶层:310.zh: 一看到裂口，马上松开那一角的刹车，裂口就停住
core_asset:顶层:310.en: The moment a tear starts, let off that corner's brake: it stops

core_asset:顶层:312.zh: 帆片在张紧时被扯离帆架
core_asset:顶层:312.en: a panel pulled off while its corner was taut

core_asset:顶层:313.en: Slacken the corner before you move its film

core_asset:顶层:315.zh: 拉索带着张力被切断，弹断撕坏了帆片
core_asset:顶层:315.en: a stay cut under load snapped and tore its panels

core_asset:顶层:316.zh: 切拉索之前先松那一角的刹车
core_asset:顶层:316.en: Let off that corner's brake before you cut its stays

core_asset:顶层:318.zh: 那一角还绷着就开了收帆电机，卷筒过载
core_asset:顶层:318.en: the furling motor run with the corner still taut

core_asset:顶层:319.zh: 先松刹车，再开收帆电机
core_asset:顶层:319.en: Brake off first, then the furling motor

core_asset:顶层:321.zh: 没接地就收卷，静电击穿了帆膜
core_asset:顶层:321.en: wound unearthed: static pinholed the film

core_asset:顶层:322.zh: 收卷前先接上左下角的接地线 GND
core_asset:顶层:322.en: Earth it at GND (bottom left) before you wind

core_asset:顶层:324.zh: 飘浮的碎件打穿了帆膜

core_asset:顶层:325.zh: 收卷前把帆前面飘着的碎件清走
core_asset:顶层:325.en: Clear the loose pieces off the film before you wind

core_asset:顶层:327.zh: 在帆附近切割，熔渣熏黑了帆膜
core_asset:顶层:327.en: cutting close by blackened the film

core_asset:顶层:328.zh: 先收帆，再切帆附近的结构
core_asset:顶层:328.en: Furl first, then cut the structure near the film

core_asset:顶层:330.zh: K-4 车钩卡着弯矩就拆了，后半列弹开撕坏两边
core_asset:顶层:330.en: K-4 undone with the bend on it: the aft train sprang and tore both sides

core_asset:顶层:331.zh: 从车尾往前拆，K-4 后面的拆完再动 K-4
core_asset:顶层:331.en: Strip from the tail; K-4 only once what is aft of it is off

core_asset:顶层:333.zh: 钻杆还带着扭矩就卸，甩打砸坏了钻台
core_asset:顶层:333.en: a stand broken out with torque on: it whipped and smashed the floor

core_asset:顶层:334.zh: 先拨 TQB 把扭矩泄到 5% 以下

core_asset:顶层:336.zh: 泥浆还有压就卸钻杆，泥浆喷出污了设备
core_asset:顶层:336.en: broken out with the mud in: it blew out and fouled the units

core_asset:顶层:337.zh: 先接 PMUD 把泥浆放掉
core_asset:顶层:337.en: Let the mud out at PMUD first

core_asset:顶层:339.zh: 顺序错了或卡瓦没卡，上面的钻杆掉了下来
core_asset:顶层:339.en: out of order or the slips open: the stands above dropped

core_asset:顶层:340.zh: 从上往下逐节卸，每节先卡上它下面的 SLIP
core_asset:顶层:340.en: From the top, each with its slips (SLIP) set under it

core_asset:顶层:342.zh: 飞轮还在高速转就拆，甩飞砸坏了旁边
core_asset:顶层:342.en: a wheel taken still spinning: it was thrown into what was near

core_asset:顶层:343.zh: 开冷却刹车，降到 300 rpm 以下再拆
core_asset:顶层:343.en: Cooled brakes till it is under 300 rpm

core_asset:顶层:345.zh: 张紧器没从尾往头松，导轨窜动撞坏东西
core_asset:顶层:345.en: a tensioner let off ahead of one aft of it: the rail lurched

core_asset:顶层:346.zh: 导轨张紧器从尾往头逐个松
core_asset:顶层:346.en: The tensioners from the tail to the head

core_asset:顶层:348.zh: 导轨带着 180 kN 张力被切，甩打砸坏东西
core_asset:顶层:348.en: a rail cut at 180 kN whipped

core_asset:顶层:349.zh: 先松完张紧器再切导轨
core_asset:顶层:349.en: Every tensioner off before the rail

core_asset:顶层:351.zh: 没开冷却就刹车，卡钳烧坏了
core_asset:顶层:351.en: braked dry: the caliper burnt out

core_asset:顶层:352.zh: 先开 CV 冷却，再拨 BR 刹车

core_asset:顶层:354.zh: 低温罐压力升到爆裂（泄压阀冻住或没制冷）
core_asset:顶层:354.en: a cryo tank climbed till it burst (its valve frozen, or no cooling)

core_asset:顶层:355.zh: 制冷机一直开着，先给冻阀化冻，再抽货
core_asset:顶层:355.en: Keep the coolers on, thaw the frozen valve, then draw it

core_asset:顶层:357.zh: 还在转就切了系绳，两个吊舱被甩飞
core_asset:顶层:357.en: the tether cut still turning: both pods were thrown

core_asset:顶层:358.zh: 开冷却刹车停转，松掉 TEN 再切
core_asset:顶层:358.en: Cooled brake till it stops, TEN off, then cut

core_asset:顶层:360.zh: 系绳带着张力断开，崩伤了设备
core_asset:顶层:360.en: the tether parted under load and hurt the units

core_asset:顶层:361.zh: 停转并松掉残余张力再切系绳
core_asset:顶层:361.en: Stopped and slackened before you cut it

core_asset:顶层:363.zh: 系绳断头甩打砸坏了旁边
core_asset:顶层:363.en: a parted end whipped into what was near

core_asset:顶层:364.zh: 停转、松 TEN 后再切
core_asset:顶层:364.en: Stop it and TEN off before the cut

core_asset:顶层:366.zh: 没开冷却就刹车，滚轮过热打滑
core_asset:顶层:366.en: braked dry: the rollers overheated and slipped

core_asset:顶层:367.zh: 先开 BRK-C 冷却再刹车

core_asset:顶层:369.zh: 点火电路还活着就松了发射夹，火工螺栓点火，逃生舱被弹射出去摔坏
core_asset:顶层:369.en: a launch clamp undone with the firing circuit live: the bolts fired and the pod was thrown off

core_asset:顶层:370.zh: 松夹之前先拨 ARM 断开点火电容，或拔掉引线
core_asset:顶层:370.en: Firing circuit off (ARM) or its lead pulled before the clamps

core_asset:顶层:372.zh: 居住舱还有压就松了夹，舱体弹出砸坏里面的设备
core_asset:顶层:372.en: the clamps let go with air still in the habitat: it sprang and knocked its fittings

core_asset:顶层:373.zh: 松夹之前先把居住舱抽到 20 kPa 以下
core_asset:顶层:373.en: Pump the habitat below 20 kPa before the clamps

core_asset:顶层:375.zh: 一边的夹先松多了，居住舱扭转，砸坏里面的设备
core_asset:顶层:375.en: one side's clamps let go first: the habitat twisted into its fittings

core_asset:顶层:376.en: Crosswise, one each side in turn: HC-U1, HC-L4, HC-U4, HC-L1…

core_asset:顶层:378.zh: 裂了的 2 号梁旁边的夹还夹着就拆了梁，船体被撕开
core_asset:顶层:378.en: the cracked beam taken with a clamp beside it still holding: it tore the hull

core_asset:顶层:379.zh: 先松 2 号梁旁边的 HC-U1、HC-L1，再拆梁
core_asset:顶层:379.en: HC-U1 and HC-L1 off before the cracked beam

core_asset:顶层:381.zh: 融水积太多，带电的设备泡水短路
core_asset:顶层:381.en: too much meltwater stood about and shorted the live units

core_asset:顶层:382.zh: 融水积到 3 m³ 之前就从 PW 泵走
core_asset:顶层:382.en: Pump it at PW before it stands over 3 m³

core_asset:顶层:384.zh: 冰还没化到一半就松了鞍座，冰整块掉下来
core_asset:顶层:384.en: a saddle seat let go with most of the ice still on: it dropped

core_asset:顶层:385.zh: 冰化到一半以下再松鞍座 PH
core_asset:顶层:385.en: Melt it below half before any seat (PH) lets go

core_asset:顶层:387.zh: 裂缝两侧的鞍座还夹着就动了裂缝上的冰块，冰沿裂缝裂开
core_asset:顶层:387.en: a block on the crack moved with the seats beside it still holding: the crack ran

core_asset:顶层:388.zh: 裂缝上的冰用加热器融，别切
core_asset:顶层:388.en: Melt the blocks on the crack; never cut them

core_asset:顶层:390.zh: 炉芯还在 350°C 以上就断了冷却（或 150°C 以上吊出），热震开裂
core_asset:顶层:390.en: cooling lost over 350 °C (or lifted out over 150 °C): the core cracked

core_asset:顶层:391.zh: 换热泵 HX 一直有电，炉芯冷到 150°C 以下再动
core_asset:顶层:391.en: Keep the heat-exchange pumps (HX) powered till the core is under 150 °C

core_asset:顶层:393.zh: 进料臂带压上着销就拆了，弹出砸坏分选机
core_asset:顶层:393.en: the feed arm taken pinned and under pressure: it sprang into the sorter

core_asset:顶层:394.zh: 先给 ACC-F 泄压、拔销
core_asset:顶层:394.en: Bleed ACC-F and pull the pins first

core_asset:顶层:396.zh: 船首门罩带压上着销就拆了，弹开砸东西
core_asset:顶层:396.en: the bow visor taken pinned and under pressure: it sprang

core_asset:顶层:397.zh: 先给 ACC-D 泄压、拔销
core_asset:顶层:397.en: Bleed ACC-D and pull the pins first

core_asset:顶层:399.zh: 弹药被激光烤热或撞击引爆，一发带一发连锁，设备被炸坏
core_asset:顶层:399.en: rounds heated by the beam or knocked went off, setting off the rest, and blew the units apart

core_asset:顶层:400.zh: 动刀之前先开 FLV 注水，把弹库全打湿
core_asset:顶层:400.en: Open the flood valve (FLV) and wet the magazine before any cut

core_asset:顶层:402.zh: 作动器没锁就切了控制线，猛甩砸坏东西
core_asset:顶层:402.en: a ram's line cut with it unlocked: it jerked and hit what was near

core_asset:顶层:403.zh: 切线之前先拨 LK-T 锁住作动器
core_asset:顶层:403.en: Lock the rams (LK-T) before their lines

core_asset:顶层:405.zh: 电池还通着就从托架上拆，无人机醒来把自己甩出去撞坏
core_asset:顶层:405.en: freed with its pack live: it woke, spun up and threw itself into things

core_asset:顶层:406.zh: 拆之前先拨 PK 断开电池隔离开关
core_asset:顶层:406.en: Pack isolator off (PK) before you free it

core_asset:顶层:408.zh: 升降机带压上着销就拆了，弹出砸坏回收无人机
core_asset:顶层:408.en: the lift taken pinned and under pressure: it sprang into the recovery drone

core_asset:顶层:409.zh: 先给 ACC-G 泄压、拔销
core_asset:顶层:409.en: Bleed ACC-G and pull the pins first

core_asset:顶层:411.zh: 线圈带着储能失去冷却或动了支架，失超，能量瞬间放出，连锁到旁边的线圈
core_asset:顶层:411.en: a coil lost its cooling or a support with its energy still in: it quenched, and it ran into the coils beside it

core_asset:顶层:412.zh: 先开 DUMP 泄能、保持制冷，储能降到 5% 以下再断电、动支架
core_asset:顶层:412.en: Close the dump (DUMP) with the cooling kept on; power off and touch the supports only under 5%

core_asset:顶层:414.zh: 没撑船体就先拆了一边的引擎舱，重量压在另一边，船体扭曲
core_asset:顶层:414.en: one pod off with the support not set: the hull twisted under the other

core_asset:顶层:415.zh: 先拨 SUP 撑住船体，或者两台引擎舱一起拆
core_asset:顶层:415.en: Set the support (SUP) first, or take both pods together

core_asset:顶层:417.zh: 绞车和拖钳还带压上着销就拆了，弹出砸坏东西
core_asset:顶层:417.en: the winch and the jaws taken pinned and under pressure: they sprang

core_asset:顶层:418.zh: 先给蓄能器泄压、拔掉 WB 和 JL 销子
core_asset:顶层:418.en: Bleed the accumulators and pull the WB and JL pins first

core_asset:顶层:420.zh: 低温罐升压到泄压阀放不掉，罐体爆裂
core_asset:顶层:420.en: a cryo tank rose past what its relief valve could let go and burst

core_asset:顶层:421.zh: 冷机一直开着，先把 LNG 抽走再断电
core_asset:顶层:421.en: Keep the chillers running and draw the LNG off before the power

core_asset:顶层:423.zh: 隔离舱的污染空气扩散到干净舱，里面的设备要消毒，掉 1/4
core_asset:顶层:423.en: the isolation rooms' air reached a clean room: its equipment needs decontaminating, a quarter off

core_asset:顶层:424.zh: 隔离舱先用带滤网的回收软管抽空，生物危险品先封存，再开门
core_asset:顶层:424.en: Pump the isolation rooms out through the filter and seal the biohazards before any door opens

core_asset:顶层:426.zh: 机柜带着冷却液被吊出，液体洒了一地
core_asset:顶层:426.en: a rack lifted out with its tank still full: the fluid spilt

core_asset:顶层:427.zh: 吊机柜之前，先从它的 PT 口把罐抽干
core_asset:顶层:427.en: Drain a rack's tank at its PT port before you lift it

core_asset:顶层:429.zh: 旁边机柜洒出的冷却液让这一排短路
core_asset:顶层:429.en: fluid spilt from the next rack shorted this one

core_asset:顶层:430.zh: 每个机柜都先抽干再吊
core_asset:顶层:430.en: Drain every rack before you lift any

core_asset:顶层:432.zh: 水球炸散，鱼缸里的鱼全死了
core_asset:顶层:432.en: the ball burst and the fish died

core_asset:顶层:433.zh: 先从 PW 口抽水，水球缩到 12% 以下再动网罩
core_asset:顶层:433.en: Pump the ball down at PW below 12% before the net

core_asset:顶层:435.zh: 水球炸散，舱里的电气被泡坏
core_asset:顶层:435.en: the ball burst and soaked the room's electrics

core_asset:顶层:436.zh: 先抽水，再动网罩和支架
core_asset:顶层:436.en: Pump it down before the net or its frame

core_asset:顶层:438.zh: 堆芯还没冷下来就断了冷却或吊出，热震开裂
core_asset:顶层:438.en: the core lost its cooling or came out still hot: it cracked

core_asset:顶层:439.zh: 冷却泵一直有电，堆芯冷到 60°C 以下再动
core_asset:顶层:439.en: Keep the coolant pumps powered till the core is under 60 °C

core_asset:顶层:441.zh: 控制鼓没锁就吊堆芯，控制鼓滑出，一阵辐射
core_asset:顶层:441.en: the core lifted with a drum unlocked: the drum slipped, a burst of dose

core_asset:顶层:442.zh: 吊堆芯之前，四个 DL 锁全部拨上
core_asset:顶层:442.en: Throw all four drum locks (DL) before the core

core_asset:顶层:444.zh: 关了增压又放空了气垫，抽液时罐里成了真空，罐体被压瘪
core_asset:顶层:444.en: pressurisation shut and the ullage vented: drawing it pulled a vacuum and it buckled

core_asset:顶层:445.zh: 抽推进剂时增压阀 PV 一直开着，TV 和 NP 口别放空
core_asset:顶层:445.en: Keep the pressurisation (PV) open while drawing; never vent TV or NP

core_asset:顶层:447.zh: 总管抽空了主泵还在抽，干转受损
core_asset:顶层:447.en: the pump kept drawing a dry manifold and was damaged

core_asset:顶层:448.zh: 总管抽空就拔掉 PR 的软管
core_asset:顶层:448.en: Take the hose off PR once the manifold is dry

core_asset:顶层:450.zh: 冷舱断冷升到 −5°C 以上，疫苗解冻，只剩 45% 价值
core_asset:顶层:450.en: a cold hold warmed past −5 °C: the vaccines thawed, 45% of their worth left

core_asset:顶层:451.zh: 先接 COLD-X 临时制冷，或者让冷机一直有电，货卸完再断电
core_asset:顶层:451.en: Plug in COLD-X or keep the chillers powered till the cargo is out

core_asset:顶层:453.zh: 混合室还没过 30 K 就开了加热器，量子芯片热震开裂
core_asset:顶层:453.en: the heaters on before the mixing chamber passed 30 K: the chip cracked

core_asset:顶层:454.zh: 停脉管后先等混合室回到 30 K 以上，再开加热器 HEAT
core_asset:顶层:454.en: After the pulse tube stops, wait for the mixing chamber past 30 K before HEAT

core_asset:顶层:456.zh: 混合室还在 250 K 以下就切开或拆下冷台，芯片脆裂
core_asset:顶层:456.en: the stack cut or freed under 250 K: the chip cracked

core_asset:顶层:457.zh: 混合室回到 250 K 以上再拆冷台
core_asset:顶层:457.en: Wait for the mixing chamber past 250 K before the stack

core_asset:顶层:459.zh: 隔振台没锁，附近切割的震动传到芯片
core_asset:顶层:459.en: the isolation table floating, a cut close by shook the chip

core_asset:顶层:460.zh: 切制冷机附近之前，先拨 VI-LOCK 锁住隔振台
core_asset:顶层:460.en: Lock the isolation table (VI-LOCK) before you cut near the fridge

core_asset:顶层:462.zh: 混合气没回收就停了脉管，混合气沸散，冷台受损
core_asset:顶层:462.en: the pulse tube stopped with the mixture still in: it boiled off and hurt the stages

core_asset:顶层:463.zh: 先停循环 CIRC，接 G-MIX 把混合气抽到 20 kPa 以下，再停脉管 PT
core_asset:顶层:463.en: Circulation (CIRC) off, recover the mixture at G-MIX below 20 kPa, then the pulse tube (PT)

core_asset:顶层:465.zh: 箱子还锁在轨道上就把轨道切了，箱子被扯伤
core_asset:顶层:465.en: a rail cut with its box still locked on: the box was wrenched

core_asset:顶层:466.zh: 开门、拨轨道锁，让箱子自己沿轨道滑出
core_asset:顶层:466.en: Open the doors and throw the rail lock: the box runs out on its own

core_asset:顶层:468.zh: 箱子还锁着就动了吊挂，整组砸下来
core_asset:顶层:468.en: the hangers taken with the boxes still locked: the set came down

core_asset:顶层:469.en: Release the rails before the hangers

core_asset:顶层:471.zh: 拖臂还带着液压和销子就拆了枢轴，臂弹出砸坏拖头
core_asset:顶层:471.en: a pivot taken with the arm still pinned and under pressure: it sprang into the head

core_asset:顶层:472.zh: 先给蓄能器泄压、拔掉 PIN 销子，再拆拖臂
core_asset:顶层:472.en: Bleed the accumulator and pull the pins before the arm

core_asset:顶层:474.zh: 舱里有空气时切碳纤维壳，毒烟把电子件熏得掉价
core_asset:顶层:474.en: the carbon skin cut with air in the room: the smoke spoiled the electronics

core_asset:顶层:475.zh: 切壳之前先把舱室抽到真空，或者用维护工具拧下壳板
core_asset:顶层:475.en: Pump the room down before you cut the skin, or unbolt the panels

core_asset:顶层:477.zh: 主舱的富氧空气还在就切，闪燃把收藏烧坏
core_asset:顶层:477.en: cut with the oxygen-rich air still in: a flash fire scorched the collection

core_asset:顶层:478.zh: 先撬开 G-S，把主舱的富氧空气抽走再动刀
core_asset:顶层:478.en: Free G-S and pump the rich air out before any cut

core_asset:顶层:480.zh: 在精密玻璃旁边切割，玻璃被烤裂
core_asset:顶层:480.en: cutting beside the glazing crazed it

core_asset:顶层:481.zh: 玻璃用维护工具拧下来，别在旁边切
core_asset:顶层:481.en: Unbolt the glass; never cut beside it

core_asset:顶层:483.zh: 从 150°C 以上的区取出设备，热损掉价
core_asset:顶层:483.en: a unit taken out of a zone over 150 °C was heat-damaged

core_asset:顶层:484.zh: 接上冷却回路 COOL-S，等那一区降到 150°C 以下再取
core_asset:顶层:484.en: Plug in the cooling loop (COOL-S) and wait for the zone below 150 °C

core_asset:顶层:486.zh: 带气割破气囊，气囊撕开塌下来砸坏了设备
core_asset:顶层:486.en: a bag cut with gas in it ripped and came down on the units

core_asset:顶层:487.zh: 先接 BV 口把气囊放瘪，再切
core_asset:顶层:487.en: Let the bag down at its BV port before you cut

core_asset:顶层:489.zh: 张紧器还绷着就切了绑带，甩伤了设备
core_asset:顶层:489.en: a strap cut with its tensioner taut whipped into the units

core_asset:顶层:490.zh: 先拨 TN 松开张紧器，再切绑带
core_asset:顶层:490.en: Tensioner (TN) off before you cut its straps

core_asset:顶层:492.zh: 在镜子附近切割，金属粉尘落在没盖住的镜面上
core_asset:顶层:492.en: cutting close by dusted the uncovered coating

core_asset:顶层:493.zh: 切主镜附近的结构之前，先放下防尘罩 CVR
core_asset:顶层:493.en: Run the dust cover (CVR) down before you cut near the mirror

core_asset:顶层:495.zh: 支撑器没锁就取下镜片，镜片掉出镜座摔裂
core_asset:顶层:495.en: taken off unlocked, the segment dropped out of its seat and cracked

core_asset:顶层:496.zh: 取镜片之前，先给控制柜 MCC 供电，合上三圈支撑器锁
core_asset:顶层:496.en: Power the mirror cabinet (MCC) and lock all three rings before you take a segment

core_asset:顶层:498.zh: 里圈先取走了，外圈镜片的边没了支撑，崩了
core_asset:顶层:498.en: an inner segment taken first: the outer one's edge lost its support and chipped

core_asset:顶层:499.zh: 从外圈往里取：先取外圈

core_asset:顶层:501.zh: 船头侧的锁先开了、船尾还锁着：小船撬起撞上船首门，溢价砍半、设备磕坏
core_asset:顶层:501.en: a bow-side lock let go with one aft still holding: it lurched into the bow door, half the premium gone, its fittings knocked

core_asset:顶层:502.zh: 托架锁从船尾往船首依次解：CL-1 → CL-4
core_asset:顶层:502.en: The cradle locks from the stern forward: CL-1 → CL-4

core_asset:顶层:504.zh: 切到或拆下了小船的船壳，整船溢价没了
core_asset:顶层:504.en: its hull cut or taken off: no longer whole, the premium gone

core_asset:顶层:505.zh: 小船的船壳一刀都别碰：只切载舰的结构
core_asset:顶层:505.en: Never touch its hull: cut only the carrier's structure

core_asset:顶层:507.zh: 外侧还满着就卸空了里侧一列，箱梁折弯，外侧的箱被砸坏
core_asset:顶层:507.en: an inner bay emptied with the bays beyond it full: the wall kinked, the boxes beyond it damaged

core_asset:顶层:508.zh: 从两端往中间卸；要先卸里侧，先用撑杆顶住外侧
core_asset:顶层:508.en: From the ends inwards; to take an inner bay first, prop the outer bays

core_asset:顶层:510.zh: 从一列下面先抽了箱，上面的箱压下来受损
core_asset:顶层:510.en: a box taken from under others: the stack above sagged onto it

core_asset:顶层:511.en: Each bay from the top down

core_asset:顶层:513.zh: 拉杆还绷着就切了，弹开砸坏了箱子
core_asset:顶层:513.en: a rod cut still tight whipped into the boxes

core_asset:顶层:514.zh: 切拉杆之前先松它的花篮螺丝
core_asset:顶层:514.en: Slacken a rod's turnbuckle before you cut it

core_asset:顶层:516.zh: 矿仓在料位线下开了口，细矿洒了出去，一分不算
core_asset:顶层:516.en: the hopper opened below the heap: the fines poured out, unpaid

core_asset:顶层:517.zh: 切矿仓壁之前，先开放料门把矿放到破口以下
core_asset:顶层:517.en: Before you cut a hopper wall, run the ore out through the gates below it

core_asset:顶层:519.zh: 矿还剩一半以上就撬开放料门，一边倾泻撕裂了矿仓焊缝
core_asset:顶层:519.en: a gate forced with the hopper half full: it all went one way and tore the welds

core_asset:顶层:520.zh: 放料门用开关正常打开；要撬门，先把矿放到一半以下
core_asset:顶层:520.en: Open the gates by their switches; to force one, run the ore below half first

core_asset:顶层:522.zh: 带着张力切断皮带，皮带弹回打坏了设备
core_asset:顶层:522.en: the belt cut under tension whipped back into the line

core_asset:顶层:523.zh: 先断皮带电机、松张紧螺栓 TEN-1，再拆皮带
core_asset:顶层:523.en: Stop the belt motor and slacken TEN-1 before you take the belt off

core_asset:顶层:525.zh: 设备被激光切穿，成了废料
core_asset:顶层:525.en: the beam went through a unit: scrap now

core_asset:顶层:526.zh: 看清设备在哪：沿它四周的焊点和螺栓切，别穿过设备本体
core_asset:顶层:526.en: See where the unit sits: cut round it at its welds and bolts, never through it

core_asset:顶层:528.zh: 设备在搬运中撞上了东西
core_asset:顶层:528.en: a unit knocked into something on the way

core_asset:顶层:529.zh: 搬设备时放慢，绕开船体和别的碎件
core_asset:顶层:529.en: Go slow with a unit and keep it clear of the hull and loose pieces

core_asset:顶层:531.zh: 带压的气瓶被切开，爆裂波及了旁边的设备
core_asset:顶层:531.en: a vessel under pressure cut open: its burst hit the units round it

core_asset:顶层:532.zh: 切之前先把气瓶泄压放空
core_asset:顶层:532.en: Vent the vessels before you cut near them

core_asset:顶层:534.zh: 危险品爆燃，波及了旁边的设备
core_asset:顶层:534.en: dangerous goods went up and hit the units round them

core_asset:顶层:535.zh: 推进剂舱先放空、通风，再动刀
core_asset:顶层:535.en: Drain and vent the propellant before you cut

core_asset:顶层:537.zh: 切开带油的管子起火，烧坏了设备
core_asset:顶层:537.en: a pipe cut wet caught fire and burnt the units

core_asset:顶层:538.zh: 切燃料管之前先关阀、抽空
core_asset:顶层:538.en: Shut and drain a fuel line before you cut it

core_asset:顶层:540.zh: 镜片在搬运中撞上了东西
core_asset:顶层:540.en: a segment knocked into something on the way

core_asset:顶层:541.zh: 镜片很脆：抓着走时放慢，绕开船体
core_asset:顶层:541.en: The glass is brittle: go slow with it and keep clear of the hull

core_asset:card:2.zh: 需要吊车：船坞还没修好吊车
core_asset:card:2.en: NEEDS THE CRANE: NOT BUILT YET

core_asset:_sail_board:7.zh: 拨 %s 松开绞盘刹车再收卷
core_asset:_sail_board:7.en: %s off to slacken it before winding

core_asset:_sail_board:8.zh: 未接地：拨 %s 接地，否则收卷会被静电击穿
core_asset:_sail_board:8.en: NOT EARTHED: %s ON, OR WINDING PINHOLES

core_asset:_mirror_board:1.zh: 防尘罩没放下：拨 %s 放下，附近切割会污染镜面
core_asset:_mirror_board:1.en: COVER UP: %s TO LOWER IT; CUTTING CLOSE BY DUSTS THE MIRROR

core_asset:_mirror_board:5.zh: 拨 %s 合锁（控制柜 %s 上）

core_asset:_mirror_board:6.zh: 先给控制柜接电，再拨 %s 合锁
core_asset:_mirror_board:6.en: power the cabinet, then %s to lock

core_asset:_sail_review:1.zh: 已送设备口，放上零件架
core_asset:_sail_review:1.en: TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH, ON THE PARTS RACK

core_asset:_sail_review:2.zh: 还挂在绞盘上，按废料算

core_asset:_sail_review:3.zh: 光帆没有收卷，按废料只值约 %s；整帆收回最多值 %s
core_asset:_sail_review:3.en: The sail was not furled: as scrap it fetched about %s; whole, up to %s

core_asset:_sail_review:4.zh: 收成 %d 卷帆材，值 %s（满价 %s），都已送走
core_asset:_sail_review:4.en: %d rolls made, worth %s (whole sail %s), all sent

core_asset:_sail_review:5.zh: 收成 %d 卷帆材，值 %s（满价 %s）；只送走了 %s，挂在绞盘上的按废料算
core_asset:_sail_review:5.en: %d rolls made, worth %s (whole sail %s); only %s sent, the rest on the winches counts as scrap

core_asset:_sail_review:6.zh: 还有角没收：四个角都收完，光帆才值满价
core_asset:_sail_review:6.en: Corners left unfurled: all four rolled is the full price

core_asset:_sail_review:7.zh: 干净利落。下次可以同时开两个角的收帆电机，省时间
core_asset:_sail_review:7.en: Clean work. Next time run two corners' motors at once to save time

core_asset:_sail_review:8.zh: 下次试试整帆收卷：先接地，松开四个角的刹车，再开收帆电机
core_asset:_sail_review:8.en: Next time furl it: earth it, let the four brakes off, then the furling motors

core_asset:_mirror_review:2.zh: 已送走 %d 片，船上 %d 片

core_asset:_mirror_review:4.zh: 干净利落。下次可以试试按背板分块吊，省时间
core_asset:_mirror_review:4.en: Clean work. Next time try a backplane at a time: quicker

core_asset:_mirror_review:5.zh: 镜片还在船上：取下来送设备口才算钱
core_asset:_mirror_review:5.en: The segments are still aboard: they pay only once in a mouth

core_asset:_equip_board:3.zh: 船还没安全：先泄压、放空再动刀；电要留到最后断
core_asset:_equip_board:3.en: NOT SAFE YET: VENT AND DRAIN BEFORE YOU CUT; THE POWER GOES LAST

core_asset:_equip_board:4.zh: 船还没安全：先断电、泄压、放空再动刀
core_asset:_equip_board:4.en: NOT SAFE YET: POWER OFF, VENT, DRAIN BEFORE YOU CUT

core_asset:_ship_warn:1.zh: 隔振台没锁：附近切割会震伤芯片（拨 VI-LOCK）
core_asset:_ship_warn:1.en: ISOLATION TABLE FLOATING: A CUT CLOSE BY SHAKES THE CHIP (VI-LOCK)

core_asset:_ship_warn:2.zh: 混合室 %s：回到 250 K 以上才能拆冷台
core_asset:_ship_warn:2.en: MIXING CHAMBER %s: NOT THE STACK TILL PAST 250 K

core_asset:_ship_warn:3.zh: 拖头残磁 %.0f mT：会吸住无人机和碎件（断开 K-H 后拨 DEGAUSS）
core_asset:_ship_warn:3.en: TOW HEADS AT %.0f mT: THEY PULL THE DRONE IN (K-H OFF, THEN DEGAUSS)

core_asset:_ship_warn:4.zh: 拖臂还带压上着销：先给 ACC 泄压、拔 PIN 再拆
core_asset:_ship_warn:4.en: ARMS PINNED UNDER PRESSURE: BLEED ACC, PULL THE PINS FIRST

core_asset:_ship_warn:5.zh: %s 有毒烟：电子件在掉价（接气口抽走空气）
core_asset:_ship_warn:5.en: SMOKE IN %s: THE ELECTRONICS ARE SPOILING (PUMP IT OUT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:6.zh: 舱里还有空气：切碳纤维壳会冒毒烟（先抽真空，或拧螺栓拆壳板）
core_asset:_ship_warn:6.en: AIR ABOARD: CUTTING THE CARBON SKIN SMOKES (PUMP DOWN, OR UNBOLT THE PANELS)

core_asset:_ship_warn:7.zh: %s 富氧 %d%%：附近切割会闪燃（撬开 G-S，抽走空气）
core_asset:_ship_warn:7.en: %s AT %d%% OXYGEN: A CUT CLOSE BY FLASHES OVER (FREE G-S, PUMP IT OUT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:8.zh: 仪器所在区 %.0f°C：150°C 以下再取（接 COOL-S 降得快）
core_asset:_ship_warn:8.en: THE INSTRUMENTS' ZONE AT %.0f °C: TAKE THEM BELOW 150 (COOL-S COOLS IT FASTER)

core_asset:_ship_warn:9.zh: %d 个气囊还鼓着：带气切会塌下砸设备（接 BV 口放气）
core_asset:_ship_warn:9.en: %d BAGS STILL UP: CUT ONE AND IT COMES DOWN ON THE UNITS (LET IT DOWN AT ITS BV)

core_asset:_ship_warn:10.zh: %d 个张紧器还绷着：切绑带会甩（先拨 TN 松开）
core_asset:_ship_warn:10.en: %d TENSIONERS TAUT: A STRAP CUT WHIPS (TN OFF FIRST)

core_asset:_ship_warn:11.zh: 线圈还储着 %d%% 的能：开 DUMP 泄能、保持制冷，降到 5%% 以下再断电动支架
core_asset:_ship_warn:11.en: THE COILS HOLD %d%% OF THEIR ENERGY: DUMP IT WITH THE COOLING ON, UNDER 5%% BEFORE POWER OR SUPPORTS

core_asset:_ship_warn:12.zh: 有线圈断了冷却：%.1f K，过 %.0f K 就失超（冷箱要有电、液氦要够）
core_asset:_ship_warn:12.en: A COIL HAS LOST ITS COOLING: %.1f K, IT QUENCHES PAST %.0f K (THE COLD BOX POWERED, HELIUM IN IT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:13.zh: 船体没撑住：先拨 %s，或者两台引擎舱一起拆，否则先拆一边船体会扭
core_asset:_ship_warn:13.en: THE HULL ISN'T PROPPED: SET %s, OR TAKE BOTH PODS TOGETHER, OR IT TWISTS

core_asset:_ship_warn:14.zh: 绞车和拖钳还带压上着销：先给蓄能器泄压、拔销再拆
core_asset:_ship_warn:14.en: WINCH AND JAWS PINNED UNDER PRESSURE: BLEED, UNPIN, THEN TAKE

core_asset:_ship_warn:15.zh: %s 压力 %.0f kPa：快到泄压线了（先抽 LNG）
core_asset:_ship_warn:15.en: %s AT %.0f kPa: NEAR ITS RELIEF (DRAW THE LNG OFF)

core_asset:_ship_warn:16.zh: 冷机没电：LNG 在升温沸散（冷机要一直开到抽完）
core_asset:_ship_warn:16.en: THE CHILLERS ARE DEAD: THE LNG IS WARMING (KEEP THEM RUNNING TILL IT IS OFF)

core_asset:_ship_warn:17.zh: %d 件生物危险品没封存：动之前先拨它的 SB / SF / SL 封存
core_asset:_ship_warn:17.en: %d BIOHAZARDS UNSEALED: SEAL EACH (SB / SF / SL) BEFORE IT MOVES

core_asset:_ship_warn:18.zh: 隔离舱 %s 还有污染空气：开门前用回收软管（带滤网）抽空
core_asset:_ship_warn:18.en: ISOLATION ROOM %s STILL HOLDS ITS AIR: PUMP IT OUT THROUGH THE FILTER BEFORE ANY DOOR

core_asset:_ship_warn:19.zh: %d 个机柜罐里还有冷却液：带液吊会洒、短路旁边的机柜（先从 PT 口抽干）
core_asset:_ship_warn:19.en: %d RACKS STILL IN FLUID: LIFTED WET THEY SPILL AND SHORT THE NEXT (DRAIN AT PT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:20.zh: %d 块客户硬盘没上锁：先拨 CUST 锁进屏蔽舱，否则按违约罚款
core_asset:_ship_warn:20.en: %d CLIENT DRIVES NOT LATCHED: CUST FIRST, OR IT IS A FINED BREACH

core_asset:_ship_warn:21.zh: 水球还有 %d%%：切网罩或拆支架会炸散（先从 PW 口抽到 12%% 以下）
core_asset:_ship_warn:21.en: THE BALL IS AT %d%%: CUT ITS NET OR FRAME AND IT BURSTS (PUMP IT BELOW 12%% AT PW)

core_asset:_ship_warn:22.zh: %s 富氧 %d%%：附近切割会闪燃（接 G-%s 抽空）
core_asset:_ship_warn:22.en: %s AT %d%% OXYGEN: A CUT CLOSE BY FLASHES OVER (PUMP IT OUT AT G-%s)

core_asset:_ship_warn:23.zh: %d 个控制鼓没锁：吊堆芯会滑出（拨 DL 锁上）
core_asset:_ship_warn:23.en: %d DRUMS UNLOCKED: THE CORE LIFTED, ONE SLIPS (THROW THE DL LOCKS)

core_asset:_ship_warn:24.zh: 堆芯 %.0f°C：冷却泵要一直有电，60°C 以下才能动它和散热片
core_asset:_ship_warn:24.en: THE CORE AT %.0f °C: KEEP THE COOLANT PUMPS POWERED, NOTHING MOVES TILL UNDER 60

core_asset:_ship_warn:25.zh: 无人机剂量 %.0f / %.0f mSv：在屏蔽板的阴影里干活；激光绝不碰堆芯
core_asset:_ship_warn:25.en: DRONE DOSE %.0f / %.0f mSv: WORK IN THE SHIELD'S SHADOW; NEVER LET THE BEAM TOUCH THE CORE

core_asset:_ship_warn:26.zh: 推进剂还有 %.1f：先抽走（主泵经 PR，N2O4 单独走 LD-2）；切管 MMH 和 N2O4 会自燃
core_asset:_ship_warn:26.en: %.1f OF PROPELLANT ABOARD: DRAW IT OFF (THE PUMP AT PR, THE N2O4 ALONE AT LD-2); CUT A LINE AND THEY IGNITE

core_asset:_ship_warn:27.zh: 增压阀 PV 一直开着，TV 和 NP 口别放空：否则罐会抽瘪
core_asset:_ship_warn:27.en: KEEP THE PV VALVES OPEN AND NEVER VENT TV OR NP: A TANK BUCKLES

core_asset:_ship_warn:28.zh: 冷舱 %s 在升温：%.0f°C，−5°C 以上就解冻（接 COLD-X，或让冷机有电）
core_asset:_ship_warn:28.en: HOLD %s IS WARMING: %.0f °C, THAWS PAST −5 (COLD-X, OR KEEP THE CHILLERS POWERED)

core_asset:_ship_warn:29.zh: %d 个逃生舱点火电路还活着：松夹前先拨 ARM 断开（或拔引线）
core_asset:_ship_warn:29.en: %d PODS STILL ARMED: ARM OFF (OR THE LEAD PULLED) BEFORE THE CLAMPS

core_asset:_ship_warn:30.zh: 居住舱还有 %.0f kPa：先抽到 20 kPa 以下再松夹，否则会弹出
core_asset:_ship_warn:30.en: THE HABITAT HOLDS %.0f kPa: BELOW 20 BEFORE THE CLAMPS, OR IT SPRINGS

core_asset:_ship_warn:31.zh: 液压夹按对角顺序交替松：HC-U1 → HC-L4 → HC-U4 → HC-L1 → …
core_asset:_ship_warn:31.en: THE CLAMPS CROSSWISE: HC-U1 → HC-L4 → HC-U4 → HC-L1 → …

core_asset:_ship_warn:32.zh: 融水积了 %.1f m³：到 %.0f m³ 带电就短路（接 PW 泵走）
core_asset:_ship_warn:32.en: %.1f m³ OF MELTWATER STANDING: PAST %.0f m³ IT SHORTS (PUMP IT AT PW)

core_asset:_ship_warn:33.zh: 冰还剩 %d%%：化到一半以下再松鞍座 PH，裂缝上的冰别切
core_asset:_ship_warn:33.en: %d%% OF THE ICE LEFT: NO SEAT (PH) TILL UNDER HALF, NEVER CUT THE BLOCKS ON THE CRACK

core_asset:_ship_warn:34.zh: 炉芯 %.0f°C：换热泵要一直有电，150°C 以下才能吊
core_asset:_ship_warn:34.en: THE CORE AT %.0f °C: KEEP THE PUMPS POWERED, NOT OUT TILL UNDER 150

core_asset:_ship_warn:35.zh: 进料臂还带压上着销：先给 ACC-F 泄压、拔销
core_asset:_ship_warn:35.en: THE FEED ARM IS PINNED UNDER PRESSURE: BLEED ACC-F, UNPIN

core_asset:_ship_warn:36.zh: %d 发弹药还活着：激光靠近会烤到殉爆、撞击会爆（开 FLV 注水打湿弹库）
core_asset:_ship_warn:36.en: %d ROUNDS LIVE: THE BEAM COOKS THEM OFF, A KNOCK SETS THEM OFF (OPEN FLV, WET THE MAGAZINE)

core_asset:_ship_warn:37.zh: %d 架无人机电池还通着：拆之前先拨 PK 断开，否则会醒来甩飞
core_asset:_ship_warn:37.en: %d DRONES ON LIVE PACKS: PK OFF FIRST, OR THEY WAKE AND THROW THEMSELVES

core_asset:_ship_warn:38.zh: 货还锁在轨道上：先解锁再动吊挂、轨道和甲板
core_asset:_ship_warn:38.en: THE CARGO IS LOCKED ON ITS RAILS: RELEASE IT BEFORE THE HANGERS, RAILS OR DECK

core_asset:_ship_warn:39.zh: 两个货罐还有货：总线断开前先从 PT-2、PT-5 抽空（泵要有电）
core_asset:_ship_warn:39.en: CARGO IN THE TANKS: DRAIN AT PT-2 AND PT-5 BEFORE THE BUS GOES (THE PUMPS NEED IT)

core_asset:_ship_warn:40.zh: K-4 车钩卡死承着弯：后面 %.0f t 拆完前别动 K-4 和它的销子
core_asset:_ship_warn:40.en: K-4 HOLDS THE BEND: %.0f t AFT OF IT, LEAVE K-4 AND ITS PINS TILL THAT IS OFF

core_asset:_ship_warn:41.zh: 钻杆还有 %d%% 扭矩：先拨 TQB 泄扭
core_asset:_ship_warn:41.en: %d%% TORQUE IN THE STRING: BLEED IT AT TQB

core_asset:_ship_warn:42.zh: 泥浆还有 %d%%（%.0f kPa）：接 PMUD 放掉
core_asset:_ship_warn:42.en: MUD AT %d%% (%.0f kPa): LET IT OUT AT PMUD

core_asset:_ship_warn:43.zh: 飞轮还在转 %.0f rpm：开 CV 冷却再拨 BR 刹车，降到 300 以下再拆
core_asset:_ship_warn:43.en: A WHEEL AT %.0f rpm: COOLING (CV), THEN THE BRAKE (BR), UNDER 300 BEFORE IT COMES OFF

core_asset:_ship_warn:44.zh: 导轨还绷着：张紧器从尾往头逐个松
core_asset:_ship_warn:44.en: THE RAILS ARE TENSIONED: LET THE TENSIONERS OFF TAIL FIRST

core_asset:_ship_warn:45.zh: 制冷机没电：罐压在升，升到泄压线就放空掉货
core_asset:_ship_warn:45.en: THE COOLERS ARE DEAD: THE TANKS ARE CLIMBING TO THEIR RELIEFS

growth:顶层:8.zh: 承受的所有伤害；越低越耐用。
growth:顶层:8.en: All incoming damage; lower means tougher.

growth:顶层:10.zh: 巡航、冲刺、加速和制动同步增强。
growth:顶层:10.en: Cruise, boost, acceleration and braking improve together.

growth:顶层:12.zh: 电弧和带电拔线伤害；仍需断电。
growth:顶层:12.en: Arc and live unplug damage; isolate power first.

growth:顶层:14.zh: 材料内的实际切割速度。
growth:顶层:14.en: Actual beam travel speed through material.

growth:顶层:16.zh: 切口半径；更少材料被烧掉，仍会切断管线。
growth:顶层:16.en: Kerf radius; wastes less metal, still severs lines.

growth:顶层:18.zh: 烫伤、火焰和爆燃对无人机的伤害。
growth:顶层:18.en: Scald, fire and combustion damage to the drone.

growth:顶层:20.zh: 提高可牵引吨位；高阶同时增强最大牵引力。
growth:顶层:20.en: Raises the mass limit; advanced volumes also strengthen towing force.

growth:顶层:22.zh: 抓取、拖曳目标和断绳距离同步增加。
growth:顶层:22.en: Acquisition, towing target and snap distance grow together.

growth:顶层:25.zh: 按 X 切换单体/范围：一次抓起半径内的多件散料，各自保持质量和碰撞；每阶件数、半径、总承重和稳定性一起提高。
growth:顶层:25.en: X switches single/field: catch several loose pieces within a radius at once, each keeping its mass and collisions; each volume adds pieces, radius, total mass and steadiness.

growth:顶层:27.zh: 增加牵引阻尼并减轻无人机受到的反作用力。
growth:顶层:27.en: More tether damping and less recoil on the drone.

growth:顶层:29.zh: 牵引力更大，重物拖得更快；无人机受到的拖拽更小。
growth:顶层:29.en: More towing force: heavy loads move faster and drag the drone less.

growth:顶层:31.zh: 可见目标的读数距离；不透视未打开的舱室。
growth:顶层:31.en: Probe visible targets farther away; no seeing through sealed rooms.

growth:顶层:33.zh: 检测耗时；首级含原精密套件，可查裂纹和设备状况。读数仍会过期。
growth:顶层:33.en: Probe time; volume I includes crack and condition inspection. Readings can still go stale.

growth:顶层:35.zh: 每条软管的气体与液体回收速度。
growth:顶层:35.en: Gas and liquid recovery speed for each attached hose.

growth:顶层:37.zh: 远处接口的接管距离；已接软管照常独立工作。
growth:顶层:37.en: Connect more distant ports; attached hoses keep working independently.

growth:顶层:39.zh: 螺栓、锁、夹具、接头及控制件的操作速度。
growth:顶层:39.en: Operate bolts, locks, clamps, connectors and controls faster.

growth:顶层:41.zh: 每份维修剂的恢复量；机库维修依旧免费。
growth:顶层:41.en: Integrity restored per repair kit; bay repair remains free.

growth:顶层:43.zh: 一次扳手动作同时处理同一部件上相邻的多颗固定件。
growth:顶层:43.en: One wrench pass handles several fixings on the same unit at once.

growth:buy:1.zh: 技能书已停用：数值卷已退款，能力来自工程成果与消耗件。
growth:buy:1.en: The skill book is withdrawn: its volumes were refunded; abilities come from achievements and parts.

txt:in_wrong_valve.zh: 货舱实际压力 %d kPa；测压口 P-C01 的隔离阀 V-C01 关闭
txt:in_wrong_valve.en: HOLD AT %d kPa; TEST PORT P-C01 ISOLATED BY CLOSED V-C01

txt:in_fake_stop.zh: G-01 远程停机指令无效，发电机仍在运转
txt:in_fake_stop.en: G-01 IGNORES THE REMOTE STOP: STILL RUNNING

txt:in_hidden_tank.zh: 货舱内有一只未登记储气罐，%d kPa
txt:in_hidden_tank.en: UNDECLARED GAS BOTTLE IN THE HOLD AT %d kPa

txt:in_live_cargo.zh: %s 自带电源 230 V，接在船体插座上
txt:in_live_cargo.en: %s HAS ITS OWN 230 V SUPPLY, PLUGGED INTO THE HULL

txt:in_welded_hatch.zh: 货舱门门缝已焊死，舱门驱动不可用
txt:in_welded_hatch.en: CARGO HATCH SEAMS WELDED: THE DRIVE WILL NOT MOVE IT

txt:in_rerouted_line.zh: 冷却管 Q2 改道，走 D 舱顶板下方
txt:in_rerouted_line.en: COOLANT RUN Q2 REROUTED UNDER THE ENGINE ROOM ROOF

txt:in_second_source.zh: 尾部装有应急发电机 EG-01，独立向母线供电
txt:in_second_source.en: EMERGENCY GENERATOR EG-01 AT THE STERN FEEDS THE BUS

txt:in_hidden_damage.zh: 货舱顶板距船首约 %d m 处有结构暗伤
txt:in_hidden_damage.en: HOLD ROOF PLATE ABOUT %d m FROM THE BOW HAS A HIDDEN CRACK

txt:in_bio_breach.zh: 隔离舱 %s 负压阀失效：舱内 %d kPa，高于主廊，空气污染严重
txt:in_bio_breach.en: ISOLATION POD %s HAS LOST ITS NEGATIVE PRESSURE: %d kPa, ABOVE THE CORRIDOR, AIR BADLY CONTAMINATED

txt:in_fire_system.zh: 灭火剂储罐 FX-01 未释放，%d kPa
txt:in_fire_system.en: FIRE BOTTLE FX-01 NEVER DISCHARGED: %d kPa

nuke:_draw_ui:4.zh: 冲击掠过 · 尚未建成

nuke:_draw_card:1.zh: 堆 芯 核 爆

nuke:_draw_card:2.zh: 激光切穿了堆芯中心的核心。合同作废。
nuke:_draw_card:2.en: THE BEAM CUT THE CORE'S HEART. THE CONTRACT IS VOID.

txt:fa_rail_d.zh: 熔炉口装上导轨：现场按 M，把它沿长槽挪到无人机正下方
txt:fa_rail_d.en: THE FURNACE MOUTH ON A RAIL: PRESS M ON SITE TO RUN IT UNDER THE DRONE

txt:fa_net_d.zh: 自动收进碎屑网的碎片上限 0.1 t → 0.5 t
txt:fa_net_d.en: WHAT GOES STRAIGHT TO THE NET: 0.1 t → 0.5 t

txt:fa_berth120_d.zh: 地板、集料槽和吊臂再延长到约 120 m，83–114 m 的船从此可以接（要先有 88 m）
txt:fa_berth120_d.en: FLOOR, TROUGH AND BOOM ON TO ABOUT 120 m: SHIPS OF 83-114 m CAN BE TAKEN (NEEDS THE 88 m FIRST)

txt:fa_berth200_d.zh: 整条船坞延长到约 200 m，115–194 m 的大船从此可以接（要先有 120 m）
txt:fa_berth200_d.en: THE WHOLE BERTH TO ABOUT 200 m: BIG SHIPS OF 115-194 m CAN BE TAKEN (NEEDS THE 120 m FIRST)

txt:fa_berth620_d.zh: 整条船坞延长到约 620 m，整艘殖民舰可以进坞拆解（要先有 200 m）
txt:fa_berth620_d.en: THE WHOLE BERTH TO ABOUT 620 m: A WHOLE COLONY SHIP CAN COME IN (NEEDS THE 200 m FIRST)

txt:fa_berth_d.zh: 地板、集料槽和吊臂延长到约 88 m，58–82 m 的船从此可以接；回收口挪到中段
txt:fa_berth_d.en: FLOOR, TROUGH AND BOOM TO ABOUT 88 m: SHIPS OF 58–82 m CAN BE TAKEN; MOUTHS MOVE MID-BERTH

txt:fa_hauler_d.zh: 现场用 %s 给漂浮零件打标记，它自己送到该去的回收口（1.5 t 以内）
txt:fa_hauler_d.en: USE %s ON A FLOATING PIECE: IT TAKES IT TO THE RIGHT MOUTH (UP TO 1.5 t)

txt:fa_hauler2_d.zh: 和第一台分着搬同一张标记清单（需先有初级搬运无人机）
txt:fa_hauler2_d.en: WORKS THE SAME MARKS AS THE FIRST (NEEDS THE BASIC HAULER)

txt:fa_crane_d.zh: 船坞顶上的门式吊，12 t 以内整件吊走；用 %s 标记超过 1.5 t 的件
txt:fa_crane_d.en: OVERHEAD GANTRY: LIFTS UP TO 12 t WHOLE; USE %s TO MARK ANYTHING OVER 1.5 t FOR IT

txt:fa_port2_d.zh: 在船坞远端上方再开一个设备口，长船后半截不用绕远
txt:fa_port2_d.en: A SECOND EQUIPMENT MOUTH OVER THE FAR END: NO LONG TRIP FROM A LONG SHIP'S STERN

txt:fa_buffer_d.zh: 近端上方的停放台：放在上面的件被牵引场定住，等你或机器来取
txt:fa_buffer_d.en: A PARKING DECK OVER THE NEAR END: WHAT YOU LEAVE ON IT STAYS PUT

txt:fa_zones_d.zh: 现场按 K 划禁入区（最多 3 个），机械不进去；在区内再按 K 取消
txt:fa_zones_d.en: PRESS K TO SET A KEEP-OUT ZONE (UP TO 3) NO MACHINE ENTERS; K INSIDE ONE CLEARS IT

txt:fa_arm_d.zh: 悬臂自动把废金属送进熔炉（初级：慢、1 t 以内）
txt:fa_arm_d.en: THE BOOM FEEDS SCRAP TO THE FURNACE (BASIC: SLOW, UP TO 1 t)

txt:fa_drone2_d.zh: 搬运无人机：标记漂浮零件和回收口，它自己送
txt:fa_drone2_d.en: HAULER: TAG A FLOATING PART AND A MOUTH, IT DELIVERS

txt:fa_scan_d.en: HOVER SHOWS WHAT A PART IS WORTH

gear:fa_gas_line.zh: 气体线（净化分离 · 压缩）

gear:fa_gas_line_d.zh: 回收的混合气在加工区净化、分离成氧和氮；拆船抽回的气不再当场折现，而是成批入库。
gear:fa_gas_line_d.en: Recovered mixed gas is purified and split into oxygen and nitrogen; a ship's gas is kept as a batch, not cashed.

gear:fa_lox_tank_d.zh: 把氧液化存进 20 吨低温储罐，卖给过路货船；储罐一直漏热，冷箱要有电。
gear:fa_lox_tank_d.en: Liquefies oxygen into a 20 t cryogenic tank for passing freighters; the tank leaks heat, the cold box needs power.

txt:rt_all_done.en: EVERYTHING ON THE ROUTE IS YOURS

txt:rt_market_after.zh: 做完主线第一单后开放
txt:rt_market_after.en: Opens after the first story job

txt:rt_tier_d.zh: 每种技能的这一卷都要攒够完成的合同和声望才能买
txt:rt_tier_d.en: Every skill's volume needs enough jobs done and reputation first

txt:rt_ship_then.zh: 条件都达到后，这种船就会出现在合同市场
txt:rt_ship_then.en: Once every condition is met, this type turns up on the contract market

txt:rt_ship_done.zh: 已经会出现在合同市场 · 拆过 %d 艘
txt:rt_ship_done.en: Already on the contract market · stripped %d

txt:rt_ship_tug.zh: 小船入门：电池、氧气、燃料管线
txt:rt_ship_tug.en: A small first job: battery, oxygen, fuel line

txt:rt_ship_s09.zh: 紧凑布局、精密设备、高价值小件
txt:rt_ship_s09.en: Compact layout, precision equipment, small valuable parts

txt:rt_ship_gr7.zh: 标准货船：货舱、货柜、冷却与燃料系统
txt:rt_ship_gr7.en: The standard freighter: hold, containers, cooling and fuel

txt:rt_ship_pod.zh: 整舱货柜，危险品要走危险品口
txt:rt_ship_pod.en: A hold of containers; hazardous cargo goes to the hazard port

txt:rt_ship_h22.zh: 外置双拖臂、液压站与蓄能器、残磁拖头
txt:rt_ship_h22.en: Twin outboard tow arms, hydraulics and accumulator, magnetised tow heads

txt:rt_ship_m14.zh: 超重设备、结构拆分、松散矿物
txt:rt_ship_m14.en: Overweight equipment, structural splitting, loose ore

txt:rt_ship_fr26.zh: 储罐温度、低温设备、热交换
txt:rt_ship_fr26.en: Tank temperatures, cryogenic equipment, heat exchange

txt:rt_ship_med47.zh: 12 个独立医疗舱、多隔离区
txt:rt_ship_med47.en: Twelve sealed medical bays, several isolation zones

txt:tm_onsite_note.zh: 技能书立即装配；原设备与设施下一单生效。Esc 回到作业
txt:tm_onsite_note.en: MANUAL VOLUMES FIT NOW; EQUIPMENT AND FACILITIES FIT NEXT JOB. Esc BACK TO WORK

txt:tm_onsite_no.en: NOT IN THE MIDDLE OF A JOB

txt:tm_next_d.zh: 主线开局的下一单，随时可以接；想先做旁边的合同也行，它一直留在这里。
txt:tm_next_d.en: The opening's next job: take it whenever you like. It stays pinned here while you work the other offers.

txt:tm_lock_equip.zh: 设备和设施下一单才生效：两单之间开放
txt:tm_lock_equip.en: Equipment and facilities fit next job: open between jobs

txt:tm_tile_route.zh: 接下来能解锁的船、设备和设施
txt:tm_tile_route.en: SHIPS, EQUIPMENT AND FACILITIES TO COME

txt:tm_keys_berth.zh: 1–3 应用 · ←→↑↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · O 设置 · Esc 回首页 / 回到船坞
txt:tm_keys_berth.en: 1–3 APPS · ARROWS CHOOSE · Enter CONFIRM · O SETTINGS · Esc HOME / BACK TO THE BERTH

txt:tm_next_first_d.zh: 开局第一单由船坞指派；拆完它合同市场就开放，之后可以自己挑船。
txt:tm_next_first_d.en: The first job is assigned. Once it is done the contract market opens and you pick your own ships.

txt:tm_st_3.zh: 账本  资金 / 贷款 / 应付 ......... 正常

txt:tm_st_4.zh: 市场数据  合同报价 ............... 正常

txt:tm_next_side.zh: 开工前可以按 2 打开「船坞」修设施，按 3 打开「拆法与建设」学新拆法、修港区；带哪些部署工具，在开工时的出勤配装里选。
txt:tm_next_side.en: Before you start: 2 opens BERTH to mend facilities, 3 opens METHODS & BUILD to learn methods and build the port; the tools you take are picked on the loadout page as the job starts.

txt:tm_keys_onsite.zh: 1–3 应用 · ←→↑↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · Esc 回首页 / 回到作业
txt:tm_keys_onsite.en: 1–3 APPS · ARROWS CHOOSE · Enter CONFIRM · Esc HOME / BACK TO WORK

txt:tm_task_full.zh: 拆完整艘船：指定设备完整送设备口，其余分类送对回收口
txt:tm_task_full.en: THE WHOLE SHIP: NAMED EQUIPMENT WHOLE TO THE EQUIPMENT MOUTH, THE REST SORTED

txt:tm_found_v.zh: 星图扫描找到 · 拖运费 %s · 已拖进港
txt:tm_found_v.en: FOUND IN THE BELT · TOW %s · TOWED IN

txt:tm_bought_v.zh: 船市购入 · 已付 %s · 拖运入港
txt:tm_bought_v.en: BOUGHT ON THE MARKET · %s PAID · TOWED IN

txt:tm_fee_drift.zh: 拖回来的运费（派拖船时付）
txt:tm_fee_drift.en: THE TOW HOME (PAID WHEN THE TUG GOES)

txt:tm_task_drift.zh: 没人要的船，拖回来就归你：拆下的东西全是你的，只付拖运费。
txt:tm_task_drift.en: Nobody's ship: tow it home and all of it is yours. You only pay the tow.

txt:tm_drift_v.zh: 在小行星带漂了 %d 年，船籍已经注销
txt:tm_drift_v.en: ADRIFT IN THE BELT %d YEARS, REGISTRY CANCELLED

txt:tm_drift_open.zh: 你的拖船从小行星带拖回 · 船籍已注销
txt:tm_drift_open.en: TOWED IN FROM THE BELT BY YOUR TUG · REGISTRY CANCELLED

txt:tm_kind_fa.zh: 船坞设施 · 永久生效

txt:tm_kind_it.zh: 消耗品 · 用完即止，可以囤
txt:tm_kind_it.en: CONSUMABLE · USED UP, CAN BE STOCKED

txt:tm_use_auto.zh: 无人机损毁时自动启用
txt:tm_use_auto.en: USED BY ITSELF WHEN THE DRONE IS LOST

txt:tm_use_intel_at.zh: 在合同市场按 I 对一份报价使用
txt:tm_use_intel_at.en: PRESS I ON AN OFFER IN THE MARKET

txt:tm_next_fee.zh: 下一单合同费最低 %s：买后余额不够付，差额 %s 会记入贷款，按每单 2% 计息
txt:tm_next_fee.en: THE NEXT CONTRACT FEE IS AT LEAST %s: %s OF IT WOULD GO ON THE LOAN, AT 2% A CONTRACT

txt:tm_next_ok.zh: 买后仍够付下一单合同费（最低 %s）
txt:tm_next_ok.en: STILL ENOUGH FOR THE NEXT CONTRACT FEE (AT LEAST %s)

txt:tm_fin_amt.zh: 金额（还款 / 借款）  ← → 或拖动

txt:tm_repay_none.zh: 资金或贷款为零，没有可还的
txt:tm_repay_none.en: NOTHING TO PAY (NO FUNDS OR NO LOAN)

txt:tm_net_d.zh: 预估价值 − 合同费 − 本单分期与利息
txt:tm_net_d.en: VALUE − FEE − THIS CONTRACT'S INSTALLMENT AND INTEREST

txt:tm_training_d.zh: 回训练舱 TS-1 再上一遍六课，随时可以退出回到泊位
txt:tm_training_d.en: BACK TO TS-1 FOR THE SIX LESSONS; LEAVE ANY TIME

txt:tm_repay_d.zh: 从资金里多还 $20,000 本金（不足则还余额）
txt:tm_repay_d.en: PAY $20,000 OF PRINCIPAL FROM FUNDS (OR WHAT IS LEFT)

txt:tm_use_intel.zh: I  对这份报价使用情报包（库存 %d）
txt:tm_use_intel.en: I  USE A SURVEY REPORT ON THIS OFFER (%d IN STOCK)

txt:tm_logs_note.zh: 记录可能过时或有误，以实测为准
txt:tm_logs_note.en: LOGS MAY BE OUT OF DATE OR WRONG: MEASURE

txt:tm_borrow.zh: 资金不足，差额 %s 记入贷款
txt:tm_borrow.en: SHORT BY %s: IT GOES ON THE LOAN

txt:tm_keys.zh: 1–3 应用 · ← → ↑ ↓ 选择 / 数量 · Enter 确认 · O 设置 · Esc 回首页 / 返回标题
txt:tm_keys.en: 1–3 APPS · ARROWS SELECT / AMOUNT · ENTER CONFIRM · O SETTINGS · ESC HOME / TITLE

gear:tm_trial_h.zh: 修缮任务 · 可反复接

gear:tm_trials_hint.zh: T  修缮任务 ×3（可反复接，借给你工具，船上一定有零件）
gear:tm_trials_hint.en: T  REPAIR TASKS ×3 (repeatable, gear lent, parts aboard)

gear:tm_borrow_none.zh: 没有可借额度，或金额为零
gear:tm_borrow_none.en: NO CREDIT LEFT, OR NOTHING TO BORROW

gear:tm_queued.zh: 这艘船太大，拖船站只有一艘拖船。先登记下来，下次打开终端时就能直接开工。
gear:tm_queued.en: Too big for the one tug you have now. Book it, and it is ready to start the next time you open the terminal.

gear:tm_held.zh: 已登记：这艘船下次开市排在最后一张卡，直接可接
gear:tm_held.en: REGISTERED: THIS SHIP IS THE LAST CARD OF THE NEXT MARKET, READY TO TAKE

txt:app_equip_d.zh: 报修和扩建计划，都在船坞图上
txt:app_equip_d.en: Faults and expansion plans, on the berth drawing

txt:app_skills_d.zh: 永久工具升级 · 工程成果与作业能力
txt:app_skills_d.en: Permanent tool upgrades / engineering achievements and capabilities

txt:app_supplies_d.zh: 现场买的直接进本单库存
txt:app_supplies_d.en: Bought on site: into this job's stock

txt:app_route_d.zh: 升级工具、建设船坞、查看船型
txt:app_route_d.en: Upgrade tools, build the berth, browse ships

txt:up_scan_d.zh: 检查设备时显示完好度，能发现结构暗伤
txt:up_scan_d.en: INSPECTION SHOWS CONDITION AND FINDS HIDDEN STRUCTURAL DAMAGE

txt:up_pump_d.zh: 抽气 / 抽液速度翻倍
txt:up_pump_d.en: GAS AND FLUID DRAW TWICE AS FAST

gear:feat_section_d.zh: 一个 6 t 以上的整体进入回收口。开放牵引锚型号，送一件。
gear:feat_section_d.en: A whole of 6 t or more went down a mouth. Opens the towing anchor; one comes with it.

gear:feat_field.zh: 一单往熔炉送 100 件以上 0.5 t 的碎料
gear:feat_field.en: 100 SCRAP PIECES OVER 0.5 t INTO THE FURNACE ON ONE JOB

gear:feat_watch.en: A COLD SHIP STRIPPED WITHOUT AN INCIDENT

gear:feat_propped.zh: 卸完一整面货柜墙不折弯
gear:feat_propped.en: A WHOLE CONTAINER WALL EMPTIED WITHOUT A BEND

gear:feat_replay.zh: 自己接的单里同型号船拆第二次
gear:feat_replay.en: THE SAME TYPE STRIPPED A SECOND TIME ON YOUR OWN JOBS

gear:feat_precise.zh: 累计完整送口高价值设备 $500,000

gear:feat_pressure_d.zh: 一只出厂带压的储瓶完整、安全地进入设备口。开放独立泵型号，送一件。
gear:feat_pressure_d.en: A bottle that came in charged went whole and safe into the equipment bay. Opens the independent pump; one comes with it.

gear:trial_g1a.zh: 修缮任务 A · 照明与配电

gear:trial_g1a_d.zh: 雨燕的蓄电池、燃料电池、配电柜完整送设备口 → 供电类零件
gear:trial_g1a_d.en: The Swift's battery, fuel cell and switchboard whole into the bay → power parts

gear:trial_g1b.zh: 修缮任务 B · 碎屑网

gear:trial_g1b_d.zh: 用锚把货舱整段切离送炉 → 结构按吨入库，补碎屑网
gear:trial_g1b_d.en: Anchor the hold, cut it free whole into the furnace → structure by the tonne for the net

gear:trial_g1c.zh: 修缮任务 C · 熔炉主火
gear:trial_g1c.en: REPAIR TASK C · FURNACE MAIN FIRE

gear:trial_g1c_d.zh: C 舱接口封死，贴壁抽空；冷却泵、散热器完整送设备口 → 热工零件
gear:trial_g1c_d.en: The hold's port is shut off: drain through the wall; coolant pump and radiator whole into the bay → thermal parts

gear:trial_busy.en: FINISH THE JOB IN HAND FIRST

gear:rp_fix_parts.zh: 自己修（用仓库里的零件和钢锭）
gear:rp_fix_parts.en: MEND IT YOURSELF (PARTS AND INGOTS FROM THE WAREHOUSE)

gear:rp_fixed.zh: 施工队开工了：修「%s」。修好之前还不能用。
gear:rp_fixed.en: THE CREW HAS STARTED ON %s. IT IS NOT USABLE UNTIL IT IS DONE.

gear:rp_cond_note.zh: 完好度低于 %d%% 的零件不能用于修缮，只能出售。
gear:rp_cond_note.en: Parts below %d%% condition cannot go into a repair; they can be sold.

gear:rp_tile.zh: 待修 %d 项 · 已修 %d 项 · 仓库零件 %d 件

gear:rp_cls_power.zh: 供电设备（电池、发电机这一类）

gear:rp_cls_thermal.zh: 热工设备（换热器、炉子部件这一类）

gear:rp_cls_drive.zh: 动力设备（电机、泵、液压件这一类）

gear:rp_cls_sail.zh: 光帆卷（纸鸢的整卷帆膜，按等级定价）
gear:rp_cls_sail.en: sail rolls (whole light-sail film, priced by grade)

gear:rp_lights_d.zh: 船坞一半的灯是灭的，牵引场也弱。修好：两盏泛光灯全亮、甲板灯全开、边缘牵引场恢复。
gear:rp_lights_d.en: Half the berth's lamps are dead and the tractor field is weak. Repaired: both floodlights, every deck lamp, the field at full strength.

gear:rp_net_fix_d.zh: 网上有个洞，三分之一的碎块漏掉。修好：碎块一个不漏。
gear:rp_net_fix_d.en: There is a hole in the net and a third of the cut-offs slip through. Repaired: nothing slips.

gear:rp_furnace_d.zh: 熔炉只有小火，吞一件废料要三倍时间。修好：恢复正常炉速。
gear:rp_furnace_d.en: The furnace runs on a small fire and takes three times as long over scrap. Repaired: normal speed.

gear:rp_debris_lost.en: A CUT-OFF SLIPPED THROUGH THE TORN NET

gear:rp_need_power.zh: 要先修零压港的动力区（第 1 阶段）：没有港电
gear:rp_need_power.en: NEEDS THE PORT'S POWER DISTRICT (STAGE 1) FIRST: NO GRID POWER

loadout_panel:refresh:3.zh: 基础工具始终可用，不占用装备槽，也不会消耗库存。
loadout_panel:refresh:3.en: Basic tools remain available; no consumable fitting required.

loadout_panel:refresh:4.zh: 旧工具配件残值已返还：

loadout_panel:refresh:7.en: Structural metal into the furnace mouth is not paid out: its tonnes become the company's unrated raw material, to sort, assay and melt into billets for industrial clients yourself. The cost: no cash for it, and it does not count as structure tonnes for repairs. Equipment, hazards and contaminated pieces go as usual.

route_panel:refresh:2.zh: 拆法是新工具带来的新干法：借用合同里先用一次就学会，之后花钱升档。
route_panel:refresh:2.en: A method is a new tool and the new way of working it opens: use it once on a borrow job to learn it, then buy its tiers.

route_panel:refresh:3.zh: 这里安排基础修复与工程成长。原料买卖和工业客户请进入交易行；加工在现场设备操作。
route_panel:refresh:3.en: Manage base repairs and engineering growth here. Trade materials and find industrial clients in the exchange; operate production equipment on site.

route_panel:refresh_detail:1.en: Achieved on a job, open for good, nothing to pay.

route_panel:refresh_detail:9.zh: 施工中 · 还剩 %d 秒

route_panel:_method_detail:4.en: Learned once the crew has built the %s.

route_panel:_method_detail:6.en: Borrow job: %s · lends %s · no fee; finish it and the method is yours.

route_panel:_method_detail:13.zh: 永久升档 · 本单立即生效

route_panel:_order_detail:1.zh: 船源：原厂灰鹭；按 P 使用安全处置和局部检修包。无需等随机合同刷新。
route_panel:_order_detail:1.en: SOURCE: FACTORY GR-7. P offers preparation and local access packages. No random market refresh is required.

route_panel:_order_detail:2.zh: 借用机器仅本单生效；锚、探头要正常取回。成功带回的自有工具可重复使用。
route_panel:_order_detail:2.en: Rented machines last for this job. Retrieve deployed anchors and probes normally; owned gear remains reusable.

route_panel:_order_detail:5.zh: 选择交付后立即恢复的设施
route_panel:_order_detail:5.en: CHOOSE THE FACILITY RESTORED ON DELIVERY

route_panel:_order_detail:6.zh: 整组交付免装配费；分件交付支付设施标价的 20%。资金不足计入现有贷款。已建满基础设施时，交付换取自有锚与探头各一件。
route_panel:_order_detail:6.en: Whole delivery waives assembly costs. Separate units cost 20% of the facility list price; any shortfall uses the existing loan. Fully restored careers receive one owned anchor and probe instead.

route_panel:_order_detail:7.zh: 保留底座，计划整件运输

route_panel:_order_detail:10.zh: 取消目标追踪（保留库存与进度）

route_panel:_port_detail:1.zh: 营业业务：按卖家报价采购原料、自主挂单、承接工业客户需求、查看交付。
route_panel:_port_detail:1.en: BUSINESS: seller listings, material purchases, limit orders, industrial clients and deliveries.

route_panel:_port_detail:2.zh: 进入交易行 · 买入 / 出售

route_panel:_port_detail:3.zh: 生产业务：分选原料与手工炼钢。先在交易行采购并等待入库，再到炉体或分选操作台按 E。
route_panel:_port_detail:3.en: PRODUCTION: material sorting and manual steelmaking. Purchase inputs, await warehouse receipt, then use the furnace or sorting console on site.

route_panel:_port_detail:4.zh: 现场路线：从船坞地板右端绕到下方；炉体操作台在左侧，分选操作台在右侧。
route_panel:_port_detail:4.en: ACCESS: go around the right end of the berth floor and underneath. Furnace console to the left, sorting console to the right.

tech_panel:refresh:2.zh: 测量仪、激光切割和磁力抓钩持续可用，无需购买、更换探针、透镜或电容。工具能力通过永久升级提升。
tech_panel:refresh:2.en: Meter, laser and grapple remain available without buying or replacing probe tips, lenses or capacitors. Permanent upgrades improve tool capabilities.

tech_panel:refresh:3.en: Legacy parts residual value refunded once:

terminal:_note_text:1.en: Back to the terminal's home screen (Esc)

terminal:_note_text:2.en: This chapter's goal: open it to see how and where

terminal:_note_text:3.zh: 直接带你去下一步要去的地方
terminal:_note_text:3.en: Takes you straight to where the next step is

terminal:_note_text:4.zh: 打开这一区的业务终端

terminal:_note_text:5.zh: 去处理这件事：带你到对应的终端或现场
terminal:_note_text:5.en: Deal with it: takes you to the right console or place

terminal:_note_text:6.zh: 找下一艘要拆的船：接单、派拖船、看二手船市
terminal:_note_text:6.en: Find the next ship: take a contract, send a tug, the hulk market

terminal:_note_text:7.zh: 船坞：报修坏了的设备、看扩建计划
terminal:_note_text:7.en: The berth: report what is broken, see the expansion plans

terminal:_note_text:8.zh: 学会新的拆法、规划港区建设
terminal:_note_text:8.en: Learn new ways to strip, plan the port's building

terminal:_note_text:9.zh: 去船坞开工已接下的这一单（Enter）
terminal:_note_text:9.en: Start the job already taken, at the berth (Enter)

terminal:_note_text:10.zh: 立刻派拖船把这艘船拖回港，到港后开拆（Enter）
terminal:_note_text:10.en: Send a tug for this ship now; strip it when it is in (Enter)

terminal:_note_text:11.zh: 这艘船已经是你的了：进船坞开拆（Enter）
terminal:_note_text:11.en: This ship is yours: strip it at the berth (Enter)

terminal:_note_text:12.zh: 接下这份合同，立刻进船坞开工；钱不够时会先借款（Enter）
terminal:_note_text:12.en: Take this contract and start at the berth; a loan covers what you lack (Enter)

terminal:_note_text:13.zh: 立刻还这一笔借款，钱从资金里扣（Enter）
terminal:_note_text:13.en: Pay this much of the loan back now, from your cash (Enter)

terminal:_note_text:14.zh: 立刻买下选中的补给，钱当场扣，东西进库存（Enter）
terminal:_note_text:14.en: Buy the chosen supplies now: paid at once, into stock (Enter)

terminal:_note_text:18.zh: 点一下选中这艘船，看它的详情；再按下面的按钮
terminal:_note_text:18.en: Click to pick this ship and see it; then the key below

terminal:_note_text:19.zh: 点一下选中这样补给，再按下面的按钮买
terminal:_note_text:19.en: Click to pick this supply, then buy it with the key below

terminal:_note_text:20.zh: 点一下选中这门课，看它练什么
terminal:_note_text:20.en: Click to pick this course and see what it trains

terminal:_ready:2.en: Open the exchange: buy feed, sell products (F8)

terminal:_ready:3.zh: 提前结束这一单：先按一次，再按一次确认；按已拆下的结算
terminal:_ready:3.en: End this job early: press, then press again to confirm; settled on what is off

terminal:_ready:4.zh: 远程办理，不用跑到现场
terminal:_ready:4.en: Done from here: no need to go there

terminal:ops_go:1.zh: 交易行在第一单完成后开放。
terminal:ops_go:1.en: The exchange opens after the first job.

terminal:_open_app:1.en: NOT OPEN YET: IT APPEARS WHEN NEEDED

terminal:_gui_input:1.en: Open the hulk market from the berth.
