terminal:_onboard_welcome:1.zh: 七号坞 · 回收权使用中

terminal:_onboard_welcome:2.zh: 你的拖船从小行星带拖回了漂流船。拆下来的东西换成钱，钱用来把七号坞修起来。
terminal:_onboard_welcome:2.en: Your tug has towed drifting hulks in from the belt. What you strip becomes money; the money mends Berth 07.

terminal:_onboard_welcome:3.zh: 第一步：按 1 打开合同，接下等着进坞的那艘船。
terminal:_onboard_welcome:3.en: First: press 1 for the contracts and take the hulk that is waiting.

terminal:_onboard_welcome:4.zh: 终端里其他的东西，用到时会一样一样亮起来。
terminal:_onboard_welcome:4.en: The rest of this terminal lights up as you need it.

terminal:_goal_strip:2.zh: 主线 · 第 %d 章 · %s（导览结束后继续）

terminal:_find_head:3.zh: 贸易区修好后才能去二手船市买船。
terminal:_find_head:3.en: The hulk market opens once the trade district is mended.

terminal:_find_head:4.zh: 在路上 %d 艘，最快的约 %d 秒后到港。
terminal:_find_head:4.en: %d on the way; the first in about %d s.

terminal:_market:1.zh: 还没找到船。点上面“星图扫描找船”，去小行星带扫一扫。
terminal:_market:1.en: No hulks found yet. Sweep the belt on the star map.

terminal:_bottom:1.zh: 派拖船去拖 · %s · 约 %d 秒

terminal:_bottom:3.zh: 这艘船有%s，没练过。点“开工拆”会先带你去练这几门专项（必练），练完直接回来拆它。
terminal:_bottom:3.en: This ship has %s, not trained for: start stripping takes you through those courses first (required), then straight back to it.

terminal:_bottom:5.zh: 。路上那艘约 %d 秒到港，到了在这里点“开工拆”。
terminal:_bottom:5.en: . The one on its way docks in ~%d s; then start stripping it here.

terminal:_next_card:1.zh: 已接的合同 · 还没开工

terminal:_next_card:2.zh: 这艘船你已经接下了，但装备页被关掉，所以还没开工：它停在拖船站的船坞口（太高的船停在外面泊位）。点“开始下一单”配好装备，就把它推进船坞开拆。
terminal:_next_card:2.en: You took this hulk but closed its loadout page, so it is not started: it lies in the tug station's mouth (a tall one in the yard outside). Start it, fit out, and it is pushed into the berth.

work_orders:顶层:2.zh: 完整回收 C-03 货箱，完整度至少 85%；选择通道，再解除固定。
work_orders:顶层:2.en: Recover cargo C-03 intact, at least 85% condition. Choose an exit before releasing its locks.

work_orders:顶层:3.zh: 开放锁索支撑；下一项借用牵引锚与探头，连底板一起取件。
work_orders:顶层:3.en: Unlock cable locking. Next: borrow an anchor and probe to recover a mounted section.

work_orders:顶层:5.zh: C-02 完整度至少 85%，保持与 FP-C2 底板相连且底板未切碎；整组脱离后稳定 1 秒再送设备口。
work_orders:顶层:5.en: Keep C-02 at least 85% intact on uncut floor plate FP-C2. Stabilize the free assembly for one second, then deliver it to equipment recovery.

work_orders:顶层:6.zh: 获得自有牵引锚；下一项可分件搬运，或借吊机整件交付并恢复设施。
work_orders:顶层:6.en: Earn an owned anchor. Next: transport separate units or rent a crane for whole-assembly delivery and restore a facility.

work_orders:顶层:8.zh: CP-E 泵与 RAD 散热器完整度均至少 85%。可分件交给搬运机，或保留 K4 底座用吊机整运。
work_orders:顶层:8.en: Deliver pump CP-E and radiator RAD intact, each at least 85% condition. Haul them separately, or keep cradle K4 and lift the whole assembly.

work_orders:顶层:9.zh: 用交付换取一项当前可用的船坞修缮；整件交付免装配费。
work_orders:顶层:9.en: Exchange the delivery for a usable berth repair. Whole-assembly delivery waives assembly costs.

ship_market_panel:_fill:1.en: PICK A SHIP. SELLERS TALK THEM UP; RATINGS HAVE BLIND SPOTS; EACH INSPECTION READS ONE SIDE; THE TITLE SEARCH FINDS LIENS AND WASTE LIABILITY.

star_map:_fill:1.en: No ships under way. Trade with an independent merchant on the exchange and a freighter leaves their belt station.

star_map:_detail:2.zh: 点一艘船看它的轨道、Δv 和货。
star_map:_detail:2.en: Click a ship for its orbit, Δv and cargo.

star_map:_detail:4.en: TRANSFER %d DAYS · Δv OUT %.1f km/s · IN %.1f km/s

star_map:_detail:6.en: grapple them into the warehouse receiver (the crane does pieces under 3 t once the cargo district is mended)

star_map:_detail:7.en: drag them from the loading table into its hold

star_map:_find_detail:1.zh: 选一片扇区，点“扫描”。扫完会收到几个信号，有的只是石头；选一个信号“分析电磁特征”，才知道是不是船。
star_map:_find_detail:1.en: Pick a sector and sweep it. Some signals are only rock: analyse one to learn whether it is a hulk.

star_map:_find_detail:3.zh: 船坞放不下：先把船坞扩长

star_map:_fill_find:1.en: %s DOCKED · START STRIPPING IT IN THE BERTH

star_map:_fill_find:4.zh: 还有 %d 片扇区太远：修好拖船站、贸易区能扫得更远。

star_map:_fill_find:11.zh: 或者去二手船市直接买一艘 →
star_map:_fill_find:11.en: OR BUY ONE AT THE HULK MARKET →

star_map:_fill_find:13.zh: 分析 %s 的电磁特征（约 %d 秒）

star_map:_fill_find:16.zh: 在路上 %d 艘 · 最快约 %d 秒

star_map:sig_state:1.zh: 拖运途中 · 约 %d 秒到港

star_map:sig_state:2.zh: 已到港 · 在拖船区等着拆
star_map:sig_state:2.en: DOCKED · WAITING IN THE TUG YARD

star_map:_done_line:2.zh: · 它那一行变成了“派拖船”按钮
star_map:_done_line:2.en: · ITS ROW IS NOW THE TUG BUTTON

star_map:next_line:2.zh: 拖船在路上，约 %d 秒到港。
star_map:next_line:2.en: THE TUG IS ON ITS WAY, ~%d s.

star_map:next_line:3.zh: 下一步：点 %s 那一行，派拖船去拖（%s）。
star_map:next_line:3.en: NEXT: CLICK %s'S ROW TO SEND THE TUG (%s).

star_map:next_line:4.zh: 下一步：%s附近找到的 %s，在下面“别的扇区找到的船”里派拖船去拖（%s）。
star_map:next_line:4.en: NEXT: THE HULK FOUND NEAR %s (%s): SEND THE TUG BELOW (%s).

star_map:next_line:5.en: THE YARD IS FULL: THIS ONE WAITS.

star_map:next_line:7.zh: 下一步：点一个信号（越强越像船），再点“分析”。
star_map:next_line:7.en: NEXT: PICK A SIGNAL (STRONGER IS LIKELIER), THEN ANALYSE IT.

star_map:next_line:8.zh: 检测到新目标进入扇区，请重新扫描。
star_map:next_line:8.en: NEW TARGETS IN THE SECTOR: SWEEP AGAIN.

star_map:next_line:9.zh: 这片没有船。约 %d 秒后有新东西漂进来，或换一片扫。
star_map:next_line:9.en: NO HULK HERE. NEW DRIFT IN ~%d s, OR SWEEP ANOTHER.

star_map:next_line:10.zh: 下一步：选一片扇区（最近的已选好），点“扫描”。
star_map:next_line:10.en: NEXT: PICK A SECTOR (THE NEAREST IS PICKED), SWEEP IT.

star_map:_tour_steps:2.zh: 它沿虚线飞到那艘船，挂上缆，拖着它沿原路回港。实线是走过的路。
star_map:_tour_steps:2.en: It flies the dashes to the hulk, takes it in tow and brings it home the same way. The solid line is behind it.

star_map:_tour_steps:4.zh: 这一行一直在倒数，现在约 %d 秒。
star_map:_tour_steps:4.en: This line counts down: about %d s now.

star_map:_tour_steps:5.en: CLOSE IT: THE TUG FLIES ON

star_map:_tour_steps:6.zh: 到港时屏幕上方弹一张卡，按 %s 打开终端，在它的卡上点“开工拆”。（只有终端打开时游戏暂停）

star_map:_tour_steps:8.zh: 没人要的废船都漂在小行星带里。左边这张图就是太阳系：中间是太阳，那一圈是小行星带，亮点是各个站。
star_map:_tour_steps:8.en: Abandoned hulks drift in the asteroid belt. This is the system: the sun in the middle, the belt around it, the stations as points.

star_map:_tour_steps:10.zh: 小行星带分成一片一片。开局只能扫离港最近的 3 片，修好拖船站、贸易区能扫得更远。
star_map:_tour_steps:10.en: The belt is cut into sectors. At first only the 3 nearest can be swept; the tug station and the trade district reach further.

star_map:_tour_steps:12.zh: 向选中的扇区发一道雷达波，约 %d 秒，不花钱。
star_map:_tour_steps:12.en: A radar sweep over the picked sector: about %d s, free.

star_map:_tour_steps:14.zh: 扫完出现几个信号，只知道强弱：可能是船，也可能只是石头。
star_map:_tour_steps:14.en: A few signals show up, strength only: a hulk, or just rock.

star_map:_tour_steps:16.zh: 点一个信号再点“分析电磁特征”（约 %d 秒）：看清是不是船、多长、漂了多少年、拖回来要多少钱。
star_map:_tour_steps:16.en: Pick a signal and analyse it (~%d s): whether it is a hulk, how long, how old, what the tow costs.

star_map:_tour_steps:18.zh: 认出是船的那一行会变成“派拖船去拖”按钮。点它，星图上看得见拖船飞过去、拖着船回来。第一趟免费。
star_map:_tour_steps:18.en: A signal analysed as a hulk becomes a tug button. Click it and watch the tug fly out and tow it home. The first is free.

star_map:_tour_steps:20.zh: 港里能停几艘等着拆的船。满了就要先拆完一艘，或扩建拖船站。
star_map:_tour_steps:20.en: How many hulks can wait at the port. Full, strip one first or extend the tug station.

star_map:tour_card:1.zh: 点一下或按空格：下一项 · Esc 跳过
star_map:tour_card:1.en: CLICK OR SPACE: NEXT · ESC SKIPS

star_map:tour_card:2.zh: 照着做，完成后自动继续 · Esc 跳过
star_map:tour_card:2.en: DO IT: THE TOUR GOES ON BY ITSELF · ESC SKIPS

star_map:tour_card:4.zh: 正在扫描，扫完会出现几个信号。
star_map:tour_card:4.en: Sweeping: a few signals show up when it is done.

star_map:tour_card:6.zh: 正在分析 %s 的电磁特征，分析完就知道是不是船。
star_map:tour_card:6.en: Analysing %s: done, it says whether it is a hulk.

star_map:tour_card:8.zh: 这片的信号都看过了，都不是船。换一片扇区再扫描。
star_map:tour_card:8.en: Every signal here is rock. Pick another sector and sweep it.

star_map:_send:2.zh: 拖运费 %s 先赊着，下次结算扣。
star_map:_send:2.en: THE %s TOW IS ON CREDIT TILL THE NEXT SETTLEMENT.

star_map:_draw_inset:3.zh: 检测到新目标 · 建议重新扫描

tow_traffic:start:1.zh: 拖船把 %s 拖回来了，停进拖船站外的泊位。按 Esc 跳过。
tow_traffic:start:1.en: The tug is bringing %s in to the tug yard. Esc skips.

tug_yard:block:1.zh: 拖船站泊位满了（%d / %d）：先拆掉一艘，或扩建拖船站
tug_yard:block:1.en: THE TUG YARD IS FULL (%d / %d): STRIP ONE, OR BUILD ON THE TUG STATION

tug_yard:block:2.zh: 拖船拖不动 %.0f m 的船（现在最长 %.0f m）：先修拖船站
tug_yard:block:2.en: THE TUGS CANNOT TOW %.0f m (UP TO %.0f m NOW): MEND THE TUG STATION

gear:pt_access_gate.zh: 港区航道 ↑ 通往中央转运环

gear:pt_access_hint.zh: 空船坞：%s 接单 · 沿上方青色航道前往零压港 · %s 查看全景
gear:pt_access_hint.en: EMPTY BERTH: %s CONTRACTS · FOLLOW THE CYAN EXIT TO THE PORT · %s PANORAMA

gear:pt_cargo_1.zh: 货运区的调度台复工：出场配装多一个部署工具槽。
gear:pt_cargo_1.en: The cargo district's dispatch desk back at work: one more deploy slot on a job.

gear:pt_effect_cargo.zh: 货运区支持出勤装配与物资调度。
gear:pt_effect_cargo.en: The cargo district supports field loadouts and supply dispatch.

gear:pt_built.zh: 施工队开工了：%s（%s期）。修好之前还不能用。
gear:pt_built.en: THE CREW HAS STARTED ON THE %s, PART %s. NOT USABLE UNTIL IT IS DONE.

gear:pt_power_1.zh: 接通主电网的第一回路：动力区点亮一半，高耗能设施有了电源。
gear:pt_power_1.en: The first loop of the main grid: half the district lit, power for the heavy facilities.

gear:pt_power_2.zh: 全网供电：动力区全亮，转运环有了底电。
gear:pt_power_2.en: The whole grid: the district fully lit, base power for the ring.

gear:pt_salvage_1.zh: 修复拆船区的码头结构：贸易区可以开工了。
gear:pt_salvage_1.en: The salvage district's quays repaired: the trade district can be built.

gear:pt_salvage_2.zh: 拆船区重开第二泊位的基座（第二泊位在终局版本启用）。
gear:pt_salvage_2.en: The footing of a second berth (the berth itself comes with the final version).

gear:pt_process_1.zh: 加工区复工：电弧炉、分选台和轧机可以用了。
gear:pt_process_1.en: The processing district back at work: the arc furnace, the sorting line and the mill.

gear:pt_tug_1.zh: 自家拖船 TG-1 修好：泊位 2 个，能拖 88 m 的船；TG-1 待命时拖运费半价。
gear:pt_tug_1.en: Your own tug TG-1: two berths, ships up to 88 m; half the tow while TG-1 stands by.

gear:pt_tug_2.zh: 第二艘自家拖船 TG-2：泊位 4 个，船长不限。
gear:pt_tug_2.en: A second tug, TG-2: four berths, any length.

gear:pt_trade_1.zh: 贸易港重开一条航线：完整设备多卖 10%。
gear:pt_trade_1.en: One trade lane reopened: whole equipment sells 10 % better.

gear:pt_trade_2.zh: 贸易港全开：完整设备多卖 20%，三星合同更多。
gear:pt_trade_2.en: The trade port open: equipment sells 20 % better, more three-star contracts.

gear:pt_ring_1.zh: 中央转运环通电：剩下的两台驱动带着转盘慢慢转，各区之间开始转运货物。
gear:pt_ring_1.en: The ring powered: the two drives left turn the carousel slowly, and goods start moving between the districts.

gear:pt_ring_2.zh: 装回四台驱动和冷却，转盘全速转：大型星舰可以进港（终局在下一版本）。
gear:pt_ring_2.en: All four drives and the coolers back: the carousel at full speed, and great ships may come in (the ending comes with the next version).

gear:pt_effect_power.zh: 动力区是高耗能设施的前提。
gear:pt_effect_power.en: The power district is the prerequisite of the heavy facilities.

gear:pt_effect_salvage.zh: 拆船区决定港口能停几艘船。
gear:pt_effect_salvage.en: The salvage district decides how many ships the port can hold.

gear:pt_effect_process.zh: 加工区决定废金属的价钱。
gear:pt_effect_process.en: The processing district decides what scrap pays.

gear:pt_effect_tug.zh: 拖船站坏着时每单扣 $1,500 拖运费。
gear:pt_effect_tug.en: While the tug station is down every contract pays a $1,500 towing fee.

gear:pt_effect_trade.zh: 贸易港决定完整设备的售价和合同质量。
gear:pt_effect_trade.en: The trade port decides what equipment sells for and the contracts offered.

gear:pt_effect_ring.zh: 转运环是整个港口复兴的终点。
gear:pt_effect_ring.en: The ring is where the port's revival ends.

gear:tram_title.zh: 接驳车 T-1 · 目的地

gear:tram_sub.zh: 选一站：车先开到你这里接你，再沿走廊经中央环开过去，到站自动下车。
gear:tram_sub.en: PICK A STOP: THE CAR COMES TO YOU, RUNS THE CORRIDORS VIA THE HUB AND LETS YOU OFF.

cargo_art:still:2.zh: 叉车通道 限速 5 km/h

cargo_art:plates:1.zh: 在途 %d 单 · 叉车 %d 台

cargo_art:hover_items:4.zh: 四层托盘货架，每层一排、各有用途。货物按真实库存放在对应的排上：%s。

cargo_art:hover_items:6.zh: 飞到下面的货架口按 E 只看这一侧的货；在业务终端可以改每一排的用途。
cargo_art:hover_items:6.en: E at the mouth below opens this side's racks only; the business console changes what each row holds.

cargo_art:hover_items:8.zh: 从地面舱口开到对应货架下，门架三级伸缩把货叉升到那一层，取货或上架后降下开回。出库和送料要等它把货搬到舱口。缺电时开得慢。
cargo_art:hover_items:8.en: Drives from the floor hatch to under its row, telescopes its mast up to the shelf, picks or puts away, lowers and comes back. Sales and the furnace's feed wait for it to bring goods to the hatch; short of power it crawls.

cargo_art:hover_items:9.zh: 货运区升到 1 级有两台叉车，2 级开得更快。
cargo_art:hover_items:9.en: Stage 1 of the cargo district gives two trucks, stage 2 faster ones.

cargo_art:hover_items:11.zh: 库存有变化时，从舱口把货吊上对应的货架（或从货架吊下），吊具随起停轻轻摆动。
cargo_art:hover_items:11.en: When the stock changes it lifts the goods from the hatch up to their row (or down from it), the spreader swinging a little as it starts and stops.

cargo_art:hover_items:16.zh: 货物从下面的货场经这里进出仓库：叉车到舱口交接时舱门打开，升降台把货送上来或降下去。
cargo_art:hover_items:16.en: Goods come in and leave through here from the yard below: as a truck hands over, the doors open and the lift brings the goods up or takes them down.

cargo_art:hover_items:21.zh: 八排货架各自的用途、存量和正在进行的出入库，数据都是实时的。
cargo_art:hover_items:21.en: Each of the eight rows' use, what it holds and the moves under way, live.

cargo_art:hover_items:23.en: Change a row's use at the business console.

cargo_floor:use:2.zh: 这批全部上架，开始计租。

cargo_floor:use:4.en: THIS ONE GOES ON ROW %s (%s RACK).

cargo_floor:use:8.zh: 飞到亮着的货架口再按 %s 放下。
cargo_floor:use:8.en: FLY TO THE LIT RACK MOUTH AND PRESS %s.

cargo_floor:use:9.zh: 吊起来了：%.0f t，送到 %s 排（%s货架口）。
cargo_floor:use:9.en: LIFTED: %.0f t FOR ROW %s (%s RACK MOUTH).

hub_art:hover_items:2.en: Moves goods between this spoke's hatch and the carousel's cradles: what comes up from %s goes onto the carousel, what comes round for %s is set down into it.

hub_art:hover_items:3.zh: 货由各区真实作业产生：仓库出入库、加工排队、贸易装货。修好中央环后转得更快。
hub_art:hover_items:3.en: The goods come from the districts' real work: the warehouse's jobs, the heats queued, trades being loaded. Mend the ring and it runs faster.

hub_art:hover_items:5.zh: 立式电机经减速箱带小齿轮，啮合转盘内圈齿圈，四台一起让转盘一格一格转位。

hub_art:hover_items:6.zh: 拆走了，只剩底座螺栓和剪断的电缆

hub_art:hover_items:10.zh: 中央环修到 2 档（需驱动件）会把缺的两台装回去。

hub_art:hover_items:11.zh: 中央环 1 档通电就能转。
hub_art:hover_items:11.en: Stage 1 of the ring powers it.

hub_art:hover_items:13.zh: 动力区的电经供电桥进母线环，分给四台驱动；中间的滑环把电送上一直在转的转盘。
hub_art:hover_items:13.en: The power district's feed comes over the bridge into the bus ring and on to the four drives; the slip ring in the middle carries it onto the turning carousel.

hub_art:hover_items:16.zh: 中央环 1 档需要动力区先修好。
hub_art:hover_items:16.en: Stage 1 of the ring needs the power district mended first.

hub_art:hover_items:17.zh: 供电桥 · 环网主管廊

hub_art:hover_items:18.zh: 从动力区来的馈线一路过桥进核心，一路沿环网电缆槽分到每条走廊。旁边两根是冷却水管。
hub_art:hover_items:18.en: The feeder from the power district: one way over the bridge into the core, the other round the ring main's tray to every spoke. The two pipes beside it are the coolant.

hub_art:hover_items:20.zh: 在动力区的电网调度里分电。
hub_art:hover_items:20.en: Share the power out at the power district's grid.

hub_art:hover_items:22.zh: 12 个托架的大转盘，每次转 30° 停住锁销，各走廊的转运臂趁停的时候装卸，把货在各区之间转运。
hub_art:hover_items:22.en: Twelve cradles on a slewing ring: it turns 30°, the pins lock it, and each spoke's arm loads or unloads while it stands, carrying the goods between the districts.

hub_art:hover_items:23.zh: 停转：转盘卡在半格上，一个货箱撞歪了

hub_art:hover_items:25.zh: 在业务终端的建设里修中央环：1 档通电慢转，2 档装回驱动和冷却全速转。
hub_art:hover_items:25.en: Mend the ring under building at the console: stage 1 powers it slowly, stage 2 puts the drives and coolers back for full speed.

power_station_art:hover_items:1.zh: 扩建动力区（船坞终端 → 成长与建设 → 零压港 → 动力区）。
power_station_art:hover_items:1.en: Build on the power district (berth terminal → growth → the port → power).

power_station_art:hover_items:3.zh: 留给第 3 套机组的屏蔽隔间：现在只有脚手架和盖板。
power_station_art:hover_items:3.en: The shielded bay kept for a third unit: scaffold and cover plates for now.

power_station_art:hover_items:4.zh: 动力区第 2 期装上第 3 套机组，容量从 30 MW 升到 80 MW。
power_station_art:hover_items:4.en: Power stage 2 fits the third unit: 30 MW becomes 80 MW.

power_station_art:hover_items:6.zh: 压水堆：堆芯的热把一回路的水加热到三百多度（高压不沸腾），在蒸汽发生器里把二回路的水烧成蒸汽去推汽轮机。控制棒抽出越多，堆越热。稳压器保持压力，主泵让水循环。
power_station_art:hover_items:6.en: A pressurised-water reactor: the core heats the primary water past 300 °C (kept liquid by pressure); the steam generator boils the secondary water to drive the turbine. The further out the rods, the hotter the core. The pressuriser holds the pressure; the main pump circulates.

power_station_art:hover_items:7.zh: 不用操作：棒位自动跟着全港用电走。
power_station_art:hover_items:7.en: Nothing to do: the rods follow the port's load by themselves.

power_station_art:hover_items:8.zh: 修好动力区（第 1 期）就会启动。
power_station_art:hover_items:8.en: Mending the power district (stage 1) starts it.

power_station_art:hover_items:10.zh: 蒸汽经主汽门、调节阀进高压缸、低压缸推动转子，带发电机发电。负荷一加上，转速和频率先往下掉，调节阀开大补上，几秒后回到 50 Hz。
power_station_art:hover_items:10.en: Steam through the stop and governor valves drives the HP and LP casings and the generator. A load put on drops the speed and frequency until the governor valve opens to match; in a few seconds it is back at 50 Hz.

power_station_art:hover_items:11.zh: 在业务终端的动力控制屏可以给电弧炉设功率上限、排电不够时的先后顺序。
power_station_art:hover_items:11.en: The power control screen at the business console sets the furnace's cap and who comes first when short.

power_station_art:hover_items:13.zh: 把汽轮机排出的蒸汽冷成水，再由给水泵送回蒸汽发生器。它的热由散热回路带到外面的散热板排到太空。
power_station_art:hover_items:13.en: Turns the turbine's exhaust back into water for the feed pumps; its heat goes by the radiator loop to the radiators outside, out into space.

power_station_art:hover_items:16.zh: 氢氧燃料电池，最多 6 MW：动力区没修好时全港靠它，修好后转为备用。
power_station_art:hover_items:16.en: Hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells, up to 6 MW: the port lives on them until the power district is mended, then they stand by.

power_station_art:hover_items:19.zh: 把冷凝器里的凝结水加压送回蒸汽发生器：两台运行一台备用，振动偏高时自动切换。
power_station_art:hover_items:19.en: Pump the condensate back into the steam generators: two run, one stands by, changed over automatically when one vibrates.

power_station_art:hover_items:20.zh: 不用操作：切换是自动的，不影响供电。
power_station_art:hover_items:20.en: Nothing to do: the changeover is automatic and the supply carries on.

power_station_art:hover_items:22.zh: 推动散热回路：把冷凝器的热送到两侧吊臂上的散热板。太空里没有空气和水，热只能辐射出去。
power_station_art:hover_items:22.en: Drive the radiator loop: the condenser's heat out to the radiators on the booms. In vacuum heat can only be radiated away.

power_station_art:hover_items:23.zh: 不用操作。站外看散热板越红，排的热越多。
power_station_art:hover_items:23.en: Nothing to do. Outside, the redder the radiators, the more heat goes out.

power_station_art:hover_items:25.zh: 全港的电从这里分出去：自家发的电和外购电进来，再每区一条线送出去。哪个区开始用电，它的开关就合上（I），表针指着它现在用的电。
power_station_art:hover_items:25.en: Where the port's power is shared out: the units' incomer, the shore incomer, then a feeder for each district. A district starting to draw closes its breaker (I); its ammeter shows what it draws.

power_station_art:hover_items:26.zh: 全港在用 %.1f · 自家发 %.1f · 外购 %.1f 兆瓦

power_station_art:hover_items:27.zh: 电不够时谁先用：业务终端 → 动力控制屏里调顺序，或设成不够时自动买外购电。
power_station_art:hover_items:27.en: Who comes first when short: the business console's power control screen, where the supply line is chosen too.

power_station_art:hover_items:29.zh: 整座电站的读数：输出 / 容量、频率、堆热功率、蒸汽、冷凝器、散热板、外购电，以及最近几次自动切换。
power_station_art:hover_items:29.en: The plant in figures: out against capacity, frequency, reactor heat, steam, condenser, radiators, shore power, and the last automatic changeovers.

power_station_art:hover_items:30.zh: 详细控制在下面的业务终端（按 B 附近打开）。
power_station_art:hover_items:30.en: The controls are at the business console below.

process_art:hover_items:2.zh: 跨在整个厂房上方的桥式天车。电弧炉料仓里有废钢在等时，它从左上方的料篮架吊起料篮，送到电弧炉右侧的加料口上方，料篮里的废钢随加料一点点变少，加完把空篮送回去。
process_art:hover_items:2.en: The bridge crane over the whole hall. While scrap waits in the furnace's bunker it lifts the charging basket off its stand (top left), hangs it over the furnace's side chute and lets the scrap feed in, then takes the empty basket back.

process_art:hover_items:3.zh: 不用操作。往电弧炉加废钢（炉体操作台或终端）它就会去吊料。
process_art:hover_items:3.en: Nothing to do: charge the furnace (at its desk or the terminal) and it brings the basket.

process_art:hover_items:5.zh: 把废钢熔成钢水。三根石墨电极从炉盖伸进去起弧（满功率 24 MW），钢水到出钢温度后炉体倾转，从偏心底出钢口浇进右边的锭模线，冷却成钢坯。
process_art:hover_items:5.en: Melts scrap into steel: three graphite electrodes strike arcs through the roof (24 MW flat out); at tapping heat the vessel tilts and taps from its eccentric bottom hole into the mould line on the right, where billets cool.

process_art:hover_items:6.zh: 在炉体操作台（E）一键熔炼；电价、电网余量决定功率。
process_art:hover_items:6.en: One button at the furnace desk (E); the power follows the price and the grid's spare.

process_art:hover_items:8.zh: 把港区电网的高压降成电弧需要的大电流低电压，经铜母线和水冷电缆送到电极横臂。散热风扇随负载加速。
process_art:hover_items:8.en: Steps the port's high voltage down to the arcs' heavy current, through the copper bus and the water-cooled cables to the electrode arms. Its fans speed up with the load.

process_art:hover_items:10.zh: 不用操作。动力区的供电决定电弧炉能开多大功率。
process_art:hover_items:10.en: Nothing to do; the power district's supply sets how hard the furnace can burn.

process_art:hover_items:12.zh: 电弧炉的烟气经炉顶烟罩和排烟道进来，滤袋截住粉尘，脉冲喷吹按顺序把灰抖进灰斗，引风机把净化后的气从烟囱排出。
process_art:hover_items:12.en: The furnace's fume comes along the duct from its hood; the bags catch the dust, pulses shake it down in turn into the hopper, and the fan sends the clean air up the stack.

process_art:hover_items:15.zh: 不用操作，跟电弧炉一起运行。
process_art:hover_items:15.en: Nothing to do; it runs with the furnace.

process_art:hover_items:17.zh: 钢坯先在加热炉里烧透，开轧时炉门升起、推钢机把它推上进料辊道；除鳞喷水打掉氧化皮，四辊轧机把它轧成钢板或型材，在出料辊道上冷却后入库。
process_art:hover_items:17.en: A billet heats through in the reheating furnace; at the pass the door lifts and the pusher sends it out onto the feed table, the descaler blasts its scale off, the four-high stand rolls it into plate or sections, and it cools on the run-out on its way to the racks.

process_art:hover_items:18.zh: 在轧机操作台（E）选配方、开轧；钢坯从货运区自动送来。
process_art:hover_items:18.en: At the mill pedestal (E) pick the recipe and roll; billets come up from the cargo district.

process_art:hover_items:20.zh: 电弧炉下方的控制室：屏幕上是电弧功率曲线、炉温和天车位置。
process_art:hover_items:20.en: The control room under the furnace deck: the arcs' power trace, the bath's heat and where the crane is.

process_art:hover_items:22.zh: 只是看的。操作在各自的操作台上。
process_art:hover_items:22.en: Only to watch; the controls are at each machine's desk.

process_works:furnace_state:7.zh: 有料 · 等按『通电熔化』

process_works:furnace_state:8.zh: 有料未加热 %d °C · 没分到电

remote_ops:why:1.zh: 第一次先飞到船坞的仓库柜台按 E，之后在哪都能按 F3
remote_ops:why:1.en: FLY TO THE STORES COUNTER IN THE BERTH AND PRESS E ONCE; THEN F3 WORKS ANYWHERE

remote_ops:why:2.zh: 先到船坞的零件架前用一次（E）
remote_ops:why:2.en: USE THE RACK IN THE BERTH ONCE FIRST (E)

remote_ops:why:3.zh: 动力区导览走过以后才能远程调度

remote_ops:why:4.zh: 加工区导览走过以后才能远程排队

rolling_mill:block:1.en: THE PROCESSING DISTRICT IS NOT MENDED

rolling_mill:block:4.zh: 仓库里钢坯（等级 1）不到 1 吨：先在加工区把钢锭炼成钢坯
rolling_mill:block:4.en: UNDER A TONNE OF GRADE-1 BILLET: MELT INGOTS INTO BILLETS FIRST

rolling_mill:lamp:4.zh: 连续轧：仓库里钢坯不到 1 t，等钢坯
rolling_mill:lamp:4.en: ROLLING ON: UNDER A TONNE OF BILLET

rolling_mill:status:4.zh: 轧机正在轧%s · %d%% · 还剩约 %d 秒

shelf_panel:_ready:4.zh: 货运区 · 只管这一边的四排 · 全部东西按 F3 看公司仓库
shelf_panel:_ready:4.en: CARGO · THIS SIDE'S FOUR ROWS ONLY · F3: EVERYTHING

shelf_panel:_ready:6.zh: 打开零件架：看架上有哪些零件、成色多少
shelf_panel:_ready:6.en: Open the parts rack: what is on it, in what condition

shelf_panel:_fill:1.zh: 选这一排货架放哪类货：立刻生效
shelf_panel:_fill:1.en: Choose what this row of racks holds: takes effect at once

trade_hall_art:_booths_moving:2.en: Good day, what do you need?

trade_hall_art:_booths_moving:4.en: We have %s at %s/t, %.1f t in stock.

trade_hall_art:board:1.zh: 报价大屏 · 港内三家与小行星带商人
trade_hall_art:board:1.en: QUOTES · THE PORT'S THREE AND THE BELT'S MERCHANTS

trade_hall_art:signs:6.zh: 货单 %d 张在途 · 上一批过磅 %.2f t

trade_hall_art:signs:7.zh: 修复件 · 收 %s 还要 %.1f t

trade_hall_art:ticker:1.zh: 成交 · 今天还没有成交

trade_hall_art:hover_items:2.zh: 整个港口每样货的最高收价、最低卖价、上次成交价，每分钟记一点的走势，以及买卖两边各挂了多少吨。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:2.en: Every goods' best bid, best ask and last price at the port, its trend one point a minute, and how many tonnes are bid and offered.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:4.zh: 看准价差再去柜台或终端（F8）买卖。蓝线高过平时就是卖的好时候。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:4.en: Mind the spread, then deal at a counter or the exchange (F8). Blue above its usual is the time to sell.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:8.zh: 炉料商：卖废钢、混合金属等炉料，收钢锭。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:8.en: Furnace feed: sells scrap and mixed metal, buys billets.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:9.zh: 物流商：收成品，开货单、过磅、发运。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:9.en: Logistics: buys products, writes dockets, weighs, ships.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:10.zh: 修理工场：收钢锭做法兰、轴套、支架等修复件。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:10.en: Repair shop: buys billets for flanges, bushes, brackets.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:11.zh: 飞到柜台前按 %s：挂单、按它的报价成交。和它成交的货在下层交货码头交接。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:11.en: Fly to the desk, %s: post, or take its quote. What you deal with it is handed over at the dock below.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:13.zh: 交货码头和仓库之间的口：卖出的货从这里出来，买进的货从这里进仓。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:13.en: Between the dock and the warehouse: what you sell comes out here, what you buy goes in.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:14.zh: 不用操作；仓库里要有货，卖单才能交货。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:14.en: Nothing to do; a sale needs the goods in the warehouse.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:16.zh: 每箱货过磅，读数是这笔成交的真实吨数。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:16.en: Each crate is weighed; the reading is the deal's real tonnes.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:17.zh: 看着读数就知道这笔交了多少。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:17.en: The reading is how much of the deal has gone.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:19.zh: 给过了磅的货箱打铅封，橙色标签就是封好的。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:19.en: Seals each weighed crate; the orange tag is its seal.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:22.zh: 和港内公司成交后，对方的驳船靠进东墙下的口子，吊车把货箱吊进吊出。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:22.en: A deal with one of the port's companies brings its lighter into the port under the east wall; the crane swings the crates in or out.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:23.zh: 在柜台或终端和港内公司成交，就会看到它来交货。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:23.en: Deal with a port company at a counter or the exchange and it comes.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:25.zh: 独立商人和个体船主的小船靠在这里，廊桥接上舱门，接驳小车把客人送到业务终端旁边。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:25.en: The independent merchants' small ships berth here; the gangway meets the hatch and the cart takes the visitor to the business console.

trade_hall_art:hover_items:27.zh: 到西边业务终端按 %s：接受、还价或拒绝。急着要货的客人一分钟内不谈就走。
trade_hall_art:hover_items:27.en: At the business console in the west, %s: accept, haggle or send away. One in a hurry leaves after a minute.

trade_people:take_contract:1.zh: 这家现在没有合同可接

trade_people:_deliver:2.zh: 没能按时给%s交货（%s不够），信誉 −1。

trade_people:advance:1.zh: %s开船来了（%s）。到贸易区业务终端看看他要什么。

trade_works:dock_state:1.zh: 没开 · 贸易港未修复

trade_works:dock_state:2.zh: 空闲 · 和港内公司成交后在这里交货
trade_works:dock_state:2.en: IDLE · DEALS WITH THE PORT'S COMPANIES ARE HANDED OVER HERE

trade_works:lighter_state:1.zh: 不在 · 成交后来接货送货

trade_works:lighter_state:5.zh: %s 的驳船靠泊 · 舱内 %d 箱

transit_panel:_ready:2.en: Ride the shuttle to this stop

tug_station_art:still:3.zh: 备件架 · 喷管 / 缆绳 / 电池模块 / 阀件

tug_station_art:hover_items:2.zh: 拖回来的船先停进这里：高不过 %.0f m 的船尾伸进站内，系泊臂夹住，软管抽走一部分推进剂，装上推船夹具，扫描船体。更高的船停在外面露天泊位。
tug_station_art:hover_items:2.en: Hulks towed home lie here first: one under %.0f m tall goes in stern first, is clamped, drawn off, fitted with the push frame and scanned. Taller ones wait outside.

tug_station_art:hover_items:3.zh: 不用操作，自动处理。拖船站等级越高抽得越多（现在 %d%%）：拆的时候船里推进剂更少、更不容易起火，抽出的推进剂进储罐。接单开工就把它推去船坞。
tug_station_art:hover_items:3.en: Nothing to do: it runs by itself. A better station draws off more (now %d%%): less propellant aboard to burn when you cut, and the tank fills. Start the job and it is pushed to the berth.

tug_station_art:hover_items:5.zh: 跨在船坞口上方的 40 吨龙门吊：给废船船尾装推船夹具（拖船推它进船坞时顶的就是这个），小车上的激光头扫描船体。
tug_station_art:hover_items:5.en: The 40 t gantry over the mouth: sets the push frame on a hulk's stern (what the tug bears on to push it in) and its trolley's lidar scans the hull.

tug_station_art:hover_items:6.zh: 不用操作。看它在做什么就知道船处理到哪一步了。
tug_station_art:hover_items:6.en: Nothing to do; what it does tells you how far the hulk is.

tug_station_art:hover_items:8.zh: 自家拖船的泊位：从左墙上部的拖船门飞进来，接上加注臂补推进剂、接上充电线充电，尾部吊舱经甲板舱口换下去检修。
tug_station_art:hover_items:8.en: A company tug's berth: in through the tug gate, the arm refuels it, the umbilical charges it, its aft pod is swapped through the deck hatch.

tug_station_art:hover_items:9.zh: 自家拖船满电待命时，买船拖运只收一半钱，也能接包机单（贸易港或终端）。

tug_station_art:hover_items:10.zh: 扩建拖船站（终端 → 成长与建设）多一艘拖船。

tug_station_art:hover_items:12.zh: 拖船回港时升降台把它的旧推进器吊舱换下来放到这里，探头沿喷管扫描检修，修好变成下一次的备用吊舱。
tug_station_art:hover_items:12.en: When a tug comes home the lift swaps its worn thruster pod onto this table; the probe overhauls it into the next spare.

tug_station_art:hover_items:13.zh: 不用操作；没有备用吊舱时下一艘回港的拖船要等它修完。
tug_station_art:hover_items:13.en: Nothing to do; with no spare ready the next tug home waits for the overhaul.

tug_station_art:hover_items:15.zh: 存放从废船抽出来的甲基肼，给回港的拖船加注。剧毒易燃。
tug_station_art:hover_items:15.en: Holds the monomethylhydrazine drawn off the hulks and refuels the tugs home. Toxic, flammable.

tug_station_art:hover_items:16.zh: 接包机单时推进剂先从这里扣（每 m³ 抵 %s），不够再花钱。
tug_station_art:hover_items:16.en: A charter's propellant comes out of it first (%s a m³), cash only for the rest.

tug_station_art:hover_items:18.zh: 拖船换下来的易损件：喷管、缆绳、电池模块、阀件。
tug_station_art:hover_items:18.en: What a tug wears out: nozzle bells, cable, battery modules, valve blocks.

tug_station_art:hover_items:19.zh: 电池模块 %d 块 · 喷管 %d 个

tug_station_art:hover_items:20.zh: 扩建拖船站后备件更多。

tug_station_art:hover_items:22.zh: 检修用的小件：阀件、密封圈、紧固件、线束。
tug_station_art:hover_items:22.en: Small parts for the overhauls: valves, seals, bolts, looms.

tug_works:gantry_state:1.zh: 断电 · 拖船站未修复

tug_works:mouth_state:1.zh: 空 · 下一艘拖回来的船停这里
tug_works:mouth_state:1.en: EMPTY · THE NEXT HULK LIES HERE

tug_works:mouth_state:4.en: %s · READY · START IT TO PUSH IT IN

tug_works:tank_state:4.zh: 空 · 拖回的船进港时抽料

tug_works:berth_state:1.zh: 空泊位 · 扩建拖船站加一艘拖船
tug_works:berth_state:1.en: FREE · BUILD ON FOR ANOTHER TUG

warehouse:wait_text:2.en: WAITING ON THE WAREHOUSE: %d MOVES AHEAD

warehouse:wait_text:3.en: WAITING ON THE WAREHOUSE: A FORKLIFT AT %s (%d s)

assay_panel:_ready:2.zh: 整批锁在仓库，只读样品 · 每批 %s（试行）\n黑色炉料杂质 ≤ %d%% 升为等级 1
assay_panel:_ready:2.en: THE LOT STAYS IN STOCK, A SAMPLE IS READ · %s A LOT (PROVISIONAL)\nFERROUS FEED ≤ %d%% IMPURITY BECOMES GRADE 1

assay_panel:_ready:6.zh: 撤回正在化验的批次（化验费不退）
assay_panel:_ready:6.en: WITHDRAW THE LOT BEING READ (FEE KEPT)

assay_panel:_ready:7.zh: 立刻停下这批的化验，货退回去，化验费不退
assay_panel:_ready:7.en: Stop reading this lot now; it goes back, the fee is kept

assay_panel:_fill:6.zh: 合格：整批升为等级 1 黑色炉料，可以开炉。
assay_panel:_fill:6.en: PASS: THE LOT IS NOW GRADE 1 FURNACE FEED.

assay_panel:_fill:7.zh: 不合格：保持未评级，只能按未评级挂牌卖。
assay_panel:_fill:7.en: FAIL: STAYS UNRATED; SELL IT AS SUCH.

assay_panel:_fill:8.zh: 已记下材料描述：这批旧料现在能送分选台。
assay_panel:_fill:8.en: RECORDED: THIS OLD LOT CAN NOW BE SORTED.

assay_panel:_fill:9.zh: 仓库里没有要化验的料。未评级黑色炉料来自分选台；自拆留料先过分选台。
assay_panel:_fill:9.en: Nothing to read. Unrated ferrous feed comes off the sorting line; own salvage goes through sorting first.

assay_panel:_fill:12.zh: 立刻化验这一批：交化验费，查清它到底是什么成分
assay_panel:_fill:12.en: Read this lot now: pay the fee and learn what it really is

client_ships:_items:5.zh: 订单板（F8 · 订单）里接单，仓库自动备货，货运火车送到贸易港，它来取走。
client_ships:_items:5.en: Take orders on the order board (F8 · ORDERS): the stores make them up, the freight train brings them to the trade port, a ship like this takes them.

exchange_logistics:_draw:1.en: Waiting for a free cargo berth

exchange_logistics:_draw:2.zh: 货物缺失，等待现场处理

exchange_logistics:_draw:3.zh: 货物受损，等待重新验收

exchange_logistics:_draw:4.zh: 搬运机构受阻，请清理通道

exchange_logistics:_draw:5.zh: 货物通道受阻，请检查现场

exchange_logistics:_draw:6.zh: 记录保存失败，货物暂存

exchange_logistics:_draw:8.zh: 装运暂停，请检查货运区
exchange_logistics:_draw:8.en: Freight paused; inspect the cargo district

exchange_panel:_ready:7.zh: 买别人挂出来的货：选货，再选卖家
exchange_panel:_ready:7.en: Buy what others list: pick the goods, then a seller

exchange_panel:_ready:8.zh: 把仓库里的货挂出去卖
exchange_panel:_ready:8.en: List goods from your store for sale

exchange_panel:_ready:9.zh: 每一笔买卖和挂单，用白话写着
exchange_panel:_ready:9.en: Every trade and listing, in plain words

exchange_panel:_ready:10.zh: 关掉这里，打开星图的航运页：货船在哪、什么时候到
exchange_panel:_ready:10.en: Close this and open the star map's shipping: where freighters are, when they come

exchange_panel:_ready:11.zh: 关掉这里，打开二手船市：买整艘旧船回来拆
exchange_panel:_ready:11.en: Close this and open the hulk market: buy whole old ships to strip

exchange_panel:_ready:14.zh: 一步一步指给你：现在该点哪里
exchange_panel:_ready:14.en: Shows you, step by step, what to press now

exchange_panel:_ready:16.zh: 暂停整个港口和市场的时间，慢慢看；再点一次继续
exchange_panel:_ready:16.en: Stops the port's and the market's clock while you look; press again to go on

exchange_panel:_build_sell_window:2.zh: 价格分布：蓝 = 在收（买单），灰 = 在卖（卖单），橙 = 加急收购，绿框 = 你的价
exchange_panel:_build_sell_window:2.en: PRICES: BLUE BIDS · GREY ASKS · ORANGE RUSH · GREEN YOUR PRICE

exchange_panel:_build_sell_window:4.zh: 拖滑条、直接输入，或点左边的柱子跳到那个价。
exchange_panel:_build_sell_window:4.en: Drag, type, or click a column on the left for its price.

exchange_panel:_build_sell_window:6.zh: 按上面的价钱和数量挂到交易行；有人出到这个价就成交，钱直接到账
exchange_panel:_build_sell_window:6.en: List it at the price and amount above; it sells when a buyer meets the price

exchange_panel:where:1.zh: 本港柜台 · 几十秒到

exchange_panel:where:3.zh: 小行星带 · 货船几分钟

exchange_panel:refresh:4.zh: 贸易港尚未恢复营业 · 可浏览报价，修复后开放交易

exchange_panel:_buy_cards:1.zh: 点一种货，看每一家卖方的报价。
exchange_panel:_buy_cards:1.en: PICK THE GOODS TO SEE EVERY SELLER.

exchange_panel:_sellers:2.zh: 每行是一家卖方的实际报价。点“购买”只按这一家的价格和余量成交。
exchange_panel:_sellers:2.en: EACH ROW IS ONE SELLER. BUY TAKES ONLY THAT SELLER'S PRICE AND STOCK.

exchange_panel:_sell_cards:1.zh: 你库里的货。点一种，自己定价上架，或按港务回收价马上卖掉。
exchange_panel:_sell_cards:1.en: YOUR STOCK. PICK ONE TO LIST AT YOUR PRICE, OR SELL TO THE PORT NOW.

exchange_panel:_update_sell:2.zh: 预期到账（扣 2%% 手续费）：%s

exchange_panel:_update_sell:3.zh: 这个价不高于 %s 的收价 %s：上架就立即成交，钱当场到账。
exchange_panel:_update_sell:3.en: AT OR UNDER %s's BID OF %s: SOLD THE MOMENT IT IS LISTED.

exchange_panel:_update_sell:4.zh: 比现在的最高收价高：挂着等人出到这个价，随时可在交易记录里撤回。
exchange_panel:_update_sell:4.en: OVER THE BEST BID: IT WAITS FOR A BUYER; WITHDRAW ANY TIME FROM RECORDS.

exchange_panel:_update_sell:5.zh: 港务回收价 %s / t · 按回收价卖掉 · 到账 %s
exchange_panel:_update_sell:5.en: PORT BUYBACK %s / t · SELL NOW · PAID %s

exchange_panel:list_it:1.zh: 卖出去了，钱已到账 +%s；搬运车会把货送过去。
exchange_panel:list_it:1.en: SOLD AND PAID +%s; THE COURIER TAKES IT.

exchange_panel:list_it:2.zh: 已上架，有人出到这个价就成交。
exchange_panel:list_it:2.en: LISTED; IT SELLS WHEN A BUYER MEETS THE PRICE.

industrial_sort:_process:2.zh: 分选电费余额不足，驱动已停止；补足资金后可现场重启

industrial_sort:write_off:1.zh: 只能在分选台报损已发运货物

industrial_sort:write_off:2.zh: 未发运原料可直接撤回；产物尚在设备内，不可凭空报损

industrial_sort:write_off:4.zh: 分选缓冲记录无效，保留现场

industrial_sort:write_off:5.zh: 请先清空弃料出口，缓冲内实物尚未弃置

industrial_sort:_materialize_disposals:1.zh: 待交接弃料已有切割碎片，未生成整批替代货物

industrial_sort:_materialize_disposals:2.zh: 弃料现场与待交接质量不符，未生成替代货物

industrial_sort:_materialize_disposals:3.zh: 弃料交接保存失败，未生成新实体

order_settlement:select_sale:3.zh: 出售入账，本次不交付工程。
order_settlement:select_sale:3.en: Sell for cash. No engineering delivery this time.

order_settlement:select_sale:5.zh: 交付完成后：获得自有牵引锚与监测探头。
order_settlement:select_sale:5.en: AFTER DELIVERY: receive an owned anchor and monitoring probe.

order_settlement:select_sale:7.zh: 预留入库；下次带回剩余目标即可继续交付。
order_settlement:select_sale:7.en: Keep these goods reserved. Bring the remaining targets on a later job.

process_queue:line:1.zh: %s：已熔 %.1f t · 已轧钢板 %.1f t

queue_panel:_ready:2.zh: 远程 · 炉台和轧机照这个顺序取料
queue_panel:_ready:2.en: REMOTE · THE FURNACE AND THE MILL TAKE THEM IN THIS ORDER

queue_panel:_ready:3.zh: ↑ ↓ 选一批 · W / S 上下移 · Home 放到最前 · Esc 关闭
queue_panel:_ready:3.en: ↑ ↓ PICK · W / S MOVE · HOME TO THE FRONT · ESC CLOSE

queue_panel:_fill:1.zh: 没有排队的钢锭。结算时选“留着加工”的钢锭会排到这里。
queue_panel:_fill:1.en: NOTHING QUEUED. INGOTS KEPT FOR PROCESSING AT A SETTLEMENT COME HERE.

queue_panel:_fill:2.zh: 选中这一批，看它的详情
queue_panel:_fill:2.en: Pick this batch and see it

queue_panel:_fill:4.zh: 往前排一位：早一点加工

queue_panel:_fill:5.zh: 往后排一位：晚一点加工

queue_panel:_fill:6.zh: 排到最前：下一个就加工它

sort_panel:_ready:2.zh:
压块 → 撕碎 → 磁选 → 线上化验 → 电弧炉
有色料回仓库 · 电费按电网
sort_panel:_ready:2.en:
PRESS / SHRED / MAGNETS / IN-LINE ASSAY / ARC FURNACE
NONFERROUS TO THE WAREHOUSE

sort_panel:_ready:7.zh: 展开或收起分选台的更多操作
sort_panel:_ready:7.en: Show or hide the sorting desk's other keys

sort_panel:_ready:8.zh: 分选台的下一步，按当前状态来（Enter）
sort_panel:_ready:8.en: The sorting desk's next step, as it stands now (Enter)

sort_panel:_ready:10.zh: 把这些原料送去只分选不进炉，分出的两路产物都回仓库
sort_panel:_ready:10.en: Send this feed to be sorted only; both outputs go back to the store

sort_panel:_ready:12.zh: 立刻开动分选线的电机
sort_panel:_ready:12.en: Start the sorting line's drives now

sort_panel:_ready:14.zh: 立刻停下分选线的电机
sort_panel:_ready:14.en: Stop the sorting line's drives now

sort_panel:_ready:16.zh: 还没分选的原料退回仓库
sort_panel:_ready:16.en: Send the feed not yet sorted back to the store

sort_panel:_ready:18.zh: 这批货直接报废扔掉，钱不退；只在救不回来时用
sort_panel:_ready:18.en: Scrap this batch for nothing; only when it cannot be saved

sort_panel:_next:1.zh: 整线加工（分选 → 化验 → 炼钢）

sort_panel:_next:5.zh: 分选中 · 设备里 %.2f t

sort_panel:_next:6.zh: 黑色料过化验、进电弧炉…
sort_panel:_next:6.en: FERROUS TO THE ASSAY AND THE FURNACE…

sort_panel:_next:8.zh: 整线加工（分选 → 化验 → 炼钢）

sort_panel:_process:6.zh: 一键跑完整条线：原料从仓库运来，分选后黑色料经线上化验直接进电弧炉，炉子自己通电；你到炉台测温、出钢。有色料回仓库。
sort_panel:_process:6.en: ONE PRESS RUNS THE LINE: FERROUS STRAIGHT TO THE ARC FURNACE, WHICH STARTS ITSELF; YOU SAMPLE AND TAP AT THE FURNACE DESK.

guide:_at:3.zh: 出船坞闸口就是拆船区站，按 %s 坐接驳车到加工区；也可以跟着屏幕边上的箭头飞过去。
guide:_at:3.en: Out of the berth's gate is the salvage stop: %s calls the shuttle to the processing district; or follow the arrow at the screen's edge.

guide:_sort:2.zh: 整线加工：分选 → 线上化验 → 黑色料直接进电弧炉；有色料回仓库
guide:_sort:2.en: The through line: sorted, assayed in line, straight into the arc furnace

guide:_sort:3.zh: 等原料沿吊轨运到分选线

guide:_sort:4.zh: 搬运车正从仓库把料运过来。
guide:_sort:4.en: The courier is bringing the feed.

guide:_sort:6.zh: 撤回的原料正运回仓库。
guide:_sort:6.en: The withdrawn feed is going back.

guide:_sort:9.zh: 压块 → 撕碎 → 磁选进行中

guide:_sort:10.zh: 机器自己在跑，不用守着。

guide:_sort:11.zh: 黑色料过线上化验，进电弧炉
guide:_sort:11.en: FERROUS THROUGH THE ASSAY INTO THE FURNACE

guide:_sort:12.zh: 化验位读数约 30 秒，合格的直接进炉，炉子自己通电。
guide:_sort:12.en: A 30 s reading; then into the furnace, which starts itself.

guide:_sort:17.zh: 仓库里没有可分选的金属

guide:_assay:2.zh: 只读样品、定等级，和旁边的熔炉无关：杂质 ≤ 3% 的黑色炉料整批升为等级 1 才能进炉
guide:_assay:2.en: Reads a sample and grades the lot (nothing to do with the furnace beside it): ≤ 3% impurity makes grade 1 feed

guide:_assay:4.zh: 约 30 秒，读完自动入账；不用守着。

guide:_assay:5.zh: 化验合格：整批升为等级 1 炉料
guide:_assay:5.en: PASSED: the lot is grade 1 feed

guide:_assay:6.zh: 化验不合格：杂质太高，只能按未评级卖
guide:_assay:6.en: FAILED: too much impurity, sell it unrated

guide:_assay:7.zh: 化验完成：旧料有了材料描述，可以分选
guide:_assay:7.en: READ: the old lot can now be sorted

guide:_assay:11.zh: 仓库里没有要化验的料

guide:_heat:2.zh: 把钢锭重新熔成钢水、浇成钢坯，卖给工业客户
guide:_heat:2.en: Melts grade 1 feed and casts billets for industrial clients

guide:_heat:6.zh: 填炉料吨数，按『把仓库炉料送到炉口』

guide:_heat:7.zh: 送 %.2f t 钢锭去炉口（在哪都能按）
guide:_heat:7.en: SEND %.2f t OF INGOT TO THE FURNACE (FROM ANYWHERE)

guide:_heat:8.zh: 按卡片上的按钮就开始送，你飞过去的路上料也在走；到了炉台再按『通电熔化』。
guide:_heat:8.en: The card's button starts it; the feed travels while you fly over. At the desk, strike the arcs.

guide:_clients:1.zh: 钢坯已入库：按 F3 打开仓库，可以卖给回收站或留着
guide:_clients:1.en: THE BILLETS ARE IN STORE: F3 TO SELL OR KEEP

guide:_clients:2.zh: 钢坯卖出去了，钱已到账

guide:_clients:3.zh: 钢坯卖出去了，钱已到账

guide:_clients:4.en: UNDER SELL: PICK THE BILLETS, PRESS LIST IT

guide:_clients:5.zh: 价格默认就是客户的收价，上架当场成交、钱当场到账，货由搬运车送，不用你发货。
guide:_clients:5.en: The price starts at the client's bid: sold and paid at once, delivered for you.

guide:_clients:6.zh: 点卡片上的按钮打开交易行。
guide:_clients:6.en: Use the button on this card to open the exchange.

guide:_buy_feed:3.en: Usable once it is in the warehouse.

guide:_buy_feed:5.zh: 在交易行选『黑色炉料』等级 1，点一家卖方的『购买』
guide:_buy_feed:5.en: BUY GRADE 1 FERROUS FEED FROM A SELLER

guide:_buy_feed:6.zh: 没有自己的料时，先买合格炉料开炉。
guide:_buy_feed:6.en: No feed of your own yet: buy grade 1 to run a heat.

guide:_repair:3.zh: 施工暂停：无人机离吊装区远一点
guide:_repair:3.en: WORK STOPPED: MOVE THE DRONE OUT OF THE LIFT ZONE

guide:_repair:4.zh: 吊装时无人机在 %d m 内，施工队不能吊。
guide:_repair:4.en: The crew cannot lift with the drone within %d m.

guide:_repair:5.zh: 施工队在修「%s」：还要约 %d 秒

guide:_repair:6.zh: 零件已经交给施工队了，等它修完就能用。
guide:_repair:6.en: The parts are with the crew; it works once they are done.

guide:_repair:8.zh: 跟着箭头，飞近就会记进报修。
guide:_repair:8.en: Follow the arrow: close up, it is logged.

guide:_repair:11.zh: 修好后回船坞就能看到施工。
guide:_repair:11.en: You will see the work done back at the berth.

guide:_repair:13.zh: 点卡片上的按钮打开船坞修缮页。
guide:_repair:13.en: Open the berth repairs with the button on this card.

guide:_repair:15.zh: 接一单合同挣钱，或在账本里借款。
guide:_repair:15.en: Take a job, or borrow on the ledger.

guide:_repair:17.zh: 拆下的船壳送熔炉攒吨数

guide:_build:2.en: EVERY PORT STAGE THAT CAN BE BUILT IS BUILT

guide:_build:7.zh: 点击任务卡上的按钮，打开港区建设菜单。
guide:_build:7.en: Open the port works with the button on this card.

guide:_build:9.zh: 接合同攒零件、结构吨和钱。
guide:_build:9.en: Take jobs for parts, structure and money.

guide:_transit:3.zh: 到站自动开门放你出来。
guide:_transit:3.en: It lets you out at the stop.

guide:_transit:4.zh: 坐过一次接驳车了：任何站台按 E 都能叫车
guide:_transit:4.en: YOU HAVE RIDDEN IT: E AT ANY STOP CALLS IT

guide:_transit:5.zh: 接驳车沿走廊轨道连通六区，比飞快
guide:_transit:5.en: The shuttle runs the corridors to every district

guide:_transit:7.zh: 车会先开到你这一站接你。
guide:_transit:7.en: The car comes to your stop first.

guide:_transit:10.zh: 从船坞顶上的闸口出去，站台就在闸口正上方。
guide:_transit:10.en: Out through the gate above the berth: the stop is right over it.

guide:_transit:11.en: Follow the arrow at the screen's edge.

guide:_trade:1.zh: 成交了：货会实际运进仓库，到了才能用
guide:_trade:1.en: BOUGHT: THE GOODS ARE SHIPPED IN, USABLE ON ARRIVAL

guide:_trade:3.zh: 只按这一家的价格和余量成交。
guide:_trade:3.en: Only this seller's price and stock.

guide:_trade:5.zh: 点一种货的卡片，再点一家卖方的『购买』
guide:_trade:5.en: PICK THE GOODS' CARD, THEN BUY FROM ONE SELLER

guide:_trade:6.zh: 每行是一家卖方的实际报价和余量，写着货从哪来、多久到。
guide:_trade:6.en: Each row is one seller's real offer, where from and how soon.

guide:_trade:9.zh: 买原料、卖产品、接工业客户都在这里。
guide:_trade:9.en: Buy feed, sell products, serve clients.

guide:_retain:1.zh: 这一单的结构钢会记成公司原料进仓库
guide:_retain:1.en: THIS JOB'S STRUCTURAL STEEL GOES TO THE WAREHOUSE

guide:_retain:2.zh: 打开『废金属留作原料』，再按开工
guide:_retain:2.en: SWITCH ON KEEP THE SCRAP, THEN GO

guide:_retain:3.zh: 代价：这部分回收价不付现金，也不算修缮用的结构吨。
guide:_retain:3.en: It costs the scrap's cash and its repair tonnes.

guide:_retain:6.zh: 接单后弹出的配装页里有留料开关。
guide:_retain:6.en: The switch is on the loadout page after you sign.

guide:_collect:3.en: THE FREIGHTER IS ON ITS WAY

guide:_collect:4.zh: 到港后会靠上货运区码头；星图上能看它沿转移轨道飞。
guide:_collect:4.en: It will moor at the cargo pier; follow its arc on the star map.

guide:_collect:7.zh: 货是实物：进了收货口才算入库
guide:_collect:7.en: Goods are real: stock once inside the receiver

guide:_collect:9.zh: 货运区修好了，3 t 以下的件吊车自动搬。
guide:_collect:9.en: With the cargo district mended the crane takes pieces under 3 t.

guide:_collect:11.zh: 从院子东门进去，整件放进左边 WAREHOUSE 框里松开。
guide:_collect:11.en: Through the yard's east gate; let go with the whole piece inside the WAREHOUSE frame.

guide:_collect:13.zh: 整件放进货舱里松开，装满就起航。
guide:_collect:13.en: Let go with the whole piece inside the hold; it sails when loaded.

guide:_collect:14.zh: 飞到出货台，抓住一件货
guide:_collect:14.en: GRAPPLE A PIECE ON THE LOADING TABLE

guide:_collect:15.zh: 飞到 %d 号船位，抓住一件货
guide:_collect:15.en: FLY TO BERTH %d, GRAPPLE A PIECE

guide:_collect:16.zh: 飞到码头空地，抓住一件货
guide:_collect:16.en: FLY TO THE APRON, GRAPPLE A PIECE

guide:_collect:17.zh: 码头在货运区下方仓库院子的东边。
guide:_collect:17.en: The pier runs east from the warehouse yard under the cargo district.

guide:_next:1.zh: 黑色料已经在电弧炉里，去炉台测温、出钢
guide:_next:1.en: the ferrous is in the furnace: sample and tap

guide:_next:2.zh: 黑色炉料还没评级，要先化验
guide:_next:2.en: the feed is unrated: assay it

guide:_next:5.en: the feed is in: run a heat

guide:act:1.zh: 钢锭出库了：%.2f t 正送往炉口
guide:act:1.en: THE INGOTS ARE ON THEIR WAY: %.2f t

mainline:顶层:4.en: THE RECYCLER PAYS SIXTY PER CENT

mainline:顶层:10.zh: 让中央转运环重新转起来
mainline:顶层:10.en: GET THE TRANSFER RING TURNING AGAIN

mainline:trigger_text:1.en: Once the first hulk is stripped

mainline:trigger_text:3.zh: 仓库里钢锭攒到 %.0f 吨时
mainline:trigger_text:3.en: When %.0f t of ingots are in store

mainline:trigger_text:5.zh: 第一次因为缺电，炉子或叉车变慢时
mainline:trigger_text:5.en: The first time the furnace or the forklifts slow for want of power

mainline:trigger_text:6.zh: 星图扫到超过 %d m 的船时
mainline:trigger_text:6.en: When the star map finds a hulk over %d m

mainline:trigger_text:7.zh: 扫到超过 %d m、船坞放不下的船时
mainline:trigger_text:7.en: When a hulk over %d m turns up, too long for the berth

mainline:trigger_text:8.en: Once the districts before it are mended

mainline:opens_text:2.zh: 修船坞照明 → 看得清、切得快
mainline:opens_text:2.en: Mend the berth's lights: clear readings, faster cutting

mainline:opens_text:3.zh: 修熔炉和接碎料的网 → 碎料炼成钢锭
mainline:opens_text:3.en: Mend the furnace and the net: scrap becomes ingots

mainline:opens_text:4.zh: 修贸易港一期 → 交易行、订单板（即将开放）
mainline:opens_text:4.en: Mend the trade port: exchange and order board (opening soon)

mainline:opens_text:5.zh: 修加工区一期 → 钢锭炼成钢坯
mainline:opens_text:5.en: Mend the processing district: ingots into billets

mainline:opens_text:6.zh: 修货运区 → 仓库 8×32 变 8×48
mainline:opens_text:6.en: Mend the cargo district: the stores grow 8×32 → 8×48

mainline:opens_text:7.zh: 修动力区 → 自家发电，炉子和叉车不再变慢
mainline:opens_text:7.en: Mend the power district: your own power, no more slowdowns

mainline:opens_text:8.zh: 修拖船站 → 能拖超过 %d m 的船
mainline:opens_text:8.en: Mend the tug station: tow hulks over %d m

mainline:opens_text:9.zh: 把船坞扩到 88 m → 能拆更大的船
mainline:opens_text:9.en: Extend the berth to 88 m for bigger hulks

mainline:_repair_step:1.zh: 先飞去看「%s」坏在哪（飞近就记下）。
mainline:_repair_step:1.en: Fly over and look at the %s (close up logs it).

mainline:_repair_step:2.en: Mend %s: parts and money are there.

mainline:_build_step:4.zh: 修%s：飞到它的业务终端按 %s，点“修”。%s
mainline:_build_step:4.en: Mend the %s: %s at its business console, then MEND. %s

mainline:_build_step:5.zh: 修%s：%s。先拆船攒钱，或者卖掉仓库里的东西。
mainline:_build_step:5.en: Mend the %s: %s. Strip hulks or sell from the stores first.

mainline:_build_step:7.en: To mend the %s (part %s) you still need: %s.

mainline:_next_ship:1.zh: 船到港了：%s 开终端，在“找船”里开工。
mainline:_next_ship:1.en: A hulk is home: %s, start it under Find Ships.

mainline:_next_ship:2.zh: 拖船在路上，约 %d 秒到港。
mainline:_next_ship:2.en: The tug is on its way: about %d s.

mainline:_next_ship:3.zh: 已找到船：%s 开星图，派拖船。
mainline:_next_ship:3.en: A hulk is found: %s, send the tug.

mainline:step:1.zh: 施工暂停：无人机在吊装区（%d m 内）。飞远些就接着干（还要约 %d 秒）。
mainline:step:1.en: WORK STOPPED: THE DRONE IS IN THE LIFT ZONE (%d m). MOVE AWAY (~%d s LEFT).

mainline:step:4.zh: 开始拆 %s：%s 开终端，在“找船”里开工。
mainline:step:4.en: Start on %s: %s, pick it under Find Ships.

mainline:step:6.zh: 照明坏了：看不清读数、切得慢。
mainline:step:6.en: The lights are out: poor readings, slow cutting.

mainline:step:7.zh: 钢坯已入库：按 F3 打开仓库，可以卖给回收站或留着。
mainline:step:7.en: Billets in store: F3 opens the warehouse — sell to the recycler or keep.

mainline:step:8.zh: 有钢坯了：去交易行挂价卖。
mainline:step:8.en: Billets in stock: list them on the exchange.

mainline:step:9.zh: 去加工区炉台，把钢锭炼成钢坯。
mainline:step:9.en: To the furnace desk: melt the ingots into billets.

mainline:step:10.zh: 去加工区化验台，测废铁杂质。
mainline:step:10.en: To the assay bench: test the scrap.

mainline:step:11.zh: 去加工区分选台，把混合金属分开。
mainline:step:11.en: To the sorting desk: separate the mixed metal.

mainline:step:12.zh: 仓库没有钢锭：再拆一艘船，碎料会炼成钢锭。
mainline:step:12.en: No ingots: strip another ship; its scrap becomes ingots.

mainline:step:13.zh: 远航者工程还没做好，以后的版本开放。
mainline:step:13.en: The Ark project comes in a later version.

ops:_grid:1.zh: 自家能发 %.0f · 已分出去 %.1f · 还空着 %.1f 兆瓦
ops:_grid:1.en: WE MAKE %.0f · GIVEN OUT %.1f · FREE %.1f MW

ops:_grid:2.zh: 动力区 %d / 2 期 · 大设备 %d / %d 有电

ops:_grid:4.en: THE FURNACE IS SHORT OF POWER

ops:_shipping:1.zh: 排队大船 %s · 下次开市可接

ops:_shipping:2.zh: 拖运费：派拖船时付，自家拖船待命时半价
ops:_shipping:2.en: TOWING: PAID WHEN THE TUG GOES, HALF WITH YOUR OWN TUG

ops:decisions:1.zh: 欠了 %s 电费，机器停了
ops:decisions:1.en: %s OF POWER UNPAID: THE MACHINES STOPPED

ops:decisions:2.zh: 去那台机器的面板上把电费交了，再开机。
ops:decisions:2.en: Pay at the machine's panel, then start it again.

ops:decisions:3.zh: 下次结算要还 %s 欠款，现在的钱不够
ops:decisions:3.en: %s OF DEBT IS DUE AT THE NEXT SETTLEMENT: NOT ENOUGH CASH

ops:decisions:4.zh: 拆完下一艘船结算时会自动扣。先拆一艘船，或者把仓库里的东西卖掉。

guidepage:M01:body.zh:
拆船时，船壳、甲板这些废料掉进船坞熔炉，炼成钢锭。

结算时在回收整理页把钢锭拖进右边“我的仓库”，它就进了货运区仓库（A1 排）。按 F3 打开公司仓库，能看到现在有多少吨。

交易行里也能买钢锭（等级 1 黑色炉料）。
guidepage:M01:body.en: Scrap from the hull goes into the berth furnace and comes out as ingots. Keep them at settlement and they go to the cargo warehouse (row A1); F3 shows how many tonnes. The exchange sells ingots too.

guidepage:M02:title.en: Send the ingots to the furnace

guidepage:M02:body.zh:
加工区要先修好一期。

在引导卡上按「送料到炉口」，或者到加工区炉台按 E，填好这一炉的吨数（0.25～2 吨），点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。

叉车从货架取料、吊轨车运到炉口，大约 20 秒。在哪按都行：你飞过去的路上，料也在走。
guidepage:M02:body.en: The processing district must be mended first. Press Send the feed on the guide card, or at the furnace desk set 0.25–2 t and send it. The forklift and the rail trolley bring it in about 20 s; it travels while you fly over.

guidepage:M03:body.zh:
料到炉口后，在炉台按「通电熔化」：自动装炉、起弧，温度自己控制，不用调功率。

熔得多快，看电弧炉分到多少电。炉台写着“实际在用多少、分到多少”，还有大约多久能出钢。

动力区没修时，全港只有一台旧主机，约 6 兆瓦，电弧炉只能分到 3～4 兆瓦（满功率 24），一炉 2 吨要十几分钟。
guidepage:M03:body.en: At the desk, Strike the arcs: it charges, strikes and holds the temperature by itself. How fast depends on the power it gets; the desk shows what it draws, what it is given and how long is left. With the power district unmended the port has about 6 MW, and the furnace gets 3–4 of its 24 MW: a 2 t heat takes over ten minutes.

guidepage:M04:body.zh:
有三个办法，各有代价：

· 买外购电补上：快，但比自家发的电贵 5 倍；
· 在动力区控制屏把加工区排到拆船区前面：炉子快了，拆船的激光和传送带会变慢；
· 修动力区：一期能发 30 兆瓦，从此都够用。

拆船时，船坞熔炉排在前面会把电拿走，电弧炉可能停下来降温；拆完再回来，它会接着熔。
guidepage:M04:body.en: Three ways, each with a price: buy power (five times dearer than our own), move processing ahead of salvage at the power control screen (salvage slows), or mend the power district (30 MW at stage 1). While you strip a ship the berth furnace comes first and the arc furnace may stop and cool; it carries on afterwards.

guidepage:M05:body.zh: 全部熔化、温度到 1640 °C 以后，炉台按「测温取样」。等测温探头完全收回，再按「倾炉出钢」。\n\n超过 1710 °C 会把成品烧成低等级。装了自动测温出钢以后，这两步由机器自己做。
guidepage:M05:body.en: Once all is melted at 1640 °C, Take a sample; when the probe is up, Tilt and tap. Over 1710 °C downgrades the product. With the auto unit fitted, the machine does both.

guidepage:M06:title.en: Billets cool and go to the warehouse

guidepage:M06:body.zh:
出钢后炉里空了，不再通电，炉温会往下掉，这是正常的。

钢坯在铸造线上冷却两三分钟，凉了吊轨车把它运回仓库。完成时会弹出“本次加工完成”，写着得了多少吨、放在哪一排；按 F3 在公司仓库的“加工成品”里也能看到。

注意：轧机开着“连续轧”时，钢坯一入库就会被轧成钢板。
guidepage:M06:body.en: After tapping the furnace is empty and draws nothing; its temperature falls, as it should. The billets cool on the line for two or three minutes and the trolley takes them home. A card says how many tonnes and which row; F3 shows them under Products. With the mill rolling on, billet is rolled into plate as soon as it comes in.

guidepage:M07:body.zh:
按 F8 打开交易行，在「出售」里选货、填数量和价格挂牌；有人买就成交，钱当场到账，货由叉车和码头送走。

也可以在公司仓库（F3）点那样东西，按「去交易行挂牌卖」。

完整设备不用挂牌：在公司仓库或零件架上直接出售。
guidepage:M07:body.en: F8 opens the exchange: under Sell, pick the goods, quantity and price; when someone buys, the cash is there at once and the goods ship. From the stores (F3), a thing's List it button does the same. Whole equipment sells straight from the stores or the parts rack.

guidepage:M08:body.zh: 船壳、甲板、龙骨这些废料进熔炉，炼成钢锭；完整设备走设备口，结算时放进“我的仓库”就进了零件架，也可以当场卖掉；危险品走危险品口。\n\n没分选的废金属要先在分选台分开、化验位定级，才能当炉料。
guidepage:M08:body.en: Hull, decks and keel become scrap and then ingots in the furnace; whole equipment goes in by the equipment mouth and, kept at settlement, onto the parts rack (or sold there and then); hazards use theirs. Unsorted scrap must be sorted and assayed before it is furnace feed.

codex:cx_bolt_a.zh: 可拆的固定点，维护工具拧下即松开，零件完好。
codex:cx_bolt_a.en: A fixing made to come undone: the wrench backs it out and the part stays whole.

codex:cx_bolt_b.zh: 最后一颗松开，零件就没东西拉住，会带着惯性漂走。
codex:cx_bolt_b.en: Take the last one out and nothing holds the part: it drifts off with whatever motion it had.

codex:cx_bolt_c.zh: 先用抓钩稳住，再松最后一颗。
codex:cx_bolt_c.en: Steady it with the grapple first, then the last bolt.

codex:cx_bolt_x.zh: 船上的螺栓多是 M12–M24 的高强度螺栓，靠预紧力把两件压在一起，承受剪切和拉力的是摩擦面而不是螺杆本身。拧松它不改变零件本身，所以“能拧就别切”：螺栓拆下的设备保留全部价值，切开的只值废金属价。失重下没有地板替你接住东西，一件 0.5 t 的板只要 0.1 m/s 的余速，十秒后就离开一米。
codex:cx_bolt_x.en: Ship bolts are mostly high-strength M12–M24, preloaded so the friction between the faces carries the load, not the shank. Backing one out changes nothing about the part, hence the rule \"unbolt before you cut\": unbolted equipment keeps its full value, cut equipment is scrap. In free fall nothing catches what you loosen: a 0.5 t plate with 0.1 m/s left on it is a metre away ten seconds later.

codex:cx_weld_a.zh: 两件金属熔成一体的连接，扳手拧不开。
codex:cx_weld_a.en: Two pieces of metal fused into one. No wrench undoes it.

codex:cx_weld_b.zh: 只能切。切开的位置决定剩下的东西还值多少。
codex:cx_weld_b.en: Only the laser parts it, and where you cut decides what the pieces are worth.

codex:cx_weld_c.zh: 沿焊缝或标线切，别切进设备本体。
codex:cx_weld_c.en: Cut along the seam or a marked line, never through the equipment itself.

codex:cx_weld_x.zh: 结构焊缝的强度和母材相当，激光要把整个截面熔透才算切开。切割速度由材料决定：普通钢板快，装甲和厚梁慢，冰和复合材料各有自己的规矩。激光前沿只按材料的限速追着光标走，贴着边慢慢推才提交切口——急着来回扫只会烧出一道浅沟。
codex:cx_weld_x.en: A structural weld is as strong as the plate around it; the beam has to melt the whole section through before it parts. How fast depends on the material: thin steel quick, armour and heavy beams slow, ice and composites with rules of their own. The cut front follows the cursor only as fast as the material lets it, and commits when it reaches the edge — sweeping back and forth just burns a shallow groove.

codex:cx_lock_a.zh: 带锁销的快拆固定件，常藏在别的件后面。
codex:cx_lock_a.en: A quick-release fixing with a locking pin, often hidden behind something else.

codex:cx_lock_b.zh: 漏掉一个锁扣硬拽，零件会被扯坏或扯断锁扣弹开。
codex:cx_lock_b.en: Miss one and pull, and the part tears or the lock snaps and lets it fly.

codex:cx_lock_c.zh: 拽之前看光标提示还剩几个固定点。
codex:cx_lock_c.en: Before you pull, read how many fixings the cursor says are left.

codex:cx_lock_x.zh: 锁扣用在需要快速更换的地方：检修盖、可更换单元、货物托盘。它和螺栓一样能用维护工具打开，但拉力过大时会先于零件失效——所以抓钩硬拽时，被扯断的是锁扣，被撕坏的可能是零件的安装耳。拉扯只会扯断锁扣和管线，螺栓不会断。
codex:cx_lock_x.en: Locks go where things are meant to come out fast: service covers, replaceable units, cargo pallets. The wrench opens them like bolts, but under a big enough pull they fail before the part does — so when the grapple yanks, what snaps is the lock, and what tears may be the part's mounting ear. A pull only ever breaks locks and lines; bolts don't give.

codex:cx_clamp_a.zh: 船坞的液压夹爪，把整艘船固定在泊位上。
codex:cx_clamp_a.en: The berth's hydraulic jaws holding the whole ship in place.

codex:cx_clamp_b.zh: 夹具只夹某几件结构：把它们拆走，整艘船会松脱漂移。
codex:cx_clamp_b.en: They grip a few structural pieces: take those away and the ship comes loose and drifts.

codex:cx_clamp_c.zh: 最后再拆夹具咬着的那几件。
codex:cx_clamp_c.en: Leave whatever the clamps bite on until last.

codex:cx_clamp_x.zh: 夹具通常咬在龙骨或底板上。一艘几百吨的船只要获得 0.05 m/s，撞上泊位端墙时的冲量就足以撞坏舱内松动的设备。夹具咬着的件在蓝图里有标记，拆到后半程时先确认剩下的船体还有夹具抓着。
codex:cx_clamp_x.en: The clamps usually bite the keel or the floor plates. A few hundred tonnes of ship picking up 0.05 m/s hits the berth's end wall hard enough to wreck anything loose inside. The pieces the clamps hold are marked on the drawing; late in a job, check what's left is still held.

codex:cx_hull_a.zh: 船的外皮，也是舱室的气密边界。
codex:cx_hull_a.en: The ship's skin, and the airtight wall of the rooms behind it.

codex:cx_hull_b.zh: 舱里还有气就切开，舱压会把板和里面的东西一起喷出去。
codex:cx_hull_b.en: Cut it with air still inside and the pressure blows the plate out, and what's behind it with it.

codex:cx_hull_c.zh: 先测舱压，放气到 5 kPa 以下再动它。
codex:cx_hull_c.en: Measure the room, vent it below 5 kPa, then work on it.

codex:cx_hull_x.zh: 一个标准大气压是 101 kPa，也就是每平方米 10 吨的力。一块 1 × 2 m 的舱壁板背后有 100 kPa，就有 20 吨在推它；切出一条缝，气流在缝口达到音速，几秒内把松动的零件和碎屑带出去。舱室低于 5 kPa 视为安全。
codex:cx_hull_x.en: One atmosphere is 101 kPa, ten tonnes on every square metre. A 1 × 2 m panel with 100 kPa behind it has twenty tonnes pushing on it; open a slit and the flow through it goes sonic, carrying loose parts and debris out within seconds. Below 5 kPa a room counts as safe.

codex:cx_bulkhead_a.zh: 把船分成独立气密舱的内部隔墙。
codex:cx_bulkhead_a.en: An internal wall dividing the ship into separate airtight rooms.

codex:cx_bulkhead_b.zh: 两侧压力不同时切开，高压一侧的气体和东西冲向低压一侧。
codex:cx_bulkhead_b.en: Cut it with different pressures each side and the high side's air and loose things rush through.

codex:cx_bulkhead_c.zh: 两侧舱室都测一遍压力，先放气或平衡。
codex:cx_bulkhead_c.en: Measure the rooms on both sides; vent or equalise first.

codex:cx_bulkhead_x.zh: 舱壁让一个舱的事故不扩散到全船，也让你可以分舱处理：一个舱放完气，隔壁可能还满着。压差才是危险的来源——两侧都是 100 kPa 时切开舱壁不会爆，但两个舱从此变成一个，放气时要一起放。
codex:cx_bulkhead_x.en: Bulkheads keep one room's trouble out of the next, and let you work room by room: one emptied, the next may still be full. The danger is the difference: with 100 kPa on both sides a cut doesn't blow, but the two rooms become one and have to be vented together.

codex:cx_frame_a.zh: 龙骨、肋骨、纵梁、支撑杆：船的骨架。
codex:cx_frame_a.en: Keel, frames, longitudinals, struts: the ship's skeleton.

codex:cx_frame_b.zh: 切断还在承重的骨架，它托着的部分会坠落、弹开或扭断。
codex:cx_frame_b.en: Cut a member still carrying load and what it held drops, springs or twists off.

codex:cx_frame_c.zh: 先卸掉它托着的重量，最后再拆骨架。
codex:cx_frame_c.en: Take the weight off it first; the frame comes out last.

codex:cx_frame_x.zh: 失重下没有重力载荷，但还有预紧、惯性和船坞夹具传来的力：一根梁可能正把两台几十吨的设备撑在原位。骨架件通常很重，常超过抓钩 3 t 的上限，要沿标线切成段再运走。
codex:cx_frame_x.en: Free fall takes gravity away, not preload, inertia or the clamps' grip: a beam may be what keeps two machines of tens of tonnes in place. Frame pieces are heavy, often past the grapple's 3 t, and go out in sections cut along their marked lines.

codex:cx_door_a.zh: 通往舱室的门，多数靠总线供电开关。
codex:cx_door_a.en: The way into a room; most open on power from the ship's bus.

codex:cx_door_b.zh: 舱里有气就开门，门会被气压推开爆开；断电后有些门打不开。
codex:cx_door_b.en: Open it with air inside and the pressure blows it open; with the power cut some won't open at all.

codex:cx_door_c.zh: 先放气再开门；要开的门，在断电前开。
codex:cx_door_c.en: Vent the room before the door; open the doors you need before you cut the power.

codex:cx_door_x.zh: 一扇 2 m² 的门背后 60 kPa，就有 12 吨压在门上，电机打不开，锁一松就会被整扇推飞。货舱大门常由电机或液压驱动：先断了电池，它就只能切开。船坞的外部供电插座可以在断船电后给门临时供电。
codex:cx_door_x.en: A 2 m² door with 60 kPa behind it carries twelve tonnes: no motor opens that, and the moment the latch gives the whole leaf flies. Big cargo doors run on motors or hydraulics: kill the battery first and the only way through is the laser. The berth's external power socket can feed a door once the ship's own power is off.

codex:cx_rail_a.zh: 货物、吊车或滑架沿着走的导轨。
codex:cx_rail_a.en: A guide rail cargo, cranes or cradles run along.

codex:cx_rail_b.zh: 切到还托着东西的轨道，那件东西会被扯坏或掉下去。
codex:cx_rail_b.en: Cut a rail still carrying something and that thing is torn or dropped.

codex:cx_rail_c.zh: 先把轨道上的东西运走，再拆轨道。
codex:cx_rail_c.en: Move what's on the rail off it first, then the rail.

codex:cx_rail_x.zh: 导轨把载荷分散到很多个支座上；切断一段，载荷全落到断口两边的支座，常常超出它们的能力。锁轨货物要从轨道上开出去，不能用扳手卸——见各船的锁轨条目。
codex:cx_rail_x.en: A rail spreads its load over many mounts; cut a length and the whole load falls on the two either side of the gap, usually more than they take. Rail-locked cargo is driven off its rail, not unbolted — see the rail-locked cargo entry.

codex:cx_film_a.zh: 几微米厚的聚酰亚胺膜：帆面、气囊壁、遮阳膜。
codex:cx_film_a.en: Polyimide a few microns thick: sail panels, gasbag walls, sunshades.

codex:cx_film_b.zh: 绷紧时一切就撕，裂口会沿张力方向跑开。
codex:cx_film_b.en: Under tension it doesn't cut, it tears, and the tear runs along the load.

codex:cx_film_c.zh: 先松掉张力，再整块拆下。
codex:cx_film_c.en: Slack it first, then take it off in whole panels.

codex:cx_film_x.zh: 薄膜的抗撕裂强度只有每米几牛，而张紧的帆面每米承受几十牛的膜应力。激光切出的切口是一个尖锐的裂纹源，在张力下以接近声速扩展。薄膜几乎没有质量，不挡碰撞也不挡路径，但会挡光、带静电。
codex:cx_film_x.en: Film resists tearing at a few newtons per metre; a tensioned sail panel carries tens of newtons per metre of membrane stress. A laser kerf is a sharp crack start, and under tension it runs at close to the speed of sound. Film has next to no mass and doesn't block the drone, but it shades light and holds static charge.

codex:cx_cable_a.zh: 设备和电网之间的供电线，两端是可拔的接头。
codex:cx_cable_a.en: A power line from a device to the grid, with a plug at each end.

codex:cx_cable_b.zh: 带电拔或切会起弧，伤到无人机和设备。
codex:cx_cable_b.en: Pull or cut it live and it arcs, hurting the drone and the equipment.

codex:cx_cable_c.zh: 验电确认 0 V，再拔接头带走设备。
codex:cx_cable_c.en: Test it to 0 V, then unplug it and take the equipment.

codex:cx_cable_x.zh: 30 V 以下的电不会伤到无人机；船上的总线常在 28–400 V 之间，电容组可达上千伏。直流电弧不会像交流那样每秒过零 100 次自行熄灭，一旦拉起来就会一直烧。设备的电缆没拔，抓钩拉它会被拉住——拉力大了，扯断的是接头。
codex:cx_cable_x.en: Under 30 V can't hurt the drone; ship buses run 28 to 400 V and capacitor banks reach a thousand and more. A DC arc doesn't go out by itself a hundred times a second like AC does; drawn once, it keeps burning. A device still plugged in is held by its cable — pull hard enough and the plug is what tears.

codex:cx_pipe_line_a.zh: 冷却液、燃料或气体的管路，两端有接头。
codex:cx_pipe_line_a.en: A line for coolant, fuel or gas, with a coupling at each end.

codex:cx_pipe_line_b.zh: 满管切开会漏，燃料会成可燃云，热管会烫伤。
codex:cx_pipe_line_b.en: Cut a full line and it leaks: fuel makes a flammable cloud, a hot line burns.

codex:cx_pipe_line_c.zh: 从低点排放口抽空，测温不烫，再拔或切。
codex:cx_pipe_line_c.en: Draw it off at the low-point drain, check it's not hot, then uncouple or cut.

codex:cx_pipe_line_x.zh: 管路系统里，阀门关了不等于管子空了：两阀之间总留着一段液体（死腿）。失重下漏出来的液体不会流到地上，而是变成漂浮的液团，碰到带电件就短路。60 °C 以上的管路会伤到抓取它的无人机。
codex:cx_pipe_line_x.en: In a piping system a shut valve doesn't make the pipe empty: there's always a length trapped between two valves (a dead leg). In free fall what leaks doesn't run to the floor; it floats off in globules that short whatever live thing they touch. Lines over 60 °C hurt the drone that grabs them.

codex:cx_cut_line_a.zh: 超重设备上预先标出的切分位置。
codex:cx_cut_line_a.en: Where a piece too heavy to move is meant to be cut apart.

codex:cx_cut_line_b.zh: 随便切会切进内部零件，价值大减；整件又超出抓钩上限。
codex:cx_cut_line_b.en: Cut anywhere else and you cut into its insides; whole, it's beyond the grapple.

codex:cx_cut_line_c.zh: 沿标线切成几段，每段都在抓钩上限以内。
codex:cx_cut_line_c.en: Cut along the marked lines; each section is within the grapple's limit.

codex:cx_cut_line_x.zh: 抓钩额定 3 t（升级后 5 t）。超过它的设备在设计时就留了可分段的位置：法兰、模块接缝、无管线穿过的地方。沿标线切开，每段仍按设备回收；乱切的切口会穿过绕组、管束或电路板，剩下的只值废金属。
codex:cx_cut_line_x.en: The grapple is rated 3 t (5 t upgraded). Equipment heavier than that was built with places it can come apart: flanges, module seams, spans no pipe or cable crosses. Cut on the lines and each section still counts as equipment; a cut anywhere else goes through windings, tube bundles or boards, and what's left is scrap.

codex:cx_glass_a.zh: 压条螺栓固定的舷窗或精密玻璃罩板。
codex:cx_glass_a.en: A window or precision glass panel held in by clamping strips.

codex:cx_glass_b.zh: 背后有压力时拆会被推出去碎掉；附近动激光会烤裂。
codex:cx_glass_b.en: Unbolted with pressure behind it, it's blown out and shatters; a laser nearby cracks it.

codex:cx_glass_c.zh: 先泄压，远离它切割，拧下压条整块取出。
codex:cx_glass_c.en: Vent first, cut well away from it, unbolt the strips and lift it out whole.

codex:cx_glass_x.zh: 玻璃抗压不抗拉，表面的划痕和局部热应力都会成为裂纹源。激光在 0.7 m 内工作，辐射和溅射的热能让玻璃两面温差超过 100 °C，热应力足以让它开裂。完整的光学玻璃价值远高于碎玻璃（几乎为零）。
codex:cx_glass_x.en: Glass takes compression, not tension; a scratch or a hot spot is where a crack starts. With the laser working within 0.7 m, the heat thrown off can put a hundred degrees between its faces, enough thermal stress to craze it. Whole optical glass is worth a great deal; broken, next to nothing.

codex:cx_armor_a.zh: 厚的防护板：分层装甲、隔热瓦、屏蔽层。
codex:cx_armor_a.en: Thick protective plate: layered armour, heat tiles, shielding.

codex:cx_armor_b.zh: 切得极慢，热量会积在切口附近，烤坏贴着它的东西。
codex:cx_armor_b.en: It cuts very slowly, and the heat building up at the kerf cooks what's behind it.

codex:cx_armor_c.zh: 能拆螺栓就拆，切口选在远离设备的地方。
codex:cx_armor_c.en: Unbolt where you can; cut where nothing sits behind it.

codex:cx_armor_x.zh: 装甲靠厚度和硬度吸收能量，切割速度可低到普通钢板的十分之一。屏蔽层（钨、氢化锂）则是挡辐射用的，重而脆。外挂装甲条常用螺栓挂在船体上，拆下来比切穿快得多。
codex:cx_armor_x.en: Armour soaks up energy with thickness and hardness; it may cut ten times slower than plain plate. Shielding (tungsten, lithium hydride) stops radiation, heavy and brittle. Add-on armour strips usually hang on bolts — much faster off than through.

codex:cx_insul_a.zh: 两层蒙皮夹泡沫芯的隔热壁，或多层隔热毯。
codex:cx_insul_a.en: Foam core between two skins, or multilayer insulation blanket.

codex:cx_insul_b.zh: 破了隔热，冷舱回温、低温罐升压就会加快。
codex:cx_insul_b.en: Break it and a cold room warms, a cryogenic tank's pressure climbs, much faster.

codex:cx_insul_c.zh: 冷的东西没处理完之前，别动它的隔热层。
codex:cx_insul_c.en: Leave the insulation alone until what it keeps cold is dealt with.

codex:cx_insul_x.zh: 真空中的多层隔热毯靠几十层镀铝膜反射热辐射，漏热只有每平方米零点几瓦；划开一道口，那一块的漏热可以高十倍以上。低温货物的回温和蒸发速率直接由隔热完好度决定。
codex:cx_insul_x.en: In vacuum, multilayer insulation stops heat with tens of aluminised films, letting through a fraction of a watt per square metre; slit it and that patch leaks ten times more. How fast cold cargo warms or boils off comes straight from how sound its insulation is.

codex:cx_cover_a.zh: 挡住后面设备或固定件的盖板。
codex:cx_cover_a.en: A panel over the equipment or fixings behind it.

codex:cx_cover_b.zh: 盖板后面的螺栓看不见、拧不到，常被漏掉。
codex:cx_cover_b.en: The bolts behind it can't be seen or reached, and get missed.

codex:cx_cover_c.zh: 先拆盖板，再找它后面的固定点。
codex:cx_cover_c.en: Take the cover off first, then look for what's behind it.

codex:cx_cover_x.zh: 工程图会画出盖板后面的东西，但图纸是设计时画的，不一定和现在的船对得上。被盖住的固定点在光标上不会显示，只有盖板拆走之后才可操作。
codex:cx_cover_x.en: The drawing shows what's behind a cover, but it was drawn at design time and may not match the ship now. Hidden fixings don't show under the cursor; they can only be worked once the cover is off.

codex:cx_port.zh: 接口（测压口 / 回收口）

codex:cx_port_a.zh: 接测量工具或回收软管的接口，接在某个舱、罐或管路上。
codex:cx_port_a.en: A connection for the meter or the recovery hose, on a room, a tank or a line.

codex:cx_port_b.zh: 它测的是它连着的那一段：中间的阀关着，读数是零也不代表舱里没气。
codex:cx_port_b.en: It reads what it's connected to: with a valve shut in between, zero doesn't mean the room is empty.

codex:cx_port_c.zh: 打开工程图，确认接口和目标之间的阀门是开的。
codex:cx_port_c.en: Open the drawing and check every valve between the port and what you want is open.

codex:cx_port_x.zh: 测压口后面常有一段短管和阀门，阀门关着时，你测到的是这段短管（死腿）里的压力。回收口用软管把气体或液体抽进船坞的回收泵：气体按价值计入合同，抽的速度由接口的口径和泵的能力决定。
codex:cx_port_x.en: Behind a pressure port there's often a short pipe and a valve; with the valve shut, what you read is that stub (the dead leg). A recovery port takes the hose to the berth's recovery pump: the gas or liquid is paid into the contract, as fast as the port's bore and the pump allow.

codex:cx_valve_a.zh: 开关一段管路或两个容积之间通路的手动阀。
codex:cx_valve_a.en: A hand valve that opens or shuts the way between two volumes.

codex:cx_valve_b.zh: 关着的阀会骗过测量；卡死的阀接不上软管。
codex:cx_valve_b.en: A shut valve fools your meter; a jammed one won't take the hose.

codex:cx_valve_c.zh: 维护工具开关它；卡死的先用扳手拧开。
codex:cx_valve_c.en: Turn it with the wrench; free a jammed one with the wrench first.

codex:cx_valve_x.zh: 阀门把系统分成段：每一段的压力、液位可以完全不同。查管路时顺着工程图从接口走到目标，每遇到一个阀门问一句：它现在是开还是关？
codex:cx_valve_x.en: Valves split a system into sections, each with its own pressure and level. Trace the drawing from the port to what you want and at every valve ask: is it open or shut right now?

codex:cx_switch_a.zh: 电路的隔离开关、待发开关、刹车或锁的控制。
codex:cx_switch_a.en: A circuit isolator, an arming switch, a brake or a lock control.

codex:cx_switch_b.zh: 断一个开关只断一路：别的电源、蓄能还在。
codex:cx_switch_b.en: One switch kills one path: the other sources and stored energy are still there.

codex:cx_switch_c.zh: 断开后再验电或读表，确认真的归零。
codex:cx_switch_c.en: Switch it, then test or read the gauge to see it really went to zero.

codex:cx_switch_x.zh: “关机不等于断电”：主开关只断主电源，备用电池、独立电源、电容组各自还可能带电。专项机制里的开关常有顺序（先冷却后刹车，先泄压后拔销），顺序错了比不动更糟。
codex:cx_switch_x.en: \"Off isn't dead\": the main switch isolates the main supply; backup batteries, independent supplies and capacitor banks may each still be live. The switches of a ship's special mechanisms often have an order (cooling before the brake, pressure off before the pins), and the wrong order is worse than none.

codex:cx_test_a.zh: 电网上可以用测量工具读电压的点。
codex:cx_test_a.en: A point on the grid where the meter reads the voltage.

codex:cx_test_b.zh: 它读的是它所在那段总线；别的支路可能另有电源。
codex:cx_test_b.en: It reads its own stretch of bus; another branch may have its own supply.

codex:cx_test_c.zh: 断电、放电之后，再测一次确认 0 V。
codex:cx_test_c.en: After isolating and discharging, test again for 0 V.

codex:cx_test_x.zh: 读数会过期：你测完之后开关一动，旧读数就不再是现在的状态。安全的流程是“断开—放电—验电”三步，最后一步必须在前两步之后。
codex:cx_test_x.en: A reading goes stale: switch anything after you measured and the old number is no longer the truth. The safe sequence is isolate, discharge, verify — and the verify has to come after the other two.

codex:cx_probe_a.zh: 读温度、液位、剂量、张力、转速等的传感器。
codex:cx_probe_a.en: A sensor reading temperature, level, dose, tension, speed and the like.

codex:cx_probe_b.zh: 不读就不知道：危险往往藏在数字里。
codex:cx_probe_b.en: Unread, you don't know: the danger is usually in the number.

codex:cx_probe_c.zh: 动手前用测量工具读一遍，动手后再读一遍。
codex:cx_probe_c.en: Read it with the meter before you work, and again after.

codex:cx_probe_x.zh: 专项机制几乎都有一个探头：线圈储能、飞轮转速、钻杆扭矩、罐压、氧浓度、剂量率、炉芯温度。读数告诉你还要等多久，或者哪一步还没做完。
codex:cx_probe_x.en: Nearly every special mechanism has its probe: a coil's stored energy, a flywheel's speed, a drill string's torque, a tank's pressure, oxygen, dose rate, a core's temperature. The reading says how long to wait, or which step isn't done.

codex:cx_socket_a.zh: 船坞的临时供电、供冷或地线接口。
codex:cx_socket_a.en: Where the berth plugs in temporary power, cooling or an earth.

codex:cx_socket_b.zh: 断了船电，有些系统还需要外来的电或冷才能安全收尾。
codex:cx_socket_b.en: With the ship's own power off, some systems still need outside power or cooling to finish safely.

codex:cx_socket_c.zh: 断船电之前先把船坞的那一路接上。
codex:cx_socket_c.en: Plug the berth's supply in before you kill the ship's.

codex:cx_socket_x.zh: 船坞供电让门、泵、制冷机在船电断开后还能工作；船坞供冷让冷链货舱不回温；地线把帆面这类大面积带电体的静电导走。插座在外部面板上，接上后才算有效。
codex:cx_socket_x.en: Berth power keeps doors, pumps and chillers working after the ship's own is off; berth cooling keeps a cold hold from warming; an earth drains the static off a big charged surface like a sail. The sockets are on the outside panel and count once plugged.

codex:cx_discharge_a.zh: 让电容组经电阻受控放电的开关。
codex:cx_discharge_a.en: A switch that bleeds a capacitor bank through a resistor.

codex:cx_discharge_b.zh: 电容断电后仍能存着上千焦的能量，碰一下就是电弧。
codex:cx_discharge_b.en: Isolated, a capacitor still holds kilojoules; touch it and it arcs.

codex:cx_discharge_c.zh: 打开放电，等到电量归零，再验电。
codex:cx_discharge_c.en: Open the discharge, wait for it to reach zero, then test.

codex:cx_discharge_x.zh: 电容储能 E = ½CV²：一组 0.1 F 的电容在 400 V 下存 8 kJ。经电阻放电时电压按 e^(−t/RC) 衰减，大约五个时间常数后降到 1% 以下。放电点通常在设备附近的接线盒上。
codex:cx_discharge_x.en: A capacitor stores E = ½CV²: a 0.1 F bank at 400 V holds 8 kJ. Through the resistor its voltage falls as e^(−t/RC), under 1 % after about five time constants. The discharge point is usually on a junction box near the equipment.

codex:cx_seal_a.zh: 把生物危险品封进密封袋或密封盖的控件。
codex:cx_seal_a.en: The control that closes a biohazard item into its seal.

codex:cx_seal_b.zh: 没封就搬或切，污染会散进整个舱室的空气。
codex:cx_seal_b.en: Moved or cut unsealed, it spills contamination into the room's air.

codex:cx_seal_c.zh: 先封好，再整件送危险品口。
codex:cx_seal_c.en: Seal it first, then take it whole to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_seal_x.zh: 生物污染随空气流动：舱门打开、舱壁切开，污染就扩散到隔壁舱。被污染舱室里的完好设备要走洗消，价值降四分之一。
codex:cx_seal_x.en: Contamination travels with the air: open a door or cut a bulkhead and it spreads to the next room. Whole equipment in a contaminated room has to be decontaminated and loses a quarter of its value.

codex:cx_s_gas_a.zh: 每个密封舱里还留着的空气或工艺气体。
codex:cx_s_gas_a.en: The air or process gas still held in each sealed room.

codex:cx_s_gas_b.zh: 带压开口会爆开：门、板和舱里的东西一起喷出去。
codex:cx_s_gas_b.en: Open it under pressure and it blows: door, plate and contents thrown out.

codex:cx_s_gas_c.zh: 从接口测压，接软管放气到 5 kPa 以下，再开口。
codex:cx_s_gas_c.en: Measure at a port, hose it down below 5 kPa, then open it.

codex:cx_s_gas_x.zh: 舱压由舱里气体的量和舱的容积决定（pV = nRT）。回收泵从接口把气抽走，压力按指数下降：舱越大、接口越小，越慢；大舱可能要几十秒。舱壁一旦有了开口，气体就从开口流向压力低的一侧，相连的几个舱会变成一个。抽走的气体按价值计入合同。
codex:cx_s_gas_x.en: A room's pressure comes from how much gas is in it and its volume (pV = nRT). The recovery pump draws it off through a port and the pressure falls away exponentially: the bigger the room and the smaller the port, the slower; a big hold can take tens of seconds. Once a wall has an opening, gas flows to the low side and connected rooms become one. Recovered gas is paid into the contract.

codex:cx_s_stale_a.zh: 测到的数字只代表测的那一刻。
codex:cx_s_stale_a.en: A reading is true only for the moment you took it.

codex:cx_s_stale_b.zh: 之后开了阀、断了电，旧读数就不是现在的状态。
codex:cx_s_stale_b.en: Open a valve or cut a supply afterwards and the old number is no longer the state.

codex:cx_s_stale_c.zh: 改动之后重新测一次；过期的读数会变灰。
codex:cx_s_stale_c.en: After any change, measure again; stale readings grey out.

codex:cx_s_stale_x.zh: 压力变化超过 2 kPa（或 4%），或者电路的连接关系改变，读数就标为过期。船上的面板和总览屏显示的是“上一次记录”，同样可能早已过期——永远以自己刚测的为准。
codex:cx_s_stale_x.en: A pressure reading goes stale when the pressure moves more than 2 kPa (or 4 %); a voltage reading when the circuit's connections change. Panels and overview screens on board show their last record, which may be long out of date — trust only what you just measured.

codex:cx_s_power_a.zh: 发电机、电池、电容、独立电源经总线供给设备。
codex:cx_s_power_a.en: Generators, batteries, capacitors and independent supplies feed the equipment over the bus.

codex:cx_s_power_b.zh: 主电源关了，备用电池、独立电源、电容还能让设备带电。
codex:cx_s_power_b.en: Main power off, a backup battery, an independent supply or a capacitor can still keep it live.

codex:cx_s_power_c.zh: 找出每一路电源：逐个断开、放电，再验电。
codex:cx_s_power_c.en: Find every source: isolate each, discharge, then test.

codex:cx_s_power_x.zh: 工程图的电路层画出每条电缆和它连到哪里。独立电源（无人机电池、门锁备用电源、仪器的不间断电源）只供它那一小片，主开关管不到它；接在总线上的独立电源还会反过来给整条总线供电。超过 30 V 的设备拔线、切割会起弧。
codex:cx_s_power_x.en: The drawing's circuit layer shows every cable and where it goes. An independent supply (a drone's battery, a door lock's backup, an instrument's UPS) feeds its own little patch, beyond the main switch's reach; one tied to the bus feeds the whole bus back. Over 30 V, unplugging or cutting draws an arc.

codex:cx_s_heat_a.zh: 发动机、反应堆、炉子停了以后还热着的管线和设备。
codex:cx_s_heat_a.en: Lines and machines still hot after an engine, reactor or furnace stopped.

codex:cx_s_heat_b.zh: 60 °C 以上抓取会伤无人机；骤冷会让热件开裂。
codex:cx_s_heat_b.en: Over 60 °C they hurt the drone; quenched suddenly, hot parts crack.

codex:cx_s_heat_c.zh: 测温，让冷却系统把它带下来，冷透再拆。
codex:cx_s_heat_c.en: Measure, let the cooling bring it down, take it out cold.

codex:cx_s_heat_x.zh: 真空里没有对流，热只能靠辐射和传导散掉：一件几百度的设备自然冷却可能要几个小时。冷却回路有电、有液时才能带走热量；先断冷却再等，等于把它关在保温瓶里。
codex:cx_s_heat_x.en: In vacuum there's no convection; heat leaves only by radiation and conduction, and a machine at a few hundred degrees may take hours to cool alone. The cooling loop carries heat off only while it has power and coolant; cut it first and wait, and you've shut it in a vacuum flask.

codex:cx_s_cloud_a.zh: 漏出的燃料蒸气在舱里或船外聚成的一团。
codex:cx_s_cloud_a.en: Leaked fuel vapour gathering in a room or outside the hull.

codex:cx_s_cloud_b.zh: 激光扫进去就点燃，起火、爆燃。
codex:cx_s_cloud_b.en: Sweep the laser into it and it lights: fire, a flash.

codex:cx_s_cloud_c.zh: 先回收燃料、等云散开，再在附近切割。
codex:cx_s_cloud_c.en: Recover the fuel and let the cloud disperse before cutting near it.

codex:cx_s_cloud_x.zh: 燃料蒸气只在一定浓度范围内能燃烧（肼约 4.7–100%，氢约 4–75%），太稀太浓都点不着；但云团边缘总有一圈正好在范围内。真空里云团会慢慢扩散变稀，舱里有空气时散得慢得多。
codex:cx_s_cloud_x.en: Fuel vapour burns only within a band of concentration (hydrazine about 4.7–100 %, hydrogen 4–75 %), too lean or too rich won't light — but the edge of a cloud is always somewhere in the band. In vacuum the cloud spreads and thins; in a room with air it lingers much longer.

codex:cx_s_fire_a.zh: 燃料只在有空气的舱里、或碰到氧化剂时才烧；真空里它只会蒸发、结冰、漂走。
codex:cx_s_fire_a.en: Fuel burns only in a room with air, or where it meets an oxidiser; in vacuum it just boils off, freezes and drifts.

codex:cx_s_fire_b.zh: 激光、电弧、带电电缆的火花、短路、刚切的红热切口、尾焰、爆炸都能点着；火逐团蔓延，舱压可升到 8 倍冲开舱门。
codex:cx_s_fire_b.en: Laser, arc, live-cable spark, short, fresh hot cut, thruster, blast: any lights it. It spreads; room pressure can rise 8x and blow the doors.

codex:cx_s_fire_c.zh: 先把舱抽成真空再动激光；着火的舱别开门补氧，等它把氧耗光。
codex:cx_s_fire_c.en: Vent the room to vacuum before the laser; don't open a burning room's door to feed it air, let it use its oxygen up.

codex:cx_s_fire_x.zh: 火需要燃料、氧气和点火源三样。失重下火焰没有浮力，成一个缓慢的球，靠扩散补氧。火把舱里的氧耗光会自己灭，但燃料还在，补进空气、再来一个火星就会复燃。封闭舱里的燃烧把气体加热到几千度，压力跟着升到原来的数倍。
codex:cx_s_fire_x.en: Fire needs fuel, oxygen and a spark. Without gravity a flame has no buoyancy: it sits in a slow sphere fed by diffusion. A fire that uses up a room's oxygen goes out on its own, but the fuel is still there: let air in, add a spark, and it lights again. In a closed room the burning heats the gas to thousands of degrees and the pressure rises several times over.

codex:cx_s_liquid_a.zh: 漏出的液体在失重下变成漂浮的液团。
codex:cx_s_liquid_a.en: Liquid let loose in free fall becomes drifting globules.

codex:cx_s_liquid_b.zh: 碰到带电设备会短路，燃料遇激光起火，低温液体冻裂设备。
codex:cx_s_liquid_b.en: A globule shorts live equipment, fuel lights under the laser, cryogens crack what they touch.

codex:cx_s_liquid_c.zh: 接软管从接口抽空，再切管或拆罐。
codex:cx_s_liquid_c.en: Draw it off through a port with the hose before cutting the line or moving the tank.

codex:cx_s_liquid_x.zh: 没有重力，液体靠表面张力收成球，保持动量直线漂移，碰到表面要么溅开、要么摊成液膜跟着那件走。液氢、液氦一出来就闪蒸掉一部分，其余边漂边沸；水在真空里几秒内结成冰球；燃料慢慢挥发，蒸气汇进可燃云；钻井泥浆落哪粘哪。
codex:cx_s_liquid_x.en: With no gravity, surface tension pulls liquid into balls that drift in straight lines and either splash or wet the surface they meet, then travel with it. Liquid hydrogen and helium flash part away on release and boil as they drift; water freezes into a ball of ice within seconds in vacuum; fuel evaporates slowly into a flammable cloud; drilling mud sticks wherever it lands.

codex:cx_s_hose_a.zh: 气液回收工具接上接口，把气体或液体抽进船坞的泵。
codex:cx_s_hose_a.en: The recovery tool on a port, drawing gas or liquid into the berth's pump.

codex:cx_s_hose_b.zh: 接错接口会混料；抽干了还开着，有些泵会干转损坏。
codex:cx_s_hose_b.en: The wrong port mixes the media; left running dry, some pumps wreck themselves.

codex:cx_s_hose_c.zh: 接上后看读数下降，到量后摘下软管。
codex:cx_s_hose_c.en: Hose on, watch the reading fall, take it off when it's done.

codex:cx_s_hose_x.zh: 一条软管同时只接一个接口。抽速随压力（或液位）降低而变慢，按住 = 会加速时间。回收的气体和液体按市价计入合同；危险介质要接到对应的回收口，不能放到太空。
