codex:cx_s_hose_x.en: One hose, one port at a time. The draw slows as the pressure or level drops; hold = to speed time up. What's recovered is paid into the contract at market price; hazardous media have to go to their own recovery, never to space.

codex:cx_s_free_a.zh: 最后一个固定点松开，零件就成了自由漂浮的刚体。
codex:cx_s_free_a.en: With its last fixing gone a part becomes a free-floating body.

codex:cx_s_free_b.zh: 它保持原来的速度和转动，撞上别的东西会撞坏。
codex:cx_s_free_b.en: It keeps its speed and spin, and whatever it runs into gets damaged.

codex:cx_s_free_c.zh: 用抓钩接住，慢慢送进回收口。
codex:cx_s_free_c.en: Catch it with the grapple and ease it into a mouth.

codex:cx_s_free_x.zh: 失重下没有摩擦帮你停下：推一下就一直走，停下来要同样大的反推。重的件动量大，0.5 m/s 的 3 t 设备和 1.5 m/s 的 1 t 设备撞起来一样狠。船坞边缘的牵引场会把漂出去的东西慢慢拉回来。
codex:cx_s_free_x.en: Free fall has no friction to stop things: a push goes on forever, and stopping takes the same push the other way. Heavy pieces carry momentum — 3 t at 0.5 m/s hits as hard as 1 t at 1.5 m/s. The tractor field at the berth's edge slowly pulls back what drifts out.

codex:cx_s_grapple_a.zh: 无人机抓住、拖动零件的工具。
codex:cx_s_grapple_a.en: The drone's tool for holding and towing parts.

codex:cx_s_grapple_b.zh: 超过额定质量拖不动；拉还连着的件会扯断锁扣和管线。
codex:cx_s_grapple_b.en: Over its rating it can't move a load; pulling something still fixed tears its locks and lines.

codex:cx_s_grapple_c.zh: 先看质量和剩余固定点，再拖。
codex:cx_s_grapple_c.en: Check the mass and the fixings left before you tow.

codex:cx_s_grapple_x.zh: 抓钩额定 3 t（升级 5 t）。无人机的推力有限，拖着重物时加速慢、刹车也慢，要提前减速。还连着的件被拉时，光标会显示剩几个固定点；拉力越大，越先断的是锁扣和管线。
codex:cx_s_grapple_x.en: Rated 3 t (5 t upgraded). The drone's thrust is limited: towing, it speeds up slowly and stops slowly, so start braking early. Pulling something still fixed, the cursor shows the fixings left; pull harder and the locks and lines go first.

codex:cx_s_furnace_a.zh: 泊位底部的废料口：废金属进去，熔成钢锭按吨付钱。
codex:cx_s_furnace_a.en: The scrap mouth in the berth's floor: scrap goes in, is melted to ingots and paid by the tonne.

codex:cx_s_furnace_b.zh: 危险品、带电或带压的东西进炉会炸。完整设备进炉只值废金属价。
codex:cx_s_furnace_b.en: Hazards, live or pressurised things go off in it. Whole equipment sent in is paid as scrap.

codex:cx_s_furnace_c.zh: 只送纯金属废料；6–8 m 外对准长槽甩进去就行。
codex:cx_s_furnace_c.en: Only plain scrap; from 6–8 m out, line it up with the trough and let it go.

codex:cx_s_furnace_x.zh: 炉口下面：料仓把废料压实，螺旋给料机送进一台真空感应炉。坩埚以 45 rpm 旋转，离心力把熔池压在炉衬上（约 1.4 g）。水冷铜线圈产生交变磁场，在金属里感应涡流加热（集肤深度 δ = 503·√(ρ/μf)）；炉温升到 1640 °C 出钢，倒进水冷铜锭模。真空本身就是熔炼条件。
codex:cx_s_furnace_x.en: Under the mouth a bunker compacts the scrap and a screw feeder charges a vacuum induction furnace. The crucible spins at 45 rpm so the melt is held against the lining at about 1.4 g. A water-cooled copper coil drives eddy currents in the metal (skin depth δ = 503·√(ρ/μf)); at 1,640 °C it taps into water-cooled copper ingot moulds. The vacuum is the berth's own.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_a.zh: 收完整设备的回收口，从下方送入。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_a.en: The mouth for whole equipment, fed from below.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_b.zh: 损坏或切开的设备按成色折价，带电带液的会出事。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_b.en: Damaged or cut equipment is marked down; live or wet equipment causes trouble.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_c.zh: 断电、排空、拔线之后整件送进来。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_c.en: Isolated, drained and unplugged, then in whole.

codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_x.zh: 设备按“价值 × 成色”付钱：撞击、过热、短路、污染都会降成色。合同里的指定件必须完整送达这里。离口太远时，设备口会把接收环移向你。
codex:cx_s_equip_mouth_x.en: Equipment pays its value times its condition: knocks, heat, shorts and contamination all lower the condition. A contract's named items must arrive here whole. Far from the bay, it moves its receiving ring towards you.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_a.zh: 收燃料罐、电池、火工品、放射源等危险品的回收口。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_a.en: The mouth for fuel tanks, batteries, pyrotechnics, radioactive parts.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_b.zh: 危险品送进熔炉会爆炸或污染。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_b.en: A hazard sent to the furnace explodes or contaminates.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_c.zh: 光标显示“危险品”的件，只送这里。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_c.en: Anything the cursor calls a hazard goes here and nowhere else.

codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_x.zh: 危险品口按危险处理津贴付钱，不按金属价。它的口子小，要慢慢对准；拖着危险品靠近熔炉时，指导会提醒你。
codex:cx_s_hazard_mouth_x.en: The hazard mouth pays a handling allowance, not the metal price. Its opening is small, so line up slowly; towing a hazard near the furnace draws a warning.

codex:cx_s_field_a.zh: 泊位开放边缘的力场，把漂出去的东西拉回来。
codex:cx_s_field_a.en: The field along the berth's open edges, pulling back what drifts out.

codex:cx_s_field_b.zh: 它只拉回，不刹车：高速漂出的件仍会撞上东西。
codex:cx_s_field_b.en: It pulls back, it doesn't brake: something fast still hits what's in its way.

codex:cx_s_field_c.zh: 别指望它救场，脱离前先抓住。
codex:cx_s_field_c.en: Don't count on it; catch things before they go.

codex:cx_s_field_x.zh: 泊位是半开放的：底部平台、塔架和悬臂，上方和右侧开放。牵引场在内框以外起作用，越往外拉力越大。船坞扩建时，场的边界会先外推到新的端部之外。
codex:cx_s_field_x.en: The berth is half open: floor, tower and boom, open above and to the right. The field acts outside the inner frame and pulls harder the further out you go. When the berth is extended, the field's edge is pushed out past the new end first.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_a.zh: 买下的扩建在现场按真实的在轨桁架施工流程建起来。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_a.en: A bought extension is built on site the way a real in-space truss job runs.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_b.zh: 施工时工区封闭，任何东西进去都会被牵引场推开。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_b.en: During the works the zone is closed; the field pushes anything out of it.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_c.zh: 看着它建，或任意键跳过。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_c.en: Watch it go up, or skip with any key.

codex:cx_s_berth_ext_x.zh: 流程：工区隔离 → 拖船推入折叠桁架盒 → 铰接桁架从储筒逐节展开（每节 0.6 m，横撑锁正后再展下一节）→ 每个模块接口先钩爪锁紧、再上 M20 10.9 级螺栓（预紧 125 kN）→ 电子束焊接缝（电子束焊需要真空，泊位本身就是）→ 管路用氦气加压到 1.5 倍工作压力检漏，同时新地板承受 1.25 倍设计载荷（挠度限值 L/800）→ 调试认证。高船进坞时，塔架顶升加节、平台同步下放。
codex:cx_s_berth_ext_x.en: Close the work zone → a tug pushes in the folded truss cassettes → the articulated truss deploys bay by bay out of its canister (0.6 m a bay, each squared and locked before the next) → each module interface latched, then bolted with M20 grade 10.9 bolts at 125 kN preload → the seams electron-beam welded (EB welding needs a vacuum, which the berth is) → the lines proof-pressurised with helium at 1.5 × working pressure and leak-checked while the new floor carries 1.25 × its design load (deflection limit L/800) → commissioned. For a tall ship, the tower is jacked up section by section and the platform lowered in step.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_a.zh: 船的设计图：管路、电路、舱室和固定件。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_a.en: The ship's design drawing: pipes, circuits, rooms and fixings.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_b.zh: 图是设计时画的，船是后来出事的：两者不一定对得上。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_b.en: It was drawn at design time; the ship had its accident later. They may not agree.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_c.zh: 用它找东西、查走向；东西现在的状态自己测。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_c.en: Use it to find things and trace lines; check their state yourself.

codex:cx_s_blueprint_x.zh: Tab 打开。图上能看到盖板后面的设备、阀门在哪条管线上、每台设备的电从哪里来。改装、事故、维修留下的变化不在图上：多出来的电源、被堵的接口、补过的管子，只有现场测得出来。
codex:cx_s_blueprint_x.en: Tab opens it. It shows the equipment behind covers, which line a valve sits on, where each machine's power comes from. What modifications, accidents and repairs changed isn't on it: an extra supply, a blocked port, a patched pipe — only measuring on site finds those.

codex:cx_s_scope_a.zh: 只拆指定区段，或只取指定设备的合同。
codex:cx_s_scope_a.en: A contract for one section only, or only for named equipment.

codex:cx_s_scope_b.zh: 动了范围外的件，损坏或拆走都要按违约扣钱。
codex:cx_s_scope_b.en: Damage or take anything outside the scope and you pay for it.

codex:cx_s_scope_c.zh: 看清界面上画出的区段边界，范围外的不碰。
codex:cx_s_scope_c.en: Read the section boundary drawn on screen; leave what's outside alone.

codex:cx_s_scope_x.zh: 分段拆解只买区段内的零件，不买气体和液体；抢救单按件付固定报酬，送齐即结束，船体其余部分由拖船拖走。光标会对范围外的件标“范围外”。
codex:cx_s_scope_x.en: A section job buys the pieces inside it, not the gas or fluids; a salvage job pays a fixed sum per named item and ends when they're in, the rest of the hull towed away. The cursor marks out-of-scope pieces.

codex:cx_s_hauler_a.zh: 船坞悬臂上的辅助机，把标记的零件运进回收口。
codex:cx_s_hauler_a.en: The helper on the boom that carries marked pieces to the mouths.

codex:cx_s_hauler_b.zh: 它只运你标记的件，不检查危险：带电带液的照样搬。
codex:cx_s_hauler_b.en: It carries what you mark without checking: live or wet, it moves it.

codex:cx_s_hauler_c.zh: 处理完危险再右键标记，让它去运。
codex:cx_s_hauler_c.en: Make a piece safe, then mark it (right click) and let it carry it.

codex:cx_s_hauler_x.zh: 搬运无人机按标记顺序排队，自己找路、选回收口。它省掉的是重复的拖运，不省判断：哪件已经安全、哪件该进哪个口，仍然由你决定。
codex:cx_s_hauler_x.en: The hauler queues marked pieces in order, finds its own way and picks the mouth. It saves the repetitive towing, not the judgement: which piece is safe and where it goes is still yours.

codex:cx_s_impact_a.zh: 漂浮的零件、无人机或整段船体撞上别的东西。
codex:cx_s_impact_a.en: A floating piece, the drone or a section of hull running into something.

codex:cx_s_impact_b.zh: 撞击按速度变化折损两边的成色，精密件最怕。
codex:cx_s_impact_b.en: An impact marks down both sides by the change in speed; precision parts suffer worst.

codex:cx_s_impact_c.zh: 拖运时慢一点、提前刹车，别让东西自己漂。
codex:cx_s_impact_c.en: Tow slowly, brake early, don't let things drift on their own.

codex:cx_s_impact_x.zh: 撞击的伤害取决于速度变化（Δv）和件的易损度。1 m/s 的撞击对钢结构无所谓，对光学玻璃或芯片就是致命的。拖着重物刹不住时，松开抓钩反而更糟：它会带着全部动量继续走。
codex:cx_s_impact_x.en: Damage comes from the change in speed (Δv) and how fragile the piece is. 1 m/s means nothing to steel and everything to optical glass or a chip. Towing something you can't stop, letting go is worse: it carries all its momentum on.

codex:cx_swb_a.zh: 母排、仪表和一排塑壳断路器：全船电力在这里分路。
codex:cx_swb_a.en: Busbars, meters and a stack of moulded-case breakers: where the ship's power is split up.

codex:cx_swb_b.zh: 它是电网的汇点，任何一路电源都可能让它带电。
codex:cx_swb_b.en: Every source on the ship can make it live; it's where they all meet.

codex:cx_swb_c.zh: 先断所有电源，在它的验电点测到 0 V 再拆。
codex:cx_swb_c.en: Isolate every source, test 0 V at its test point, then remove it.

codex:cx_swb_x.zh: 上部是三相母排室，下面每个分段一块仪表板和一列断路器，电缆从底部的格兰板进线。断路器断开的是负载侧：母排上游只要有一路电源没断，整块盘依然带电。母排之间的电弧温度可达上万度。
codex:cx_swb_x.en: Along the top the three-phase busbar chamber; below it each section's meter panel and a column of breakers, the cables rising through the gland plate. A breaker opens the load side only: while any source upstream is live, the whole board is. An arc between busbars runs at over ten thousand degrees.

codex:cx_battery_a.zh: 串联的电芯模块、汇流排、冷板和电池管理板。
codex:cx_battery_a.en: Modules of cells in series, busbars, a cooling plate and the battery management board.

codex:cx_battery_b.zh: 断不掉的电源：开关只断外部，电芯里的能量一直在。
codex:cx_battery_b.en: A source you can't switch off inside: the switch isolates its output, not the cells.

codex:cx_battery_c.zh: 断开它的隔离开关，拔掉输出线，整件送危险品口。
codex:cx_battery_c.en: Open its isolator, unplug its output, take it whole to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_battery_x.zh: 一组 50 kWh 的锂电池在满电时储存 180 MJ。电芯短路或穿刺会热失控：电芯温度在几秒内升到 600 °C 以上，释放可燃气体并引燃相邻电芯。主接触器在模块一端，断开后电池端子之间仍有全电压。
codex:cx_battery_x.en: A 50 kWh lithium pack holds 180 MJ when full. A shorted or punctured cell runs away thermally: past 600 °C in seconds, venting flammable gas and lighting its neighbours. The main contactor sits at one end; open, the pack's own terminals still carry full voltage.

codex:cx_cap_a.zh: 一排电容罐、汇流排和放电电阻，储能供脉冲用电。
codex:cx_cap_a.en: A row of capacitor cans, busbars and a discharge resistor, storing energy for pulse loads.

codex:cx_cap_b.zh: 断电后仍保持高压，碰一下就是电弧。
codex:cx_cap_b.en: Isolated it still holds its voltage; touch it and it arcs.

codex:cx_cap_c.zh: 找到它的放电点，放到 0 再验电。
codex:cx_cap_c.en: Find its discharge point, bleed it to zero, then test.

codex:cx_cap_x.zh: E = ½CV²：0.1 F 在 400 V 下存 8 kJ，发射系统的电容组可达兆焦级。电容没有“关”：只能放电。放电电阻按 RC 时间常数把能量变成热，约五个时间常数降到 1%。
codex:cx_cap_x.en: E = ½CV²: 0.1 F at 400 V holds 8 kJ, and a launcher's bank holds megajoules. A capacitor has no off, only discharged. The resistor turns its energy to heat on the RC time constant, under 1 % after five of them.

codex:cx_gen_a.zh: 发动机拖动的发电机，带散热器、励磁机和控制屏。
codex:cx_gen_a.en: An engine driving an alternator, with radiator, exciter and control panel.

codex:cx_gen_b.zh: 停机不等于断电：别的电源会经总线倒送到它的出线端。
codex:cx_gen_b.en: Stopped isn't dead: other sources feed back to its terminals through the bus.

codex:cx_gen_c.zh: 确认停机，断开它的出线，验电后拆。
codex:cx_gen_c.en: Confirm it's stopped, isolate its output, test, then remove.

codex:cx_gen_x.zh: 发电机的转子是凸极磁极，定子槽里嵌着绕组；转起来时，即使励磁断开，剩磁也能发出几十伏。机组质量常在 1–3 t，底座有减振器，螺栓都在底座上。
codex:cx_gen_x.en: The rotor carries salient poles, the windings sit in the stator slots; spinning, even unexcited, the residual magnetism gives tens of volts. A set weighs 1–3 t; its bolts are on the base frame, under the anti-vibration mounts.

codex:cx_panel_a.zh: 墙挂的电气控制箱：门、指示灯窗、端子和格兰。
codex:cx_panel_a.en: A wall-hung electrical enclosure: door, indicator window, terminals and glands.

codex:cx_panel_b.zh: 箱子小，接进来的电源可能不止一路。
codex:cx_panel_b.en: Small box, possibly more than one supply into it.

codex:cx_panel_c.zh: 按工程图找全它的进线，逐一断开再拆。
codex:cx_panel_c.en: Find every incoming line on the drawing, isolate each, then remove it.

codex:cx_panel_x.zh: 控制箱里多是继电器、PLC 和端子排，自身价值不高但接线密集；拆它之前把每根进线都处理掉，比拆完再一根根找省事。
codex:cx_panel_x.en: Inside are relays, a PLC and terminal rails: not worth much, but densely wired. Deal with every incoming line before removing it rather than chasing them afterwards.

codex:cx_junction_a.zh: 四角螺钉的盒盖、接地螺柱、进出线格兰。
codex:cx_junction_a.en: A lid on four corner screws, an earth stud, cable glands in and out.

codex:cx_junction_b.zh: 多条电缆在这里分支，常有验电点或放电点。
codex:cx_junction_b.en: Cables branch here; test points and discharge points often sit on it.

codex:cx_junction_c.zh: 在这里验电和放电，再处理它连着的设备。
codex:cx_junction_c.en: Test and discharge here, then deal with what it feeds.

codex:cx_junction_x.zh: 接线盒是电路的“路口”：查一台设备的电从哪来，从它的接线盒倒着找最快。
codex:cx_junction_x.en: A junction box is a crossroads of the circuit: to find where a device's power comes from, work back from its junction box.

codex:cx_transformer_a.zh: 三柱铁芯、高低压绕组和夹紧框架的干式变压器。
codex:cx_transformer_a.en: A dry-type transformer: three-limb core, low- and high-voltage windings, clamping frame.

codex:cx_transformer_b.zh: 一侧有电，另一侧就有电：从低压侧倒送也会升出高压。
codex:cx_transformer_b.en: Live on one side means live on the other: back-fed from the low side it puts out high voltage.

codex:cx_transformer_c.zh: 高低压两侧都断开、验电，再拆。
codex:cx_transformer_c.en: Isolate and test both sides before removing it.

codex:cx_transformer_x.zh: 绕组匝比决定电压比，10:1 的变压器从低压侧倒送 400 V，高压侧就是 4 kV。干式变压器很重，铁芯占了大半质量，常要沿夹件分开运。
codex:cx_transformer_x.en: The turns ratio sets the voltage ratio: back-feed 400 V into a 10:1 transformer's low side and its high side sits at 4 kV. It's heavy, most of it core, and often has to come apart at its clamps to move.

codex:cx_inverter_a.zh: IGBT 模块、散热器、直流母线电容和输出电抗器。
codex:cx_inverter_a.en: IGBT modules on a heat sink, DC-link capacitors and an output choke.

codex:cx_inverter_b.zh: 断电后直流母线电容还存着电，几分钟才自放完。
codex:cx_inverter_b.en: Off, its DC-link capacitors still hold charge for minutes.

codex:cx_inverter_c.zh: 断开直流输入，等放电或接放电点，验电后拆。
codex:cx_inverter_c.en: Isolate its DC input, wait or bleed it down, test, then remove.

codex:cx_inverter_x.zh: 逆变器把直流斩成交流驱动电机。直流母线电容是它的“蓄水池”，额定电压常在 600–800 V，自带的泄放电阻要几分钟才能把它放到安全电压。
codex:cx_inverter_x.en: An inverter chops DC into AC for a motor. Its DC-link capacitors are its reservoir, rated 600–800 V, and its own bleed resistors take minutes to bring them down to a safe level.

codex:cx_fuelcell_a.zh: 上百片双极板夹在端板之间，拉杆紧固，配鼓风机和加湿器。
codex:cx_fuelcell_a.en: Hundreds of bipolar plates between end plates and tie rods, with blower and humidifier.

codex:cx_fuelcell_b.zh: 只要还有氢和氧，它就在发电：关了总线它照样带电。
codex:cx_fuelcell_b.en: With hydrogen and oxygen left, it generates: kill the bus and it's still live.

codex:cx_fuelcell_c.zh: 断它自己的开关，关燃料阀、抽空氢气，再拆。
codex:cx_fuelcell_c.en: Switch it off at its own switch, shut and draw off the hydrogen, then remove it.

codex:cx_fuelcell_x.zh: 每片电池约 0.7 V，几百片串联到几百伏。电堆内的氢气即使阀门关了也会残留，泄漏到舱里就形成可燃云（氢的燃烧范围 4–75%，点火能极低）。
codex:cx_fuelcell_x.en: Each cell gives about 0.7 V; hundreds in series make hundreds of volts. Hydrogen stays in the stack after the valves shut, and leaked into a room it makes a flammable cloud (4–75 % in air, the smallest of sparks lights it).

codex:cx_charger_a.zh: 给无人机或车辆充电的模块，带枪头和线缆。
codex:cx_charger_a.en: A charging unit for drones or vehicles, with its connector and cable.

codex:cx_charger_b.zh: 接着充电线时，两头都可能带电。
codex:cx_charger_b.en: With the cable plugged in, both ends may be live.

codex:cx_charger_c.zh: 断开充电开关，拔掉充电线，再动它充的东西。
codex:cx_charger_c.en: Switch the charger off and unplug the lead before touching what it charges.

codex:cx_charger_x.zh: 充电桩自己从总线取电，又把电送进被充的设备；被充的设备若自带电池，拔线时电池一侧也带电。
codex:cx_charger_x.en: A charger takes power from the bus and puts it into what it charges; if that has its own battery, the battery end of the lead is live too.

codex:cx_dump_res_a.zh: 一排排来回折叠的不锈钢带，接在超导磁体的泄能回路上。
codex:cx_dump_res_a.en: Banks of stainless ribbon folded back and forth, on a superconducting magnet's dump circuit.

codex:cx_dump_res_b.zh: 泄能时它把磁能变成热，满负荷时发红；拆了它磁体就无处泄能。
codex:cx_dump_res_b.en: Dumping, it turns stored field energy into heat and glows; take it away and the magnet has nowhere to dump.

codex:cx_dump_res_c.zh: 磁体泄完能之前，别动它和它的母排。
codex:cx_dump_res_c.en: Leave it and its busbars alone until the magnets are run down.

codex:cx_dump_res_x.zh: 线圈电流经泄能电阻衰减：I = I₀·e^(−t/τ)，τ = L/R。电阻越大泄得越快，但线圈两端电压 = I·R 也越高。几十吉焦的储能在几十秒内变成热，电阻带温度可升到几百度。
codex:cx_dump_res_x.en: The coil's current falls through the resistor as I = I₀·e^(−t/τ), τ = L/R. More resistance dumps faster but puts more voltage (I·R) across the coil. Tens of gigajoules become heat in tens of seconds; the ribbon reaches hundreds of degrees.

codex:cx_slip_ring_a.zh: 旋转侧的一叠铜环和固定侧的电刷，给转动的环供电。
codex:cx_slip_ring_a.en: A stack of rings on the turning side and brushes on the fixed side: power into something spinning.

codex:cx_slip_ring_b.zh: 环带电时刹车，电机回馈电流穿过滑环会烧毁它。
codex:cx_slip_ring_b.en: Brake a ring while its bus is live and the motor's regenerated current burns the slip ring.

codex:cx_slip_ring_c.zh: 先断环上的负载，再刹车消旋。
codex:cx_slip_ring_c.en: Take the ring's loads off before braking it.

codex:cx_slip_ring_x.zh: 电刷在铜环上滑动导电，电流密度有限；回馈电流和起弧会在环面烧出凹坑。它是旋转居住环唯一的电力通路。
codex:cx_slip_ring_x.en: The brushes slide on the rings to carry current, which has a limit; regenerated current and arcing pit the ring faces. It's the habitat ring's only way in for power.

codex:cx_tray_a.zh: 顶板下的梯式桥架，里面成捆的电缆，配灯和喷头。
codex:cx_tray_a.en: A ladder tray under the deckhead, cables bundled in it, lights and sprinklers along it.

codex:cx_tray_b.zh: 桥架里的电缆一根带电，整捆都不能切。
codex:cx_tray_b.en: One live cable in the bundle and none of it can be cut.

codex:cx_tray_c.zh: 断开它承载的电路，再拆桥架。
codex:cx_tray_c.en: Isolate the circuits it carries, then take the tray.

codex:cx_tray_x.zh: 桥架本身只是金属结构，危险来自它承载的线：动力、信号、控制混在一起，拆之前按电路层把每路都确认掉。
codex:cx_tray_x.en: The tray is just metalwork; the danger is what it carries — power, signal and control mixed together. Check every circuit in it on the drawing before it comes out.

codex:cx_module_a.zh: 为整件更换设计的密封箱：两个抓手、自锁螺钉、盲插接头。
codex:cx_module_a.en: A sealed box made to be swapped whole: two grab handles, captive fasteners, blind-mate connectors.

codex:cx_module_b.zh: 接头面插着时硬拽，会撕坏背板的接头。
codex:cx_module_b.en: Pulled while still mated, it rips the connectors off the backplane.

codex:cx_module_c.zh: 松开自锁螺钉，断电后整件拔出。
codex:cx_module_c.en: Undo the captive fasteners and pull it whole once power is off.

codex:cx_module_x.zh: ORU 是航天器“整件更换”的思路：机械臂或宇航员戴手套就能操作，所以它是最好拆的设备之一，完整价值也最高。
codex:cx_module_x.en: The ORU is how spacecraft are maintained by swapping whole units — a robot arm or a gloved hand can do it — which makes it one of the easiest things to recover whole.

codex:cx_pump_a.zh: 蜗壳、轴承架、联轴器和电机装在同一底座上。
codex:cx_pump_a.en: Volute, bearing frame, coupling and motor on one baseplate.

codex:cx_pump_b.zh: 进出口管还满着、电机还带电：切管漏液，拔线起弧。
codex:cx_pump_b.en: Its lines still full, its motor still live: cut a line and it leaks, pull the lead and it arcs.

codex:cx_pump_c.zh: 断电、从排放口抽空，拔线拔管后整件拆下。
codex:cx_pump_c.en: Isolate, drain at the low point, uncouple lines and lead, then lift it whole.

codex:cx_pump_x.zh: 离心泵靠叶轮把液体甩向蜗壳外缘，速度变成压力。它最怕干转：没有液体冷却和润滑，机械密封几十秒内就会烧坏。完整的泵价值远高于废金属。
codex:cx_pump_x.en: The impeller flings liquid to the volute's rim, turning speed into pressure. It hates running dry: with no liquid to cool and lubricate it, the mechanical seal burns within tens of seconds. Whole, a pump is worth far more than its metal.

codex:cx_hx_a.zh: 壳体里的管束，两种介质隔着管壁换热。
codex:cx_hx_a.en: A tube bundle in a shell: two fluids trading heat through the tube walls.

codex:cx_hx_b.zh: 壳程和管程是两套液体，常常一套空了另一套还满。
codex:cx_hx_b.en: Shell side and tube side are two fluids; one emptied, the other may still be full.

codex:cx_hx_c.zh: 两侧都排空，再拆它的管口。
codex:cx_hx_c.en: Drain both sides before opening its nozzles.

codex:cx_hx_x.zh: 折流板让壳程液体来回横穿管束，提高换热系数。一台换热器里两侧的压力、温度、介质都不同，它的四个管口要分开处理。
codex:cx_hx_x.en: Baffles send the shell-side fluid back and forth across the bundle to raise the heat transfer. Each side has its own pressure, temperature and medium, and its four nozzles are four separate jobs.

codex:cx_radiator_a.zh: 两端集管之间排满流道管的散热面，靠辐射把热排进太空。
codex:cx_radiator_a.en: Flow tubes between two headers across a fin sheet, radiating heat to space.

codex:cx_radiator_b.zh: 管里还有冷却液；系统还热时收拢或拆下，板会变形。
codex:cx_radiator_b.en: Its tubes still hold coolant; folded or removed while the system is hot, it deforms.

codex:cx_radiator_c.zh: 等冷却回路把热带走、排空后再拆。
codex:cx_radiator_c.en: Let the loop carry the heat away and drain it before you take it.

codex:cx_radiator_x.zh: 太空中散热只能靠辐射：P = εσAT⁴。在 300 K，每平方米约排 400 W，所以散热板要做得很大。板面薄而轻，铰链接在吊杆上，抓住它要轻。
codex:cx_radiator_x.en: In space heat only leaves by radiation: P = εσAT⁴. At 300 K a square metre sheds about 400 W, which is why radiators are big. The panels are thin and light, hinged to their booms; handle them gently.

codex:cx_chiller_a.zh: 压缩机、冷凝器、膨胀阀和蒸发器组成的制冷回路。
codex:cx_chiller_a.en: Compressor, condenser, expansion valve and evaporator in one refrigeration loop.

codex:cx_chiller_b.zh: 一停或一切坏，它保冷的货舱或设备就开始回温。
codex:cx_chiller_b.en: Stopped or cut, whatever it keeps cold starts to warm.

codex:cx_chiller_c.zh: 先接上船坞供冷或处理完冷货，再停它。
codex:cx_chiller_c.en: Plug in berth cooling or deal with the cold cargo before stopping it.

codex:cx_chiller_x.zh: 制冷剂在蒸发器里吸热沸腾，被压缩后在冷凝器里放热凝结。回路里的制冷剂要从储液罐回收口闭环回收，不能放空。
codex:cx_chiller_x.en: The refrigerant boils in the evaporator taking heat in, is compressed, and condenses in the condenser giving it out. It's recovered in a closed loop from the receiver's port, never vented.

codex:cx_freezer_a.zh: −80 °C 的样品或药品冷柜：保温门、控制器、压缩机舱。
codex:cx_freezer_a.en: A −80 °C freezer for samples or medicine: insulated door, controller, compressor bay.

codex:cx_freezer_b.zh: 断电后里面的东西慢慢回温，有的样品一回温就作废。
codex:cx_freezer_b.en: Off, its contents slowly warm, and some samples are lost the moment they do.

codex:cx_freezer_c.zh: 带电整件送设备口，或先确认里面没有需要保冷的东西。
codex:cx_freezer_c.en: Send it whole while powered, or check nothing in it needs the cold.

codex:cx_freezer_x.zh: 保温良好的冷柜断电后每小时回温几度；门一开就快得多。冷链货物的价值往往取决于它从没超过某个温度。
codex:cx_freezer_x.en: A well-insulated freezer warms a few degrees an hour unpowered, much faster with the door open. Cold-chain goods are often worth what they are only if they never went above a set temperature.

codex:cx_env_a.zh: 进风阀、过滤器、冷却盘管、离心风机和送风箱。
codex:cx_env_a.en: Intake damper, filter, cooling coil, centrifugal fan and discharge plenum.

codex:cx_env_b.zh: 盘管里有冷却液，接水盘可能有积水；风机由总线供电。
codex:cx_env_b.en: Its coil holds coolant and its drain pan may hold water; the fan runs off the bus.

codex:cx_env_c.zh: 断电、排空盘管，再拆风管和底座螺栓。
codex:cx_env_c.en: Isolate, drain the coil, then the ducts and the base bolts.

codex:cx_env_x.zh: 空气处理机让舱里的空气循环、降温、除湿。它是舱室里最大的设备之一，沿气流方向一段段排开；舱里的空气压力和它无关，放气要走舱的接口。
codex:cx_env_x.en: It circulates, cools and dries a room's air. It's one of the biggest things in a room, laid out along its airflow; the room's pressure is nothing to do with it — vent through the room's own port.

codex:cx_duct_fan_a.zh: 风道里的电机、叶片和导流叶。
codex:cx_duct_fan_a.en: A motor, blades and straightener vanes inside a duct.

codex:cx_duct_fan_b.zh: 带电拆接线盒会起弧；叶轮可能还在惯性转动。
codex:cx_duct_fan_b.en: Its terminal box arcs if opened live; the impeller may still be coasting.

codex:cx_duct_fan_c.zh: 断电，等叶轮停下，再拆法兰。
codex:cx_duct_fan_c.en: Isolate, let it spin down, then unbolt the flanges.

codex:cx_duct_fan_x.zh: 风机断电后叶轮靠惯性还能转一阵，真空里没有空气阻力，会转得更久。
codex:cx_duct_fan_x.en: An unpowered fan coasts on; in vacuum, with no air to slow it, for longer still.

codex:cx_filter_a.zh: 壳体里的折叠滤芯，进出口、压差表和排放阀。
codex:cx_filter_a.en: A pleated element in a housing, with inlet, outlet, a differential gauge and a drain valve.

codex:cx_filter_b.zh: 滤芯截留的东西可能有毒、有污染、或带放射性。
codex:cx_filter_b.en: What the element caught may be toxic, contaminated or radioactive.

codex:cx_filter_c.zh: 先排空，带污染的滤芯封好送危险品口。
codex:cx_filter_c.en: Drain it; a contaminated element is sealed and sent to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_filter_x.zh: 压差表读滤芯两侧的压降，堵得越多压降越大。隔离舱、核设施、生物舱的过滤器本身就是危险品。
codex:cx_filter_x.en: The differential gauge reads the drop across the element, rising as it clogs. In isolation rooms, reactors and bio bays the filter is itself a hazard.

codex:cx_trap_a.zh: 倒置浮桶式疏水器：排出冷凝水、留住蒸汽。
codex:cx_trap_a.en: An inverted-bucket trap: lets condensate out, keeps steam in.

codex:cx_trap_b.zh: 蒸汽管路里的它可能又热又带压。
codex:cx_trap_b.en: On a steam line it may be hot and under pressure.

codex:cx_trap_c.en: Measure the temperature, relieve the pressure, then remove it.

codex:cx_trap_x.zh: 浮桶里有蒸汽时浮起关阀，有冷凝水时下沉开阀。失重下它靠的是压差和流动，不是浮力——船上的疏水器都是改过的。
codex:cx_trap_x.en: Steam floats the bucket and shuts the valve, water sinks it and opens it. Without gravity it works on pressure difference and flow rather than buoyancy — ship traps are modified for it.

codex:cx_manifold_a.zh: 一根总管上分出多路支管，每路一个隔离阀。
codex:cx_manifold_a.en: One header with several branches, each with its isolating valve.

codex:cx_manifold_b.zh: 每路支管里的介质、压力可能不同，拆总管时各路一起漏。
codex:cx_manifold_b.en: Each branch may hold a different medium at a different pressure; take the header off and they all leak.

codex:cx_manifold_c.zh: 逐路关阀、排空、测过，再拆总管。
codex:cx_manifold_c.en: Shut, drain and check branch by branch, then the header.

codex:cx_manifold_x.zh: 阀组让一台泵服务多个罐。开着的支路之间是连通的：抽一个罐时其它罐的阀没关，会一起被抽，或者在总管里混料。
codex:cx_manifold_x.en: A manifold lets one pump serve many tanks. Open branches are connected: draw one tank with the others' valves open and they're drawn too, or mixed in the header.

codex:cx_aux_a.zh: 球形阀体、阀盖、膜片执行器和定位器：自动调节流量的阀。
codex:cx_aux_a.en: Globe body, bonnet, diaphragm actuator and positioner: a valve that sets a flow by itself.

codex:cx_aux_b.zh: 执行器断气断电时会自动走到“故障位”，可能开也可能关。
codex:cx_aux_b.en: With its air or power gone it goes to its fail position, which may be open or shut.

codex:cx_aux_c.zh: 别靠它隔离；用手动阀隔离后再拆。
codex:cx_aux_c.en: Don't rely on it to isolate; isolate with hand valves, then remove it.

codex:cx_aux_x.zh: 调节阀按控制信号连续开度，阀芯有间隙，本来就不是密封用的。故障开（FO）的阀在断电后全开。
codex:cx_aux_x.en: A control valve throttles continuously to its signal; its trim has clearances and was never meant to seal. A fail-open valve goes fully open when the power goes.

codex:cx_relief_a.zh: 弹簧压着阀芯，超压时自动开启泄放。
codex:cx_relief_a.en: A spring holds the disc shut; over its set pressure it lifts and vents.

codex:cx_relief_b.zh: 冻住、堵住的安全阀不会开：罐压会一直升到爆。
codex:cx_relief_b.en: Frozen or blocked, it won't lift: the pressure climbs until the vessel bursts.

codex:cx_relief_c.zh: 测阀体温度，冻住的先解冻，或从接口抽低压力。
codex:cx_relief_c.en: Read its body temperature; thaw a frozen one, or draw the pressure down at a port.

codex:cx_relief_x.zh: 安全阀是压力容器最后一道保护，整定压力通常是设计压力的 1.0–1.1 倍；起跳后压力降到回座压力才重新关闭。低温罐的安全阀出口会被泄放的冷气冻上冰塞。
codex:cx_relief_x.en: The relief valve is a pressure vessel's last line, set at 1.0–1.1 × its design pressure; once lifted it reseats only below its reseat pressure. On a cryogenic tank, the cold gas it vents can freeze an ice plug in its own outlet.

codex:cx_pipe_a.zh: 带法兰、保温和吊架的一段管道。
codex:cx_pipe_a.en: A length of pipe with flanges, lagging and hangers.

codex:cx_pipe_b.zh: 满管切开会漏液或喷出可燃物。
codex:cx_pipe_b.en: Cut full, it leaks or sprays something flammable.

codex:cx_pipe_c.zh: 上下游关阀、从低点排空，再拆法兰。
codex:cx_pipe_c.en: Valve it off both ends, drain from the low point, then unbolt the flanges.

codex:cx_pipe_x.zh: 拆法兰比切管干净：法兰螺栓松开后管段完整，可以整段回收。管段里残留的液体在失重下不会自己流出来，要靠抽。
codex:cx_pipe_x.en: Unbolting a flange is cleaner than cutting: the spool comes away whole. What's left inside won't run out by itself without gravity; it has to be drawn.

codex:cx_hpu_a.zh: 油箱、电机泵、蓄能器、电磁阀块和压力表。
codex:cx_hpu_a.en: Reservoir, motor-pump, accumulators, solenoid valve block, pressure gauge.

codex:cx_hpu_b.zh: 蓄能器里存着高压油：断电后压力还在，管一切就喷。
codex:cx_hpu_b.en: Its accumulators hold oil under pressure: off, the pressure stays, and a cut line sprays.

codex:cx_hpu_c.zh: 开泄压阀把蓄能器压力放到 0，再拆管和机构。
codex:cx_hpu_c.en: Open the dump valve, bring the accumulators to zero, then the lines and what they drive.

codex:cx_hpu_x.zh: 液压系统常在 20 MPa 以上工作：一个 20 L 的蓄能器在 20 MPa 时存约 200 kJ。它驱动的缸、夹钳、机械臂只要还保着压，就是一根压缩着的弹簧。
codex:cx_hpu_x.en: Hydraulics often run above 20 MPa: a 20 L accumulator at 20 MPa holds about 200 kJ. Every cylinder, clamp and arm it drives is a compressed spring while it holds pressure.

codex:cx_actuator_a.zh: 电机、皮带、滚珠丝杠和推杆：把转动变成直线推力。
codex:cx_actuator_a.en: Motor, belt, ball screw and rod: rotation turned into a straight push.

codex:cx_actuator_b.zh: 带电时控制线一断，推杆可能猛地一动；它顶着的东西没锁会掉。
codex:cx_actuator_b.en: Live, a cut control line can jerk the rod; what it holds up drops if unlocked.

codex:cx_actuator_c.zh: 先锁住它或它支撑的东西，断电后再拆。
codex:cx_actuator_c.en: Lock it or what it carries, kill its supply, then remove it.

codex:cx_actuator_x.zh: 滚珠丝杠效率高，反过来也能被推动：断电后没有刹车的作动器会被负载推着倒转。精密场合（镜片促动器）有专门的锁定机构。
codex:cx_actuator_x.en: A ball screw is efficient enough to be back-driven: unpowered and unbraked, the load pushes it round. Precision uses — a mirror's actuators — have their own locks.

codex:cx_gastank_a.zh: 带瓶阀和手轮的高压气瓶，色环标出气体种类。
codex:cx_gastank_a.en: A high-pressure cylinder with valve and handwheel, coloured bands naming the gas.

codex:cx_gastank_b.zh: 高压气瓶被切开才会爆裂：气体冲进舱里或漂散，瓶阀断掉时整瓶像火箭一样飞出去。
codex:cx_gastank_b.en: A full cylinder only bursts when cut: the gas floods the room or drifts off, and with its valve sheared it flies like a rocket.

codex:cx_gastank_c.zh: 密封完好的满瓶整瓶送设备回收口；要放气就从它的 -V 接口放，别切。
codex:cx_gastank_c.en: A sealed full cylinder goes whole to the equipment mouth; to empty it, vent at its -V port. Never cut it.

codex:cx_gastank_x.zh: 一只 50 L、200 bar 的气瓶储存约 1.5 MJ 的压缩能。瓶阀断掉时，喷口推力可达瓶重的几十倍。氧气瓶还会让周围的东西更容易燃烧。
codex:cx_gastank_x.en: A 50 L cylinder at 200 bar holds about 1.5 MJ. With its valve sheared off, the jet's thrust is tens of times its weight. An oxygen cylinder also makes everything round it burn more readily.

codex:cx_fueltank_a.zh: 卧在鞍座上的压力容器，内有防晃隔板，顶部管口和液位计。
codex:cx_fueltank_a.en: A pressure vessel in its saddles, with baffles inside, nozzles on top and a level gauge.

codex:cx_fueltank_b.zh: 还有液或带压就切会爆；漏出的燃料成可燃云。
codex:cx_fueltank_b.en: Cut with liquid or pressure in it, it bursts; leaked fuel makes a flammable cloud.

codex:cx_fueltank_c.zh: 从回收口抽空、泄掉罐顶气，整件送危险品口。
codex:cx_fueltank_c.en: Draw it empty at its port, vent the ullage, take it whole to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_fueltank_x.zh: 储罐上方的气垫（罐顶气）保持罐压，让泵吸得进液体。抽液时要么维持增压，要么让空气补进来；在真空里只抽不补，罐会被抽瘪。
codex:cx_fueltank_x.en: The gas cushion above the liquid (the ullage) keeps the tank pressurised so the pump can draw. Drawing off, either keep the pressurisation on or let gas in; in vacuum, drawing alone can collapse the tank.

codex:cx_sphere_tank_a.zh: 赤道环焊缝、安装耳、推进剂管理叶片和顶部加注阀。
codex:cx_sphere_tank_a.en: A girth weld, mounting tabs, propellant management vanes and a fill valve on top.

codex:cx_sphere_tank_b.zh: 球罐承压最高：切开就是一次爆炸。
codex:cx_sphere_tank_b.en: Spheres carry the highest pressures: cutting one is an explosion.

codex:cx_sphere_tank_c.zh: 测压，从接口泄压到安全，再拆安装耳。
codex:cx_sphere_tank_c.en: Measure, relieve it at the port, then unbolt its tabs.

codex:cx_sphere_tank_x.zh: 同样壁厚，球的承压能力是圆筒的两倍，所以高压气体和推进剂常装在球罐里。失重下推进剂管理叶片靠毛细作用把液体引到出口。
codex:cx_sphere_tank_x.en: For the same wall a sphere holds twice the pressure of a cylinder, so high-pressure gas and propellant go in spheres. In free fall the vanes wick the liquid to the outlet by capillary action.

codex:cx_cryotank_a.zh: 真空夹套里的内罐：液氢、液氮或液化天然气在沸点下储存。
codex:cx_cryotank_a.en: An inner tank in a vacuum jacket: liquid hydrogen, nitrogen or LNG stored at its boiling point.

codex:cx_cryotank_b.zh: 一直在蒸发升压；安全阀冻住就会爆罐。
codex:cx_cryotank_b.en: It boils off all the time and its pressure climbs; with its relief valve frozen it bursts.

codex:cx_cryotank_c.zh: 保持制冷，边抽边降压，最后再断电。
codex:cx_cryotank_c.en: Keep it refrigerated, draw it down to lower the pressure, cut the power last.

codex:cx_cryotank_x.zh: 液氢在 −253 °C、液氮在 −196 °C 沸腾。热量每漏进一点，就蒸发一点液体变成气体，体积膨胀几百倍——这就是低温罐压力不断上升的原因。真空夹套一破，漏热增加十倍。
codex:cx_cryotank_x.en: Liquid hydrogen boils at −253 °C, nitrogen at −196 °C. Every bit of heat that leaks in boils some liquid off, expanding hundreds of times — which is why a cryogenic tank's pressure keeps rising. Lose the vacuum jacket and the heat leak goes up tenfold.

codex:cx_water_a.zh: 带人孔、通气管、防晃板和液位镜的水箱。
codex:cx_water_a.en: A tank with manway, vent, baffles and a sight glass.

codex:cx_water_b.zh: 切开后水漂出来，碰到带电设备就短路。
codex:cx_water_b.en: Cut open, the water drifts out and shorts what it touches.

codex:cx_water_c.zh: 从出水阀或接口抽空，再拆。
codex:cx_water_c.en: Draw it off at the outlet or a port, then remove it.

codex:cx_water_x.zh: 水在真空里先剧烈沸腾，蒸发吸热让剩下的水在几秒内结冰，成为缓慢升华的冰球。水是船上值钱的货：几立方米的水按合同价计。
codex:cx_water_x.en: In vacuum water boils hard at first; the evaporation chills the rest into a slowly subliming ball of ice within seconds. Water is worth money: cubic metres of it are paid into the contract.

codex:cx_extinguisher_a.zh: 带释放头、压力表和电磁启动器的灭火剂瓶。
codex:cx_extinguisher_a.en: A suppressant bottle with discharge head, gauge and solenoid actuator.

codex:cx_extinguisher_b.zh: 启动器带电时误触发会喷放；瓶本身是高压容器。
codex:cx_extinguisher_b.en: Its actuator, if live, can fire it; the bottle itself is a pressure vessel.

codex:cx_extinguisher_c.zh: 需要灭火时用它；不用就断电后整瓶送危险品口。
codex:cx_extinguisher_c.en: Use it if there's a fire; otherwise isolate it and send it whole to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_extinguisher_x.zh: 船上常用 CO₂、哈龙替代品或泡沫。在密闭舱里喷放 CO₂ 能把氧浓度降到燃烧下限以下，但也意味着这个舱里的气体不能再按空气回收。有的船上灭火瓶早已空了——测一下压力表。
codex:cx_extinguisher_x.en: Ships carry CO₂, halon replacements or foam. Discharged in a closed room CO₂ takes the oxygen below what burns, though the room's gas is no longer clean air to recover. Some ships' bottles are long empty — read the gauge.

codex:cx_o2cab_a.zh: 玻璃门里两只氧气瓶、减压器和面罩。
codex:cx_o2cab_a.en: Two oxygen cylinders behind a glass door, a regulator and a mask.

codex:cx_o2cab_b.zh: 高压纯氧：附近动激光会让火势猛增。
codex:cx_o2cab_b.en: High-pressure pure oxygen: a laser near it makes any fire far fiercer.

codex:cx_o2cab_c.zh: 关瓶阀，整柜送危险品口。
codex:cx_o2cab_c.en: Shut the cylinder valves and send the cabinet whole to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_o2cab_x.zh: 氧气本身不燃，但能让几乎所有东西燃烧得更快、更热；浸过氧的织物、油脂甚至金属屑都可能被点燃。
codex:cx_o2cab_x.en: Oxygen doesn't burn itself but makes almost anything burn faster and hotter; oxygen-soaked fabric, grease, even metal swarf can light.

codex:cx_co2_scrubber_a.zh: 双床胺吸收（或沸石）罐、切换阀和鼓风机。
codex:cx_co2_scrubber_a.en: Twin amine (or zeolite) beds, switching valves and a blower.

codex:cx_co2_scrubber_b.zh: 吸附床里富集着 CO₂，再生管线通向真空。
codex:cx_co2_scrubber_b.en: The beds hold concentrated CO₂; the regeneration line opens to vacuum.

codex:cx_co2_scrubber_c.en: Isolate it, close the switching valves, then remove it.

codex:cx_co2_scrubber_x.zh: 两个床交替工作：一个吸附舱里的 CO₂，另一个对真空解吸再生。人呼出的 CO₂ 浓度过 1% 就会头痛，过 5% 有生命危险。
codex:cx_co2_scrubber_x.en: The beds take turns: one absorbs the cabin's CO₂ while the other desorbs to vacuum. Above 1 % CO₂ people get headaches; above 5 % it's dangerous.

codex:cx_psa_a.zh: 两根吸附塔和上下切换阀组：从混合气里分离出某种气体。
codex:cx_psa_a.en: Two adsorber columns and switching manifolds: one gas separated out of a mixture.

codex:cx_psa_b.zh: 塔里有压力，分离出的可能是纯氧、纯氮或氢。
codex:cx_psa_b.en: The columns are under pressure, and what they separate may be pure oxygen, nitrogen or hydrogen.

codex:cx_psa_c.zh: 关进气，从接口泄压，再拆。
codex:cx_psa_c.en: Shut the feed, relieve it at a port, then remove it.

codex:cx_psa_x.zh: 分子筛在高压下多吸附某种分子、低压下放出，两塔交替加压减压，就能连续产出纯气。纯氮环境会让人无预兆地窒息。
codex:cx_psa_x.en: A molecular sieve takes up one kind of molecule at high pressure and lets it go at low; two columns swinging in turn make a steady stream of pure gas. Pure nitrogen suffocates without warning.

codex:cx_electrolyser_a.zh: 电解槽、氢氧气液分离器、循环泵和整流器。
codex:cx_electrolyser_a.en: Cell stack, hydrogen and oxygen separators, circulation pump and rectifier.

codex:cx_electrolyser_b.zh: 同时有氢、有氧、有电：泄漏就是爆鸣气。
codex:cx_electrolyser_b.en: Hydrogen, oxygen and power in one place: a leak is a detonating mixture.

codex:cx_electrolyser_c.zh: 断电，两侧气体分别放空，再拆。
codex:cx_electrolyser_c.en: Isolate it, vent each gas separately, then remove it.

codex:cx_electrolyser_x.zh: 电解 1 kg 水产生约 1.24 m³ 氢气和 0.62 m³ 氧气，耗电约 5 kWh。氢氧以 2:1 混合是最猛烈的爆鸣气。
codex:cx_electrolyser_x.en: Splitting 1 kg of water gives about 1.24 m³ of hydrogen and 0.62 m³ of oxygen for some 5 kWh. Mixed two to one they make the most violent of detonating gases.

codex:cx_humidifier_a.zh: 电极沸腾筒、进排水阀、蒸汽软管和控制盒。
codex:cx_humidifier_a.en: Electrode boiling cylinder, fill and drain valves, steam hose, control box.

codex:cx_humidifier_b.zh: 筒里是热水和带电的电极。
codex:cx_humidifier_b.en: Hot water and live electrodes in the cylinder.

codex:cx_humidifier_x.zh: 电极式加湿器让电流直接穿过水把它烧开：水的导电性决定功率。断电后筒里的水仍然很烫。
codex:cx_humidifier_x.en: An electrode humidifier boils water by passing current straight through it; the water's conductivity sets the power. The water stays hot after it's switched off.

codex:cx_uv_steriliser_a.zh: 不锈钢腔体中间一根紫外灯管，配强度传感器和镇流器。
codex:cx_uv_steriliser_a.en: A stainless chamber with a UV lamp down its axis, intensity sensor and ballast.

codex:cx_uv_steriliser_b.zh: 灯管含汞，石英套管易碎；腔体里是水。
codex:cx_uv_steriliser_b.en: The lamp holds mercury and its quartz sleeve breaks easily; the chamber is full of water.

codex:cx_uv_steriliser_c.zh: 断电、排空，整件送设备口。
codex:cx_uv_steriliser_c.en: Isolate, drain, send it whole to the equipment bay.

codex:cx_uv_steriliser_x.zh: 254 nm 紫外线破坏微生物的 DNA。灯管破碎会释放汞蒸气。
codex:cx_uv_steriliser_x.en: 254 nm ultraviolet breaks microbes' DNA. A broken lamp releases mercury vapour.

codex:cx_separator_3ph_a.zh: 卧式容器里用堰板把油、水、气分开，各有出口。
codex:cx_separator_3ph_a.en: A horizontal vessel whose weir splits oil, water and gas, each to its own outlet.

codex:cx_separator_3ph_b.zh: 容器里常留有残压和三种介质。
codex:cx_separator_3ph_b.en: It usually keeps some pressure and all three phases.

codex:cx_separator_3ph_c.zh: 从塔上的接口泄压，三路分别排空，再拆。
codex:cx_separator_3ph_c.en: Relieve it at its port, drain the three outlets, then remove it.

codex:cx_separator_3ph_x.zh: 地面上分离靠重力；船上的分离器靠旋流或离心力代替重力，结构类似但更紧凑。
codex:cx_separator_3ph_x.en: On the ground separation runs on gravity; aboard ship it's done with swirl or centrifuge instead, similar in layout but more compact.

codex:cx_coriolis_a.zh: 两根弯管在激振器驱动下振动，测出质量流量。
codex:cx_coriolis_a.en: Two bent tubes driven to vibrate; their twist gives the mass flow.

codex:cx_coriolis_b.zh: 它装在管路里：拆它等于断开那条管。
codex:cx_coriolis_b.en: It sits in the line: taking it out opens the line.

codex:cx_coriolis_c.zh: 先排空它所在的管路，再拆法兰。
codex:cx_coriolis_c.en: Drain its line first, then unbolt the flanges.

codex:cx_coriolis_x.zh: 流体流过振动的管子时受科里奥利力，两端振动出现相位差，相位差正比于质量流量。精度可达 0.1%，很贵。
codex:cx_coriolis_x.en: Fluid in a vibrating tube feels a Coriolis force; the two ends fall out of phase in proportion to the mass flow. Good to 0.1 %, and expensive.

codex:cx_level_radar_a.zh: 从罐顶法兰伸进罐里的喇叭天线和电子头。
codex:cx_level_radar_a.en: A horn antenna through a tank's top flange, with its electronics head.

codex:cx_level_radar_b.zh: 它装在罐口上：罐里有压，拆它就开了一个口。
codex:cx_level_radar_b.en: It's in the tank's roof: pressurised, taking it off opens a hole.

codex:cx_level_radar_c.zh: 读它的液位，罐空了再拆。
codex:cx_level_radar_c.en: Read its level; take it off once the tank is empty.

codex:cx_level_radar_x.zh: 雷达测量电磁波到液面再反射回来的时间。失重下液面不平，船上的液位计读的是平均值。
codex:cx_level_radar_x.en: It times a radar pulse to the surface and back. Without gravity the surface isn't flat, so a ship's gauge reads an average.

codex:cx_gauge_box_a.zh: 弹性体上贴着金属箔应变片，读结构里的受力。
codex:cx_gauge_box_a.en: Foil strain gauges on a flexure body, reading the load in a structure.

codex:cx_gauge_box_b.zh: 读数高说明这里在承受大力：此时切开会弹开。
codex:cx_gauge_box_b.en: A high reading means this point is carrying a big load: cut now and it springs.

codex:cx_gauge_box_c.zh: 动手前读一遍，读数降下来再拆。
codex:cx_gauge_box_c.en: Read it before you work; wait for it to come down.

codex:cx_gauge_box_x.zh: 应变片的电阻随拉伸变化，惠斯通电桥把它变成电压。承力件、拉杆、铰链上的载荷表告诉你哪里还“绷着”。
codex:cx_gauge_box_x.en: A strain gauge's resistance changes as it stretches; a Wheatstone bridge turns that into a voltage. Load readings on members, tie rods and hinges tell you what's still under tension.

codex:cx_insp_a.zh: 带显示窗的仪表、传感器节点、探测头。
codex:cx_insp_a.en: Instruments with display windows, sensor nodes, detector heads.

codex:cx_insp_b.zh: 本身危险不大，但常接在带压管路或带电回路上。
codex:cx_insp_b.en: Harmless themselves, but often on a pressurised line or a live circuit.

codex:cx_insp_c.zh: 读它的数，再按它所在的管路或电路处理。
codex:cx_insp_c.en: Read it, then deal with it as part of its line or circuit.

codex:cx_insp_x.zh: 仪表让你知道船现在的状态；它们的读数和面板记录不同，是实时的（只要你自己去读）。
codex:cx_insp_x.en: Instruments tell you the ship's state now; unlike a panel's records, their readings are live — as long as you read them yourself.

codex:cx_screw_comp_a.zh: 一对阴阳转子、电机、油分离器和油冷却器。
codex:cx_screw_comp_a.en: A pair of male and female rotors, motor, oil separator and oil cooler.

codex:cx_screw_comp_b.zh: 排气侧和油分里有压力和热油。
codex:cx_screw_comp_b.en: Its discharge side and oil separator hold pressure and hot oil.

codex:cx_screw_comp_c.en: Stop it, relieve it, drain the oil, then remove it.

codex:cx_screw_comp_x.zh: 两根螺旋转子啮合，把吸进的气体沿轴向挤压到排气端。氦压缩机为低温系统提供高压氦气，氦很贵，要回收。
codex:cx_screw_comp_x.en: Two meshing helical rotors squeeze the gas along to the discharge end. A helium compressor feeds a cryogenic plant; helium is dear and recovered.

codex:cx_axial_comp_a.zh: 一排排动叶和静叶交错，机匣向后收窄。
codex:cx_axial_comp_a.en: Rows of rotor blades between rows of stator vanes in a casing that narrows aft.

codex:cx_axial_comp_b.zh: 转子可能还在惯性转动；进气口还连着工艺气。
codex:cx_axial_comp_b.en: The rotor may still be coasting; its inlet is still on the process gas.

codex:cx_axial_comp_c.zh: 等转子停稳、进口隔离后再拆。
codex:cx_axial_comp_c.en: Wait for the rotor to stop and isolate the inlet, then remove it.

codex:cx_axial_comp_x.zh: 每一级把气体压力提高约 1.2–1.4 倍。叶尖线速度可达每秒几百米，叶片断裂时像弹片一样飞出。
codex:cx_axial_comp_x.en: Each stage raises the pressure about 1.2–1.4 times. Blade tips run at hundreds of metres a second; a broken blade leaves like shrapnel.

codex:cx_turboexpander_a.zh: 膨胀透平和制动压缩机装在一根气体轴承轴上。
codex:cx_turboexpander_a.en: An expansion turbine and a brake compressor on one shaft in gas bearings.

codex:cx_turboexpander_b.zh: 转速几万转；里面是极冷的工艺气。
codex:cx_turboexpander_b.en: It runs at tens of thousands of rpm, full of very cold process gas.

codex:cx_turboexpander_c.en: Stop it, let it warm up, relieve it, then remove it.

codex:cx_turboexpander_x.zh: 气体膨胀对外做功，温度骤降——这是低温制冷和液化的核心。小型透平转速可超过 10 万 rpm。
codex:cx_turboexpander_x.en: Gas expanding through it does work and its temperature drops sharply — the heart of cryogenic refrigeration and liquefaction. Small ones exceed 100,000 rpm.

codex:cx_turbo_pump_a.zh: 一叠转子和定子叶片，高速转动把气体分子打向出口。
codex:cx_turbo_pump_a.en: A stack of rotor and stator blades spinning fast to knock gas molecules to the outlet.

codex:cx_turbo_pump_b.zh: 转子每分钟几万转，突然进气会让它损毁。
codex:cx_turbo_pump_b.en: The rotor runs at tens of thousands of rpm; a sudden inrush of gas wrecks it.

codex:cx_turbo_pump_c.zh: 停机等它慢下来，再放气、拆法兰。
codex:cx_turbo_pump_c.en: Stop it, let it run down, then vent and unbolt it.

codex:cx_turbo_pump_x.zh: 分子泵叶尖速度接近气体分子的热运动速度，只能在高真空下工作，前级要有别的泵。完全停下要好几分钟。
codex:cx_turbo_pump_x.en: Its blade tips move about as fast as the gas molecules, so it only works in high vacuum, backed by another pump. It takes minutes to stop.

codex:cx_scroll_pump_a.zh: 一对互相嵌套的螺旋，一个固定一个公转。
codex:cx_scroll_pump_a.en: Two interleaved spirals, one fixed, one orbiting.

codex:cx_scroll_pump_b.zh: 它循环的可能是昂贵的 ³He 混合气。
codex:cx_scroll_pump_b.en: What it circulates may be costly ³He mixture.

codex:cx_scroll_pump_c.zh: 先回收它回路里的气，再停机拆。
codex:cx_scroll_pump_c.en: Recover the gas in its loop before stopping and removing it.

codex:cx_scroll_pump_x.zh: 涡旋泵无油，不会污染气体，所以用来循环稀释制冷机的 ³He/⁴He 混合气。
codex:cx_scroll_pump_x.en: Scroll pumps are oil-free and don't contaminate the gas, which is why they circulate a dilution refrigerator's ³He/⁴He mixture.

codex:cx_dry_cooler_a.zh: V 形翅片盘管和一排风机：把冷却液的热散出去。
codex:cx_dry_cooler_a.en: Finned coils in a V under a row of fans: shedding the coolant's heat.

codex:cx_dry_cooler_b.en: Its coils are full of coolant.

codex:cx_dry_cooler_c.en: Drain the loop before removing it.

codex:cx_dry_cooler_x.zh: 干冷器只靠空气散热，不蒸发水。真空里它没有空气可吹，只能当辐射面用——船上的“干冷器”其实大多是在有气的舱里。
codex:cx_dry_cooler_x.en: A dry cooler sheds heat to air with no water evaporated. In vacuum there's no air to blow, so aboard ship they sit in rooms that hold air.

codex:cx_cdu_a.zh: 板式换热器、两台泵、过滤器、膨胀罐和控制器。
codex:cx_cdu_a.en: Plate heat exchanger, two pumps, filter, expansion vessel and controller.

codex:cx_cdu_b.zh: 它连着整排机柜的冷却液。
codex:cx_cdu_b.en: It's connected to a whole row of racks' coolant.

codex:cx_cdu_c.zh: 排空它所在的回路，断电后再拆。
codex:cx_cdu_c.en: Drain its loop and isolate it before removing it.

codex:cx_cdu_x.zh: CDU 把机房的冷却水和机柜的二次冷却液隔开，一台可以服务几百千瓦的计算负载。
codex:cx_cdu_x.en: A CDU keeps the facility water apart from the racks' secondary coolant; one can serve hundreds of kilowatts of computing.

codex:cx_eng_core_a.zh: 涡轮泵、燃气发生器、喷注器和再生冷却燃烧室。
codex:cx_eng_core_a.en: Turbopump, gas generator, injector and a regeneratively cooled chamber.

codex:cx_eng_core_b.zh: 输送管和冷却夹套里还留着推进剂，有的有毒、有的自燃。
codex:cx_eng_core_b.en: Its feed lines and cooling jacket still hold propellant, some toxic, some self-igniting.

codex:cx_eng_core_c.zh: 关主阀，从排放口排空推进剂，再拆它的推力架。
codex:cx_eng_core_c.en: Close the main valves, drain the propellant at the drains, then unbolt its thrust frame.

codex:cx_eng_core_x.zh: 燃料先流过燃烧室壁里的冷却通道再进喷注器，所以停机后壁里还有一层推进剂。肼类推进剂有毒，与氧化剂接触即自燃。发动机是船上最重最值钱的设备之一，常要沿法兰分段。
codex:cx_eng_core_x.en: Fuel runs through the channels in the chamber wall before the injector, so a layer of it stays in the wall after shutdown. Hydrazines are toxic and ignite on contact with their oxidiser. Engines are among the heaviest and most valuable things aboard and often come apart at their flanges.

codex:cx_engine_s_a.zh: 靠贮箱气压挤出推进剂的小发动机：阀门、喷注头、燃烧室和喷管。
codex:cx_engine_s_a.en: A small engine fed by tank pressure: valves, injector head, chamber and bell.

codex:cx_engine_s_b.zh: 贮箱还有压，阀一开推进剂就喷出来。
codex:cx_engine_s_b.en: With its tanks still pressurised, a valve opened sprays propellant.

codex:cx_engine_s_c.zh: 先泄掉贮箱的增压气，再拆发动机。
codex:cx_engine_s_c.en: Vent the tanks' pressurant before removing the engine.

codex:cx_engine_s_x.zh: 没有涡轮泵，结构简单可靠，但贮箱要做得耐高压。小飞船、着陆器、作业艇多用这种。
codex:cx_engine_s_x.en: No turbopump, simple and reliable, but its tanks must take high pressure. Small craft, landers and work tugs use them.

codex:cx_nozzle_a.zh: 钟形喷管：加强环、冷却管和喉部集管。
codex:cx_nozzle_a.en: A bell nozzle: stiffening rings, coolant tubes and the manifold at its throat.

codex:cx_nozzle_b.zh: 很大但很薄，撞一下就变形；冷却管里可能有残液。
codex:cx_nozzle_b.en: Big but thin, it dents at a knock; its coolant tubes may hold residue.

codex:cx_nozzle_c.zh: 排空冷却管，沿法兰拆，慢慢拖运。
codex:cx_nozzle_c.en: Drain the tubes, unbolt it at its flange, tow it slowly.

codex:cx_nozzle_x.zh: 喷管把燃气的热能变成速度：截面比越大，真空中的比冲越高。真空喷管的扩张比可达 100 以上，壁薄如纸。
codex:cx_nozzle_x.en: The nozzle turns the gas's heat into speed; the bigger its area ratio, the higher its specific impulse in vacuum. Vacuum bells reach area ratios over 100, with paper-thin walls.

codex:cx_rcs_quad_a.zh: 一个安装块上四个小推力器，配加热片和电磁阀。
codex:cx_rcs_quad_a.en: Four small thrusters on one block, with heater pad and valves.

codex:cx_rcs_quad_b.zh: 阀门带电时一误动就喷火；管里有推进剂。
codex:cx_rcs_quad_b.en: Its valves, if live, can fire; its lines hold propellant.

codex:cx_rcs_quad_c.zh: 断电、关贮箱阀、排空管路后再拆。
codex:cx_rcs_quad_c.en: Isolate, shut the tank valves and drain the lines before removing it.

codex:cx_rcs_quad_x.zh: 单组元肼推力器靠催化床分解肼产生推力，几十牛到几百牛。加热片让催化床保持预热。
codex:cx_rcs_quad_x.en: Monopropellant thrusters decompose hydrazine on a catalyst bed for tens to hundreds of newtons; the heater keeps the bed warm.

codex:cx_turbopump_a.zh: 燃料泵和氧化剂泵装在一根轴上，中间是涡轮。
codex:cx_turbopump_a.en: Fuel and oxidiser pumps on one shaft with the turbine between.

codex:cx_turbopump_b.zh: 两种推进剂在同一台机器里，泵壳里有残液。
codex:cx_turbopump_b.en: Two propellants in one machine, residue in both pump casings.

codex:cx_turbopump_c.en: Drain both sides separately, then remove it.

codex:cx_turbopump_x.zh: 涡轮泵功率密度极高：几十公斤的机器输出几兆瓦，转速每分钟几万转。轴封把燃料和氧化剂隔开，封坏了就是爆炸。
codex:cx_turbopump_x.en: A turbopump is power-dense: tens of kilograms putting out megawatts at tens of thousands of rpm. The shaft seals keep fuel and oxidiser apart; when they fail, it explodes.

codex:cx_apu_a.zh: 小型燃气轮机加齿轮箱和发电机。
codex:cx_apu_a.en: A small gas turbine with its gearbox and generator.

codex:cx_apu_b.zh: 燃料管里有油，发电机端可能带电。
codex:cx_apu_b.en: Fuel in its lines, and its generator may be live.

codex:cx_apu_c.zh: 关燃油、断电、排空后再拆。
codex:cx_apu_c.en: Fuel off, isolated, drained, then remove it.

codex:cx_apu_x.zh: APU 在主发动机不工作时提供电力和气源，自己就是一台完整的小涡轮发动机。
codex:cx_apu_x.en: An APU provides power and air when the main engines don't run; it's a complete little turbine engine itself.

codex:cx_ntr_core_a.zh: 六角燃料元件、铍反射层和控制鼓：用核裂变加热氢气推进。
codex:cx_ntr_core_a.en: Hexagonal fuel elements, a beryllium reflector and control drums: fission heating hydrogen for thrust.

codex:cx_ntr_core_b.zh: 停堆后仍有强辐射和衰变热；激光切到堆芯会直接核爆。
codex:cx_ntr_core_b.en: Shut down, still fiercely radioactive and hot; the beam into it detonates it.

codex:cx_ntr_core_c.zh: 在屏蔽阴影里工作，等它冷却，锁好控制鼓后整件吊走。
codex:cx_ntr_core_c.en: Work in a shield's shadow, let it cool, lock the drums, lift it out whole.

codex:cx_ntr_core_x.zh: 核热火箭把氢气加热到 2,500 K 以上从喷管喷出，比冲约 900 s，是化学火箭的两倍。停堆后衰变热约为满功率的 1%，并随时间缓慢下降。
codex:cx_ntr_core_x.en: It heats hydrogen past 2,500 K and expands it through the nozzle, for a specific impulse around 900 s — twice a chemical rocket's. After shutdown the decay heat is about 1 % of full power, falling slowly.

codex:cx_nav_rack_a.zh: 19 英寸机架：配线架、交换机、服务器和底部的 UPS。
codex:cx_nav_rack_a.en: 19-inch racks: patch panel, switch, servers and a UPS at the foot.

codex:cx_nav_rack_b.zh: 底部的 UPS 是一路独立电源：断了总线它照样带电。
codex:cx_nav_rack_b.en: The UPS at its foot is a supply of its own: kill the bus and it's still live.

codex:cx_nav_rack_c.zh: 断开 UPS 的输出，再拔线拆机架。
codex:cx_nav_rack_c.en: Switch the UPS output off, then unplug and remove the rack.

codex:cx_nav_rack_x.zh: 不间断电源平时充着电，主电一断立刻接管，能撑几分钟到几小时。数据设备价值高，整架拆下比拆散好卖。
codex:cx_nav_rack_x.en: A UPS charges while the mains is on and takes over the moment it goes, for minutes or hours. Data hardware is valuable and sells better as a whole rack.

codex:cx_nav_a.zh: 带显示屏、旋钮和底部接插件的机载电子盒。
codex:cx_nav_a.en: A flight electronics box with display, selectors and connectors along its foot.

codex:cx_nav_b.zh: 价值高、怕撞，接插件带电时拔会损坏。
codex:cx_nav_b.en: Valuable and fragile; pulled live, its connectors are damaged.

codex:cx_nav_c.zh: 断电后拔插头，轻拿轻放送设备口。
codex:cx_nav_c.en: Unplug once isolated, handle gently to the equipment bay.

codex:cx_nav_x.zh: 航电单元按 ARINC 等标准做成可整件更换的盒子，前面板两个把手，后面盲插。
codex:cx_nav_x.en: Avionics are built to standards like ARINC as whole replaceable boxes: two handles on the front, blind-mate connectors at the back.

codex:cx_console_a.zh: 底座、桌面、倾斜的显示面板、键盘和操纵杆。
codex:cx_console_a.en: Pedestal, desk, sloped display panel, keyboard and joystick.

codex:cx_console_b.zh: 显示的状态可能早已过期。
codex:cx_console_b.en: What it shows may be long out of date.

codex:cx_console_c.zh: 别信它的屏幕，自己测；断电后整件拆下。
codex:cx_console_c.en: Don't trust its screens, measure; isolate and remove it whole.

codex:cx_console_x.zh: 控制台是指令的入口，不是状态的真相：它显示的是传感器最后一次上报的值。
codex:cx_console_x.en: A console is where commands go in, not where truth comes out: it shows what the sensors last reported.

codex:cx_blackbox_a.zh: 装甲存储筒、水下定位信标和接插件。
codex:cx_blackbox_a.en: An armoured memory drum, an underwater locator beacon and a connector.

codex:cx_blackbox_b.zh: 合同常要求完整送回；切到它就违约。
codex:cx_blackbox_b.en: Contracts usually want it back whole; cut it and you've broken the contract.

codex:cx_blackbox_c.en: Unbolt it and take it whole to the equipment bay.

codex:cx_blackbox_x.zh: 抗坠毁存储器能承受 3,400 g 冲击和 1,100 °C 火烧一小时。它记录的是事故前最后的数据——船出过什么事，答案常在这里。
codex:cx_blackbox_x.en: A crash-survivable memory takes 3,400 g and an hour at 1,100 °C. It holds the last data before the accident: what happened to the ship is usually in there.

codex:cx_imu_a.zh: 三个正交的环形激光陀螺和加速度计，装在减振座上。
codex:cx_imu_a.en: Three ring-laser gyros on orthogonal faces and accelerometers, on isolators.

codex:cx_imu_b.zh: 精密而贵，撞一下就失准。
codex:cx_imu_b.en: Precise and dear; one knock and it's out of calibration.

codex:cx_imu_c.en: Isolate it and move it whole, slowly.

codex:cx_imu_x.zh: 环形激光陀螺测两束反向激光的频差（萨格纳克效应）来测转动，没有运动部件。
codex:cx_imu_x.en: A ring-laser gyro measures rotation from the frequency split between two counter-running beams (the Sagnac effect), with no moving parts.

codex:cx_star_tracker_a.zh: 长遮光罩、光学头和电子箱：拍星空定姿态。
codex:cx_star_tracker_a.en: A long sun baffle, optical head and electronics box: photographs the stars to know its attitude.

codex:cx_star_tracker_b.en: Its optics hate contamination and knocks.

codex:cx_star_tracker_c.en: Cut well away from it and remove it whole.

codex:cx_star_tracker_x.zh: 把拍到的星点图案和星表比对，姿态精度可达角秒级。遮光罩挡住太阳和亮天体的杂散光。
codex:cx_star_tracker_x.en: It matches the star pattern it sees against a catalogue, to arc-second accuracy. The baffle keeps out stray light from the sun and bright bodies.

codex:cx_radar_a.zh: 反射面、馈源支架、副反射面和方位俯仰轴。
codex:cx_radar_a.en: Reflector, feed on its struts, subreflector, azimuth and elevation axes.

codex:cx_radar_b.zh: 反射面大而薄，一撞就变形；发射机可能带高压。
codex:cx_radar_b.en: The dish is big and thin and dents at a touch; its transmitter may hold high voltage.

codex:cx_radar_c.zh: 断开发射机，整件拆下，慢慢拖。
codex:cx_radar_c.en: Isolate the transmitter, remove it whole, tow it slowly.

codex:cx_radar_x.zh: 反射面的面形误差要小于波长的 1/16 才能聚焦，X 波段就是约 2 mm。变形的天线只值铝价。
codex:cx_radar_x.en: The surface has to be true to a sixteenth of the wavelength to focus — about 2 mm at X band. A dented dish is worth its aluminium.

codex:cx_xray_scanner_a.zh: 射线发生器、探测器阵列、铅帘和传送带。
codex:cx_xray_scanner_a.en: X-ray generator, detector array, lead curtains and conveyor.

codex:cx_xray_scanner_b.zh: 发生器带高压，通电时有射线。
codex:cx_xray_scanner_b.en: The generator runs at high voltage and emits while powered.

codex:cx_xray_scanner_c.en: Isolate and discharge it before removing it.

codex:cx_xray_scanner_x.zh: X 光管用 100–300 kV 加速电子撞击靶材产生射线。断电即停止发射，但高压电源的电容要放电。
codex:cx_xray_scanner_x.en: The tube accelerates electrons at 100–300 kV into a target. It stops emitting when unpowered, but its high-voltage supply's capacitors need discharging.

codex:cx_biometric_a.zh: 掌纹仪、虹膜摄像头、键盘和门锁状态灯。
codex:cx_biometric_a.en: Palm reader, iris camera, keypad and the door strike's lights.

codex:cx_biometric_b.zh: 它控制的门锁可能另有备用电源。
codex:cx_biometric_b.en: The lock it controls may have a backup supply of its own.

codex:cx_biometric_c.zh: 查清门锁的每一路电源再处理门。
codex:cx_biometric_c.en: Trace every supply of the lock before dealing with the door.

codex:cx_biometric_x.zh: 终端只是钥匙；锁本身靠电磁铁或电机，断电失效还是断电锁死（fail-secure），决定了门要怎么开。
codex:cx_biometric_x.en: The panel is only a key; the lock is a solenoid or motor, and whether it fails open or fails secure decides how the door has to be opened.

codex:cx_hook_a.zh: 夹板、滑轮、旋转接头和带安全扣的吊钩。
codex:cx_hook_a.en: Cheek plates, sheaves, a swivel and a hook with its safety latch.

codex:cx_hook_b.zh: 钢丝绳还绷着时拆它，绳子会抽回来。
codex:cx_hook_b.en: Free it with the rope still taut and the rope whips back.

codex:cx_hook_c.zh: 先松绞车刹车让绳放松，再拆。
codex:cx_hook_c.en: Slack the rope at the winch brake first, then remove it.

codex:cx_hook_x.zh: 多根绳穿过滑轮组可以省力（倍率），但每根绳里的张力都储存着弹性能。
codex:cx_hook_x.en: Reeving the rope over several sheaves multiplies the pull, but every fall of rope stores elastic energy.

codex:cx_reel_a.zh: 卷筒、法兰、缠着的缆、轮毂和带式刹车。
codex:cx_reel_a.en: Drum, flanges, the cable wound on it, hub and band brake.

codex:cx_reel_b.zh: 缆还受力时拆轴，卷筒会甩出去。
codex:cx_reel_b.en: Take its shaft out with the cable under load and the drum flies.

codex:cx_reel_c.zh: 拔刹车销、看张力表归零，再拆轴。
codex:cx_reel_c.en: Pull the brake pins, watch the tension gauge reach zero, then the shaft.

codex:cx_reel_x.zh: 钢缆受拉储存弹性能 E = F²L/(2EA)：一根几十千牛的长缆存着足以抽坏设备的能量。张力表告诉你它是不是还绷着。
codex:cx_reel_x.en: A taut cable stores E = F²L/(2EA): a long wire at tens of kilonewtons holds enough to smash equipment. The tension gauge tells you whether it's still taut.

codex:cx_arm_a.zh: 底座转台、肩、大臂小臂和油缸、腕部与夹爪。
codex:cx_arm_a.en: Base and turntable, shoulder, upper and lower arm with their cylinders, wrist, gripper.

codex:cx_arm_b.zh: 折叠着的臂靠液压或预紧撑着，拆枢轴会弹开。
codex:cx_arm_b.en: Folded, it's held by hydraulics or preload; take a pivot out and it springs.

codex:cx_arm_c.zh: 泄掉它的蓄能器，拔每个关节的锁销，最后拆枢轴。
codex:cx_arm_c.en: Bleed its accumulator, pull each joint's pin, the pivots last.

codex:cx_arm_x.zh: 收折的机械臂像一把张开的折刀：每个关节里都可能存着力。正确的顺序总是先卸能，再卸锁，最后卸结构。
codex:cx_arm_x.en: A folded arm is a jack-knife held open: any joint may hold force. The order is always energy off, locks off, structure last.

codex:cx_dock_a.zh: 带螺栓圈的环形法兰、捕获锁、导向瓣和舱门。
codex:cx_dock_a.en: A ring flange on its bolt circle, capture latches, guide petals and the hatch.

codex:cx_dock_b.zh: 舱门后面可能是有压的舱。
codex:cx_dock_b.en: Behind the hatch may be a room still under pressure.

codex:cx_dock_c.zh: 先测后面的舱压，放气后再拆。
codex:cx_dock_c.en: Measure the room behind it and vent it first.

codex:cx_dock_x.zh: 对接口要同时承受结构载荷和气密：一圈几十颗螺栓加双道密封圈。导向瓣在对接时把两船对正。
codex:cx_dock_x.en: A docking port carries structural load and holds air: a ring of tens of bolts and a double seal. The petals line the two ships up as they meet.

codex:cx_brake_a.zh: 跨在制动盘边上的卡钳、活塞、刹车片和油管。
codex:cx_brake_a.en: A caliper straddling the disc, with pistons, pads and hydraulic line.

codex:cx_brake_b.zh: 干刹会过热烧坏；它管着的东西可能还在转。
codex:cx_brake_b.en: Braked dry it overheats and burns out; what it holds may still be turning.

codex:cx_brake_c.zh: 先开制动冷却再刹；停稳后再拆。
codex:cx_brake_c.en: Turn the brake cooling on before braking; remove it once things have stopped.

codex:cx_brake_x.zh: 刹车把动能变成热：一个 20,000 rpm 的飞轮里存着的能量，要刹车片一点点磨成热。冷却不够，刹车片温度超过极限就失效，从此停不下来。
codex:cx_brake_x.en: A brake turns motion into heat: everything a flywheel at 20,000 rpm stores has to be ground into heat by the pads. Without cooling the pads pass their limit and fail, and then it can't be stopped.

codex:cx_lift_b.zh: 升起时的液压缸保着压。

codex:cx_lift_c.en: Lower it fully and relieve it before removing it.

codex:cx_lift_x.zh: 剪叉机构展开时力臂变短，油缸推力要很大，所以它降到底时最安全。
codex:cx_lift_x.en: As the scissors open the lever shortens and the cylinder pushes hard; fully lowered is where it's safe.

codex:cx_hold_crane_a.zh: 在桥轨上走的小车、卷扬电机和吊钩。
codex:cx_hold_crane_a.en: A trolley on its bridge rail, hoist motor and hook.

codex:cx_hold_crane_b.zh: 吊着东西时拆它，吊的东西会掉；拉杆还紧着切它会抽坏它。
codex:cx_hold_crane_b.en: Take it while it holds a load and the load drops; cut a tie rod still tight and it whips.

codex:cx_hold_crane_c.zh: 先放下吊物、松开拉杆，再拆。
codex:cx_hold_crane_c.en: Set its load down and slack the tie rods first.

codex:cx_hold_crane_x.zh: 失重下吊车不是用来提重的，而是用来控制大件的位置和速度。
codex:cx_hold_crane_x.en: In free fall a crane doesn't lift weight; it controls where big things go and how fast.

codex:cx_machine_tool_a.zh: 车床或铣床：床身、主轴、刀架或工作台。
codex:cx_machine_tool_a.en: A lathe or mill: bed, spindle, tool post or table.

codex:cx_machine_tool_b.zh: 很重，地脚螺栓多；电机带电。
codex:cx_machine_tool_b.en: Heavy, many hold-down bolts, a live motor.

codex:cx_machine_tool_c.zh: 断电后拆地脚螺栓，超重就沿标线分段。
codex:cx_machine_tool_c.en: Isolate it, undo its hold-downs, split it on its lines if too heavy.

codex:cx_machine_tool_x.zh: 机床的价值在精度：导轨磨损或撞弯就只剩铸铁的价。
codex:cx_machine_tool_x.en: A machine tool's value is its accuracy: knock the ways out of true and it's worth its cast iron.

codex:cx_vehicle_a.zh: 绑在甲板上的汽车、叉车、牵引车或作业车。
codex:cx_vehicle_a.en: A car, forklift, tractor or work vehicle lashed to the deck.

codex:cx_vehicle_b.zh: 车里有电池或燃料，绑带松了会在舱里滑动撞坏东西。
codex:cx_vehicle_b.en: It carries a battery or fuel, and loose lashings let it slide into things.

codex:cx_vehicle_c.zh: 整车运走，或先处理电池燃料再拆。
codex:cx_vehicle_c.en: Take it whole, or deal with its battery and fuel before taking it apart.

codex:cx_vehicle_x.zh: 车辆是整件货物，价值远高于废金属；绑带和轮挡在失重下才是真正拉住它的东西。
codex:cx_vehicle_x.en: A vehicle is cargo, worth far more whole than as metal; in free fall the lashings and chocks are what really hold it.

codex:cx_cargo_a.zh: 标准集装箱或木框货箱，按货物申报计价。
codex:cx_cargo_a.en: Standard containers or framed crates, paid by their declared cargo.

codex:cx_cargo_b.zh: 又大又重，拖动时惯性大；冷藏箱、住人箱里可能有压。
codex:cx_cargo_b.en: Big and heavy, with momentum to match; reefers and accommodation boxes may hold pressure.

codex:cx_cargo_c.zh: 看质量，必要时用搬运无人机或升级抓钩；有压的先放气。
codex:cx_cargo_c.en: Check its mass; use the hauler or a bigger grapple if needed; vent a pressurised one first.

codex:cx_cargo_x.zh: 集装箱四角的角件是唯一的承力点，扭锁把箱子锁在一起。整箱货物的价值远高于箱子本身。
codex:cx_cargo_x.en: A container's corner castings are its only load points; twist-locks lock them together. What's inside is worth far more than the box.

codex:cx_uav_a.zh: 停在机位里的小型无人机：机体环、四个旋翼、传感器眼。
codex:cx_uav_a.en: A small drone parked in its bay: body ring, four rotor wells, sensor eye.

codex:cx_uav_b.zh: 自带电池：船断电了它还能“醒”过来乱飞。
codex:cx_uav_b.en: It carries its own battery: the ship dead, it can still wake up and fly.

codex:cx_uav_c.zh: 断机位充电和它自己的电池开关，摘电池包再搬。
codex:cx_uav_c.en: Switch off its charger and its own battery, take the pack out, then move it.

codex:cx_uav_x.zh: 无人机的飞控在掉电保护逻辑下会尝试起飞返航；被松开时如果电池还接着，旋翼一转就会把自己甩出去。
codex:cx_uav_x.en: A drone's flight controller tries to take off and return when its link drops; released with its battery still connected, its rotors spin up and throw it about.

codex:cx_stator_a.zh: 叠片铁芯、槽里的线圈和两端翻出的端部绕组。
codex:cx_stator_a.en: Laminated core, coils in its slots, end turns curling out both ends.

codex:cx_stator_b.zh: 它的电来自电容组：断主电后仍可能带几百伏。
codex:cx_stator_b.en: It runs off a capacitor bank: off the main supply, it may still hold hundreds of volts.

codex:cx_stator_c.zh: 先给电容组放电，再拆线圈。
codex:cx_stator_c.en: Discharge the capacitor bank first, then the coils.

codex:cx_stator_x.zh: 直线电机是“展开”的旋转电机：定子沿轨道铺开，行波磁场推动动子。电磁弹射靠它在几秒内把载荷加速到几百米每秒。
codex:cx_stator_x.en: A linear motor is a rotary motor unrolled: the stator laid along the track, a travelling field pushing the mover. An electromagnetic launcher uses it to reach hundreds of metres a second in seconds.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_a.zh: 在轨道上滑行的滑橇、托垫和释放锁。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_a.en: A sled on its rails, saddle pads and release latches.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_b.zh: 轨道还有预紧，释放锁一开它就会窜出。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_b.en: With the rails still preloaded, open the latches and it lurches off.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_c.zh: 轨道泄完预紧后再拆滑架。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_c.en: Take the preload off the rails before removing the cradle.

codex:cx_launch_cradle_x.zh: 滑架承受发射时几十 g 的加速度，结构厚重。
codex:cx_launch_cradle_x.en: The cradle takes tens of g at launch and is built heavy for it.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_a.zh: 真空壳里的复合材料轮缘、磁悬浮轴承和电动/发电机。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_a.en: A composite rim in a vacuum housing on magnetic bearings, with a motor-generator.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_b.zh: 还在高速旋转：松开或切开，轮子甩出去。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_b.en: Still spinning fast: free or cut it and the wheel flies.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_c.zh: 开刹车冷却再上刹车，转速降到 300 rpm 以下再拆。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_c.en: Brake cooling on, then the brake; under 300 rpm, remove it.

codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_x.zh: 飞轮储能 E = ½Iω²，与转速的平方成正比：20,000 rpm 时储能是 2,000 rpm 的一百倍。真空和磁悬浮让它几乎没有摩擦，自己能转好几天。
codex:cx_flywheel_rotor_x.en: A flywheel holds E = ½Iω², the square of its speed: at 20,000 rpm a hundred times what it holds at 2,000. Vacuum and magnetic bearings leave it almost no friction; on its own it spins for days.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_a.zh: 壳体里的飞轮、轮毂轴承和定子线圈：用来转动整艘船。
codex:cx_reaction_wheel_a.en: A wheel on its hub bearings with stator coils in a housing: for turning the ship.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_b.en: Even idle it may still be turning.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_c.en: Read its speed and wait for it to stop.

codex:cx_reaction_wheel_x.zh: 电机让飞轮朝一个方向加速，船就朝反方向转（角动量守恒）。转速常在几千 rpm。
codex:cx_reaction_wheel_x.en: Spin the wheel up one way and the ship turns the other (conservation of angular momentum). They run at thousands of rpm.

codex:cx_despin_brake_a.zh: 旋转居住环轮毂上的制动盘、卡钳和散热片。
codex:cx_despin_brake_a.en: The disc, calipers and cooling fins on a habitat ring's hub.

codex:cx_despin_brake_b.zh: 环上负载带电时刹车，回馈电流会烧滑环；干刹会烧刹车。
codex:cx_despin_brake_b.en: Brake with the ring's loads live and the regenerated current burns the slip ring; brake dry and the brake burns.

codex:cx_despin_brake_c.zh: 断环上负载、开冷却，两个环一起刹。
codex:cx_despin_brake_c.en: Loads off the ring, cooling on, brake both rings together.

codex:cx_despin_brake_x.zh: 电机-制动器把环的动能转成电存进电容（再生制动），电容满了要放电才能继续刹。只刹一个环，船体会被另一个环的角动量拧扭。
codex:cx_despin_brake_x.en: The motor-brake turns the ring's energy into charge in a capacitor (regenerative braking); full, it has to be dumped before braking goes on. Brake only one ring and the other's angular momentum twists the hull.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_a.zh: 转动的轮毂和固定主轴之间的迷宫密封。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_a.en: A labyrinth seal between the turning hub and the fixed spine.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_b.zh: 环还在转时打开过渡气闸，会撕开它。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_b.en: Open the transfer airlock while the ring turns and it tears.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_c.zh: 环停稳、轴承锁上后再动它。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_c.en: Only once the ring has stopped and its bearing is locked.

codex:cx_rotary_seal_x.zh: 迷宫密封靠一圈圈齿的节流减少泄漏，加缓冲气槽隔开两侧，本身不接触——所以它能在转动中密封，但挡不住真正的开口。
codex:cx_rotary_seal_x.en: A labyrinth seal throttles leakage through ring after ring of teeth with a buffer-gas groove between, without touching — sealing while it turns, but no use against a real opening.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_a.zh: 沿导轨齿条升降的轿厢：门、驱动电机和安全钳。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_a.en: A car on its rack and pinion: doors, drive motor, safety gear.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_b.zh: 环在转时轿厢受离心力，导轨一断它会甩出去。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_b.en: With the ring turning the car feels the spin; cut its rail and it's flung.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_c.en: Only after the ring is despun.

codex:cx_spoke_lift_x.zh: 旋转环用离心力造“重力”：半径 100 m、3 rpm 时约 1 g。轿厢从轮毂走到环上，感受到的重力从零升到 1 g。
codex:cx_spoke_lift_x.en: A rotating ring makes gravity from its spin: about 1 g at 100 m radius and 3 rpm. The car's ride from hub to rim goes from nothing to a full g.

codex:cx_tether_damper_a.zh: 液压缸、弹簧和气囊：吸收系绳的振动。
codex:cx_tether_damper_a.en: A hydraulic cylinder, spring and gas reservoir: soaking up the tether's vibration.

codex:cx_tether_damper_b.zh: 系绳还绷着，阻尼器里压着弹簧和气压。
codex:cx_tether_damper_b.en: With the tether taut, the damper holds spring and gas pressure.

codex:cx_tether_damper_c.zh: 系绳停转、张紧器松开之后再拆。
codex:cx_tether_damper_c.en: Once the tether has stopped and its tensioner is slack.

codex:cx_tether_damper_x.zh: 长系绳会像琴弦一样振动，阻尼器把振动能量变成热。
codex:cx_tether_damper_x.en: A long tether rings like a string; the damper turns that motion into heat.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_a.zh: 固定钳口、液压缸推动的活动钳口和底板。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_a.en: A fixed jaw, a moving jaw pushed by its cylinder, and the base plate.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_b.zh: 保着压整件拆下，钳口会弹开砸坏东西。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_b.en: Removed while it holds pressure, its jaw springs open.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_c.zh: 先开它的保压开关泄压，再拆。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_c.en: Release its holding switch to bleed it, then remove it.

codex:cx_hyd_clamp_x.zh: 夹钳靠液压锁保持夹紧力，即使泵停了也能保压很久。一组夹钳共同承担载荷时，松开的顺序决定剩下的夹钳受力。
codex:cx_hyd_clamp_x.en: A clamp's lock valve holds its grip long after the pump stops. When several share a load, the order they're released in decides what the rest must carry.

codex:cx_iso_table_a.zh: 蜂窝台面、气动隔振腿和水平阀。
codex:cx_iso_table_a.en: A honeycomb top on pneumatic legs with levelling valves.

codex:cx_iso_table_b.zh: 没锁时，附近的切割和撞击会通过它震坏精密件。
codex:cx_iso_table_b.en: Unlocked, a cut or knock nearby shakes the precision parts on it.

codex:cx_iso_table_c.zh: 先锁住隔振台，再在附近动刀。
codex:cx_iso_table_c.en: Lock the table before any cutting nearby.

codex:cx_iso_table_x.zh: 隔振台把几赫兹以上的振动衰减到百分之一以下；锁住后它就成了刚性的，不再放大冲击。
codex:cx_iso_table_x.en: It cuts vibration above a few hertz to under a hundredth; locked, it's rigid and stops amplifying shocks.

codex:cx_escape_pod_a.zh: 发射架上的救生舱：防热罩、侧舱门、座椅、制动火箭和发射夹。
codex:cx_escape_pod_a.en: A pod in its cradle: heat shield, hatch, seats, retro pack and launch clamps.

codex:cx_escape_pod_b.zh: 发射夹上装着火工品，待发电路带电就可能走火弹出。
codex:cx_escape_pod_b.en: Its clamps carry pyrotechnics; with the arming circuit live, they can fire and throw it.

codex:cx_escape_pod_c.zh: 断开待发开关，再拆发射夹和火工品。
codex:cx_escape_pod_c.en: Disarm it at the pod control panel before touching the clamps or charges.

codex:cx_escape_pod_x.zh: 爆炸螺栓里装着少量炸药，起爆电流只需几安培、几毫秒。发射电容是一路独立电源，专门为它供电。
codex:cx_escape_pod_x.en: An explosive bolt holds a little charge; it needs a few amps for a few milliseconds to fire. The launch capacitor is a supply of its own, there for that alone.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_a.zh: 一墙密封保管箱，或带锁栓的厚壁库门。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_a.en: A wall of sealed deposit boxes, or a thick vault door with locking bolts.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_b.zh: 库门带电锁死；库里可能有压。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_b.en: The vault door locks while powered; the vault may hold pressure.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_c.zh: 断开门锁的所有电源，放气后开门，保管箱整件运走。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_c.en: Kill every supply of the lock, vent the vault, open it, take the boxes whole.

codex:cx_safe_deposit_x.zh: 库门的锁栓由电磁铁顶住：通电时锁死，断电后锁栓仍在原位，要扳动机械释放杆才收回。只要电磁铁还有任何一路电，释放杆就扳不动。
codex:cx_safe_deposit_x.en: The vault's bolts are held by a solenoid: powered, locked; unpowered, the bolts stay where they are until a mechanical release lever draws them. While the solenoid has any supply at all, the lever won't move.

codex:cx_pwr_core_a.zh: 压力容器、顶盖螺栓环、控制棒驱动管、堆芯和下腔室。
codex:cx_pwr_core_a.en: Vessel, closure head on its stud ring, rod drive housings, core and lower plenum.

codex:cx_pwr_core_b.zh: 停堆后仍有强辐射和衰变热，一回路高温高压。
codex:cx_pwr_core_b.en: Shut down it is still radioactive and hot, its primary loop at high temperature and pressure.

codex:cx_pwr_core_c.zh: 保持冷却、等它降温，屏蔽下作业，整件走危险品口。
codex:cx_pwr_core_c.en: Keep it cooled, let it come down, work behind shielding, send it whole to the hazard mouth.

codex:cx_pwr_core_x.zh: 一回路约 15.5 MPa、315 °C，水在高压下不沸腾。停堆一小时后衰变热约为额定功率的 1.5%，一天后约 0.5%——一座 100 MW 的堆一天后仍在发 0.5 MW 的热。
codex:cx_pwr_core_x.en: The primary runs about 15.5 MPa and 315 °C, water held liquid by pressure. An hour after shutdown the decay heat is about 1.5 % of rated power, after a day about 0.5 % — a 100 MW reactor still putting out half a megawatt.

codex:cx_crdm_a.zh: 耐压外壳、提升与保持线圈、棒位指示和驱动杆。
codex:cx_crdm_a.en: Pressure housing, lift and hold coils, rod position indicator and drive rod.

codex:cx_crdm_b.zh: 它是一回路压力边界的一部分。
codex:cx_crdm_b.en: It's part of the primary pressure boundary.

codex:cx_crdm_c.zh: 一回路泄压、冷却后再拆。
codex:cx_crdm_c.en: Only with the primary depressurised and cool.

codex:cx_crdm_x.zh: 磁力提升式驱动机构断电时，控制棒靠自身释放落入堆芯（失电安全）。
codex:cx_crdm_x.en: With a magnetic-jack drive, losing power drops the rods into the core by themselves (fail-safe).

codex:cx_rcp_a.zh: 屏蔽电机、飞轮、密封组件和泵壳。
codex:cx_rcp_a.en: Canned motor, flywheel, seal package and casing.

codex:cx_rcp_b.zh: 它是冷却堆芯的唯一手段：先断它，堆芯就开始升温。
codex:cx_rcp_b.en: It's what cools the core: cut it first and the core heats up.

codex:cx_rcp_c.zh: 堆芯冷下来之前别断它的电。
codex:cx_rcp_c.en: Leave its power on until the core is cool.

codex:cx_rcp_x.zh: 泵上的飞轮让断电后的冷却流量缓慢下降，给堆芯多几十秒的冷却。
codex:cx_rcp_x.en: Its flywheel makes the flow coast down slowly after a power loss, buying the core tens of seconds of cooling.

codex:cx_pressurizer_a.zh: 高大的容器，上部蒸汽空间、喷淋头、电加热器和安全阀。
codex:cx_pressurizer_a.en: A tall vessel: steam space above the water, spray head, heaters, relief valves.

codex:cx_pressurizer_b.zh: 它维持一回路的压力：里面是高压饱和水和蒸汽。
codex:cx_pressurizer_b.en: It holds the primary's pressure: saturated water and steam at high pressure.

codex:cx_pressurizer_c.zh: 一回路泄压冷却后再拆。
codex:cx_pressurizer_c.en: Only after the primary is relieved and cool.

codex:cx_pressurizer_x.zh: 加热器烧出蒸汽升压，喷淋冷水降压。15.5 MPa 下水的饱和温度约 345 °C。
codex:cx_pressurizer_x.en: Heaters raise the pressure by boiling, cold spray lowers it. At 15.5 MPa water saturates at about 345 °C.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_a.zh: 高压缸和低压缸同轴，叶片一级比一级长。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_a.en: High- and low-pressure cylinders on one shaft, blades growing longer stage by stage.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_b.zh: 极重，转子可能还在盘车。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_b.en: Very heavy, and its rotor may still be turning on its gear.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_c.zh: 停稳、隔离蒸汽后，沿法兰分段拆。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_c.en: Stopped and isolated from steam, it comes apart at its flanges.

codex:cx_steam_turbine_x.zh: 蒸汽每经过一级膨胀一点、体积变大，所以后面的叶片更长。整机常重几十吨。
codex:cx_steam_turbine_x.en: The steam expands a little at every stage and takes more room, so the blades lengthen. A whole set weighs tens of tonnes.

codex:cx_condenser_a.zh: 壳体、管束、水室和热井：把乏汽凝成水。
codex:cx_condenser_a.en: Shell, tube bundle, waterboxes and hotwell: exhaust steam back to water.

codex:cx_condenser_b.zh: 管束里有冷却水，热井里有凝结水。
codex:cx_condenser_b.en: Cooling water in its tubes, condensate in its hotwell.

codex:cx_condenser_c.en: Drain both sides before removing it.

codex:cx_condenser_x.zh: 凝汽器在真空下工作：蒸汽凝结体积缩小上千倍，自己就把壳内抽成低压。
codex:cx_condenser_x.en: It works in vacuum: condensing, the steam shrinks a thousandfold and pulls the shell down to low pressure by itself.

codex:cx_control_drum_a.zh: 一面贴着碳化硼吸收体的铍鼓，由电机转动。
codex:cx_control_drum_a.en: A beryllium drum faced on one side with boron carbide, turned by a motor.

codex:cx_control_drum_b.zh: 没锁就吊堆芯，鼓会滑转，吸收体转开，附近一阵剂量。
codex:cx_control_drum_b.en: Lift the core with it unlocked and it slips, the absorber turns away, and a burst of dose goes out.

codex:cx_control_drum_c.zh: 吊堆芯前把每个控制鼓机械锁死。
codex:cx_control_drum_c.en: Lock every drum mechanically before the core is lifted.

codex:cx_control_drum_x.zh: 鼓转到吸收体朝向堆芯，吸收中子、压低反应性；转到铍面朝内，反射中子、提高反应性。
codex:cx_control_drum_x.en: Turned absorber-in, it soaks up neutrons and holds the reactor down; beryllium-in, it reflects them back and raises it.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_a.zh: 钨和氢化锂交替叠层的屏蔽板，挡住堆芯的直射辐射。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_a.en: Layers of tungsten and lithium hydride stacked across the core's line of sight.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_b.zh: 它后面才是安全区；把它拆走前，先想好你在哪里干活。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_b.en: Only behind it is safe; before moving it, know where you'll work.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_c.zh: 吊着它挡在堆芯前，在它的阴影里作业。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_c.en: Hang it in front of the core and work in its shadow.

codex:cx_shadow_shield_x.zh: 钨挡伽马射线，氢化锂慢化并吸收中子。阴影里的剂量率只剩约 1%。航天堆不做全包屏蔽，只屏蔽乘员方向以省质量。
codex:cx_shadow_shield_x.en: Tungsten stops gamma, lithium hydride slows and absorbs neutrons. In its shadow the dose rate falls to about 1 %. Space reactors shield only towards the crew to save mass.

codex:cx_tf_coil_a.zh: 钢壳里的铠装导体绕组，每匝中心通液氦。
codex:cx_tf_coil_a.en: A winding pack of cable-in-conduit turns in a steel case, liquid helium through each turn.

codex:cx_tf_coil_b.zh: 带着几十亿焦的磁能：失冷或切支撑会失超，能量瞬间释放。
codex:cx_tf_coil_b.en: It holds gigajoules of field: lose its cooling or cut its supports and it quenches, all at once.

codex:cx_tf_coil_c.zh: 开泄能开关、保持制冷，储能泄完再拆。
codex:cx_tf_coil_c.en: Close the dump switch, keep it cold, take it out only once it's run down.

codex:cx_tf_coil_x.zh: Nb₃Sn 超导体在约 18 K 以下无电阻，平时用 4.5 K 液氦冷着。失超时局部变成有电阻的导体，电流 × 电阻 = 热，热又让更多导体失超——几秒内整个线圈的储能变成热和力。
codex:cx_tf_coil_x.en: Nb₃Sn has no resistance below about 18 K and is kept at 4.5 K in liquid helium. In a quench a patch turns resistive, current times resistance makes heat, the heat takes more conductor normal — and in seconds the coil's whole store becomes heat and force.

codex:cx_cs_stack_a.zh: 饼式绕组叠在拉紧板之间，中间是孔，上下预压法兰。
codex:cx_cs_stack_a.en: Pancake windings stacked between tie plates, the bore down its middle, pre-compression flanges.

codex:cx_cs_stack_b.zh: 和纵场线圈一样储着磁能，会失超。
codex:cx_cs_stack_b.en: Like the TF coils it stores field energy and can quench.

codex:cx_cs_stack_c.zh: 泄能完成后再拆预压结构。
codex:cx_cs_stack_c.en: Remove its pre-compression only after it's dumped.

codex:cx_cs_stack_x.zh: 中心螺线管靠变化的磁通在等离子体里感应出电流（变压器原理），它自己承受巨大的电磁力，要预压住。
codex:cx_cs_stack_x.en: The central solenoid drives current in the plasma by changing its flux, like a transformer; it carries huge electromagnetic forces and is held under pre-compression.

codex:cx_grav_support_a.zh: 两个端块之间一叠薄柔性板：让线圈冷缩时不拉坏底座。
codex:cx_grav_support_a.en: A stack of thin flexible plates between two blocks: lets the coil shrink as it cools.

codex:cx_grav_support_b.zh: 线圈带场时切或拆它，线圈失超。
codex:cx_grav_support_b.en: Cut or free it while the coil is energised and the coil quenches.

codex:cx_grav_support_c.en: Only after the coil is dumped.

codex:cx_grav_support_x.zh: 从室温冷到 4 K，几米长的钢结构会缩短几毫米；柔性板在一个方向软、另一个方向硬，吸收收缩又能承重。
codex:cx_grav_support_x.en: From room temperature to 4 K a few metres of steel shrinks by millimetres; the plates are soft one way and stiff the other, taking up the shrinkage and still carrying the load.

codex:cx_vv_wall_a.zh: 内外两层壳之间夹着加强肋，夹层里流屏蔽水。
codex:cx_vv_wall_a.en: Inner and outer shells with ribs between; shielding water runs in the gap.

codex:cx_vv_wall_b.zh: 夹层里可能还有水；内壁被中子活化。
codex:cx_vv_wall_b.en: The gap may still hold water; the inner shell is activated by neutrons.

codex:cx_vv_wall_c.en: Drain the gap and cut it on its marked lines.

codex:cx_vv_wall_x.zh: 真空室是等离子体的第一道包络，也是氚的屏障。聚变中子会把结构钢活化，退役后要按低放废物处理。
codex:cx_vv_wall_x.en: The vacuum vessel is the plasma's first enclosure and a tritium barrier. Fusion neutrons activate its steel; retired, it's low-level waste.

codex:cx_blanket_a.zh: 贴在真空室内壁上的模块：面向等离子体的第一壁和后面的屏蔽块。
codex:cx_blanket_a.en: Modules lining the vessel: a plasma-facing first wall and a shield block behind.

codex:cx_blanket_b.zh: 铍瓦面怕撞；冷却管里有水。
codex:cx_blanket_b.en: Its beryllium face hates knocks; its pipes hold water.

codex:cx_blanket_c.zh: 排空冷却管，拆螺栓整块取出。
codex:cx_blanket_c.en: Drain its pipes, unbolt it and lift it out whole.

codex:cx_blanket_x.zh: 第一壁表面承受每平方米几兆瓦的热流。铍粉有毒，切割会产生铍尘。
codex:cx_blanket_x.en: The first wall takes megawatts per square metre. Beryllium dust is toxic, and cutting it makes some.

codex:cx_divertor_a.zh: 钢体上竖着钨单块的内外靶板，中间是穹顶，带冷却管。
codex:cx_divertor_a.en: A steel cassette with tungsten monoblock targets at each end, a dome between, and coolant pipes.

codex:cx_divertor_b.zh: 很重，冷却管里有高压水。
codex:cx_divertor_b.en: Heavy, with high-pressure water in its pipes.

codex:cx_divertor_c.zh: 排空冷却管后整盒拆下。
codex:cx_divertor_c.en: Drain it and take the cassette out whole.

codex:cx_divertor_x.zh: 偏滤器把等离子体边缘的热和杂质引到靶板上，靶板热流可达每平方米 10–20 MW，接近火箭喉部。
codex:cx_divertor_x.en: It leads the plasma edge's heat and impurities onto its targets, which take 10–20 MW per square metre — rocket-throat territory.

codex:cx_gyrotron_a.zh: 电子枪、超导磁体里的谐振腔、输出窗和顶部收集极。
codex:cx_gyrotron_a.en: Electron gun, cavity inside a superconducting magnet, output window, collector on top.

codex:cx_gyrotron_b.zh: 自带超导磁体；电子枪和收集极带几十千伏高压。
